```tsx
import { CaseDecidedParams, MEASURES, RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  COMPOSER,
  PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER,
  correctionChoices,
  correctionDraft,
  decisionParamsOf,
  measuresOffered,
  newDraft,
  noEffectOf,
  offeredDraft,
  previewOf,
  retireMoved,
  retireOpen,
  reviewChoices,
  reviewDraft,
  reviewParamsOf,
  type CaseDraft,
} from "../src/compose";
import { STANDING_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { accountCase, decision, NO_STANDING, retireCase } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * The console's part of the retirement of a handle (3e design, sections 8.3, 8.7 and 10.3): the control in the composer
 * of an account case, with [retire.what], [retire.first], [retire.moved], [retire.none] and the no-effect sentence; the
 * params, in which the retirement is one action of the list in its one order; the preview; and "Give the handle back"
 * with [review.handle] in a correction and a review. Its pure parts are tested as functions, its screens server-rendered.
 */

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z");
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const HEX = "cd".repeat(32);
const DIGESTS = { snapshot: HEX, facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null };
const PLACEHOLDER = `${RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX}0a1b2c3d4e5f`;
const RETIREMENT = "9a0b1c2d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d";
const RETIRE_ACTION = "0b1c2d3e-4f5a-4b6c-9d7e-8f9a0b1c2d3e";
const APPEAL = "1c2d3e4f-5a6b-4c7d-8e8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f";

const retire = { kind: "retire_handle" as const, mediaId: null };
const finalRetire = (view: CaseView, change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}): CaseDraft => ({ ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR), kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [retire], ...change });

function composer(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft) {
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role: MODERATOR, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

/** The final decision under R4 that retired the account's handle, with its retirement's row as the case answer carries it. */
function retired(inForce = true): CaseDecision {
  const view = retireCase();
  return decision({
    id: RETIREMENT,
    kind: "final",
    ruleId: "R4",
    rulesVersion: 3,
    redressVersion: 2,
    category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS",
    snapshotId: view.snapshots[0]!.id,
    actions: [{ ...decision().actions[0]!, ...NO_STANDING, id: RETIRE_ACTION, kind: "retire_handle", inForce, handle: "ada_l" }],
  });
}

/** The account case that holds that retirement, closed, the profile on its placeholder, with an appeal this person may review. */
const retiredCase = (decided: CaseDecision = retired()): CaseView => ({
  ...retireCase(PLACEHOLDER, "Ada_L", { snapshotHandleRetired: true, openReports: false }),
  closedAt: "2026-10-05T09:00:00.000Z",
  answeredSeq: 1,
  decisions: [decided],
  appeals: [{ id: APPEAL, decisionId: RETIREMENT, filedAt: "2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z", statement: "That was my own name.", answeredAt: null, result: null, answeredBy: null, reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false, mayReview: true }],
});

describe("the control in the composer of an account case (8.3)", () => {
  test("the retirement is offered in a final decision on an account case to any moderator, never while deciding and never on a post case", () => {
    const view = retireCase();
    expect(measuresOffered(view, "final")).toEqual(["reset_display_name", "reset_bio", "retire_handle"]);
    expect(measuresOffered(view, "interim")).toEqual(["reset_display_name", "reset_bio"]);
    expect(MEASURES.retire_handle.label).toBe("Retire the handle");
    const out = composer(view, finalRetire(view, { actions: [] }));
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.retire_handle.label);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.retire.what));
    // Not chosen yet: the sentence about its place in the decision waits for the choice.
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.retire.first));
    expect(composer(view, finalRetire(view))).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.retire.first));
    expect(retireOpen(view)).toBe(true);
    expect(retireMoved(view)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("[retire.moved] when the profile's handle now differs from the snapshot's, in any case; the retirement still names the snapshot's", () => {
    const moved = retireCase("ada_new", "Ada_L");
    expect(retireMoved(moved)).toBe(true);
    expect(retireMoved(retireCase("ADA_L", "ada_l"))).toBe(false);
    expect(composer(moved, finalRetire(moved))).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.retire.moved));
    expect(composer(retireCase(), finalRetire(retireCase()))).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.retire.moved));
    // The statement names the handle of the snapshot, lowercased, as the database retires it.
    expect(statementParagraphs(previewOf(moved, finalRetire(moved), NOW))[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.retire("ada_l", PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER, "at_once"));
  });

  test("[retire.none] greys the control while the profile holds a placeholder, and a draft that held it loses it", () => {
    const view = retireCase(PLACEHOLDER, PLACEHOLDER);
    expect(retireOpen(view)).toBe(false);
    const out = composer(view, finalRetire(view, { actions: [] }));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.retire.none));
    // The checkbox before the label is disabled.
    const label = out.indexOf(">Retire the handle<");
    expect(out.slice(out.lastIndexOf("<li>", label), label)).toContain('disabled=""');
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, finalRetire(view)).actions).toEqual([]);
    // An open control keeps a chosen retirement.
    expect(offeredDraft(retireCase(), MODERATOR, finalRetire(retireCase())).actions).toEqual([retire]);
  });

  test("when the snapshot's handle is already retired the control stays open with the no-effect sentence; on a deleted account it says so too", () => {
    const view = retireCase("ada_new", "Ada_L", { snapshotHandleRetired: true });
    expect(retireOpen(view)).toBe(true);
    expect(noEffectOf(view, retire, "final")).toBe("already");
    expect(composer(view, finalRetire(view))).toContain(esc(COMPOSER.noEffect));
    expect(noEffectOf(retireCase(), retire, "final")).toBeNull();
    const gone = { ...retireCase(), target: { ...retireCase().target, deleted: true } } as CaseView;
    expect(noEffectOf(gone, retire, "final")).toBe("deleted");
    // The preview says what the author will read: the handle, and that it changes nothing now.
    expect(statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, finalRetire(view), NOW))[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireLead("ada_l")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireAlready}`);
  });

  test("the params carry the retirement in the list's one order, beside a reset of the display name; the decide route moves it first", () => {
    const view = retireCase();
    const params = decisionParamsOf(view, finalRetire(view, { actions: [retire, { kind: "reset_display_name", mediaId: null }] }), DIGESTS);
    expect(params.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "reset_display_name", mediaId: null }, retire]);
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R4", unfounded: [], replaced: false });
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse(params).success).toBe(true);
    // No strike: a decision on an account case never gives one.
    expect(params.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike")).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the preview prints the snapshot's handle and the placeholder's form, since the measure has no id yet; its sentence ends at once", () => {
    const view = retireCase();
    expect(PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER).toBe(`${RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX}xxxxxxxxxxxx`);
    expect(PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER).toHaveLength(20);
    const preview = previewOf(view, finalRetire(view), NOW);
    expect(preview.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, handle: "ada_l", placeholder: PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER }]);
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(preview);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.retire("ada_l", PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER, "at_once"));
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.final);
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(composer(view, finalRetire(view))).toContain(esc(STATEMENT_WORDS.retire("ada_l", PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER, "at_once")));
  });

  test("the words are the design's", () => {
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.retire).toEqual({
      what: "Retiring a handle takes it from everyone for good, its holder included. Use it when the breach lies in the handle itself: impersonation, a doxxed name, a threat. The profile then shows a placeholder (retired_ and 12 characters), and its holder may choose a new handle at once, or, if the account is suspended, when that suspension ends.",
      first: "The retirement is this decision's first measure. A reset of the display name added to it copies the placeholder, never the retired handle.",
      moved: "The account changed its handle after this snapshot. Confirming retires the handle shown in the snapshot and leaves the new one alone. To judge the new handle, take a fresh snapshot.",
      none: "Not open: this profile holds a placeholder, so there is no handle to retire.",
    });
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle).toBe("Giving the handle back clears its retirement. A profile that still holds the placeholder gets the handle again; one that chose another handle since may change back at once.");
  });
});

describe("giving the handle back in a correction or a review (8.7)", () => {
  test("a correction offers Give the handle back with [review.handle]; lifting it reverses the decision, and the preview names the handle", () => {
    const view = retiredCase();
    const decided = view.decisions[0]!;
    const draft = correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decided, MODERATOR);
    expect(correctionChoices(view, draft, MODERATOR).map((choice) => choice.reversal)).toEqual([{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null }]);
    const out = composer(view, draft);
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.unretire_handle.label);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle));
    const chosen = { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "unretire_handle" as const, mediaId: null }] };
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, chosen, { ...DIGESTS, facts: null })).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null }] });
    const preview = previewOf(view, chosen, NOW);
    expect(preview.reversals).toEqual([{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, handle: "ada_l" }]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(preview)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.unretired("ada_l"));
  });

  test("a review offers it too: Reverse gives the handle back, Keep lifts nothing; a retirement already reversed is not offered", () => {
    const view = retiredCase();
    const decided = view.decisions[0]!;
    const draft = reviewDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decided, MODERATOR);
    expect(reviewChoices(view, draft, MODERATOR).map((choice) => choice.reversal.kind)).toEqual(["unretire_handle"]);
    expect(composer(view, draft)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle));
    expect(reviewParamsOf(view, { ...draft, review: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null }] }, { snapshot: HEX, reason: HEX }).actions).toEqual([{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null }]);
    expect(reviewParamsOf(view, { ...draft, review: "kept", actions: [] }, { snapshot: HEX, reason: HEX }).actions).toEqual([]);
    const lifted = retiredCase(retired(false));
    expect(reviewChoices(lifted, reviewDraft(caseId(lifted.id), lifted, lifted.decisions[0]!, MODERATOR), MODERATOR)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the case page names the handle a retirement retired beside its row", () => {
    const base: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
      shownImage: null,
      busy: null,
      notice: null,
      error: null,
      note: "",
      reveal: null,
      onOpenCase: noop,
      onShowImage: noop,
      onShowClearly: noop,
      onHideImage: noop,
      onImageError: noop,
      onSnapshot: noop,
      onNoteChange: noop,
      onNoteSave: noop,
      onRevealOpen: noop,
      onRevealChange: noop,
      onRevealConfirm: noop,
      onRevealClose: noop,
    };
    const out = html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={caseId(retiredCase().id)} view={retiredCase()} />);
    expect(out).toContain(`${MEASURES.retire_handle.label}: in force; the handle @ada_l`);
    // An account case without the measure says nothing of one.
    expect(html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={caseId(accountCase().id)} view={accountCase()} />)).not.toContain("the handle @");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/standing-handles.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE, OUTCOME_PHRASES, itemOutcomeWords } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { closeDb, createDb } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { ROUTE_KINDS } from "../../src/moderation/decide";
import { updateLine } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { itemStatus } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { dueRedactions, insertAction, insertDecision, lateErasures, noticeItems, pendingOutcomeLines } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { changeHandle } from "../../src/social/flows/profile-edit";
import { closeDecisions, deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, actionsOf, anAccount, appealOf, decisionParams, ground, intake, refusal, removeFixtures, rowCounts, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rejection, socialHarness, type SocialHarness } from "./social-harness";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Every test commits decisions confirmed with a real key, each a round of the step-up flow: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

/** A handle nobody holds: lower-case, as the flows store a chosen one. */
const newHandle = () => `rh_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
/** The placeholder decision_actions_apply gives: the prefix and the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the measure's id as text. */
const placeholderOf = (actionId: string) => `retired_${createHash("sha256").update(actionId, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 12)}`;

/**
 * The retirement of a handle and its reversal through the routes (3e design, sections 6.2, 7.10 and 7.11; section 12.1,
 * invariant 15 and row 24 for a retirement). Each decision is confirmed as the console confirms one, with a staff key on
 * the software authenticator, and recorded by the moderation module's own decide and review, which the staff routes
 * run. The handle change and onboarding are the social module's flow and the profile store, on the API's pool, so a
 * refusal is the one a person meets; a write that skips them is made as korbat_api, which the trigger refuses. What the
 * file commits is removed in the end, and its last test holds it to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the retirement of a handle and its reversal", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let s: SocialHarness;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let reviewer: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** The profiles this file made, removed with everything they hold at the end. */
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    s = socialHarness(apiDb);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    reviewer = await world.staff("moderator");
    // Read once the staff profiles exist: the world removes them when it closes, after the last test.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 240_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }
  }, 240_000);

  const store = () => createProfileStore(apiDb);
  async function account() {
    const profile = await newProfile(apiDb);
    made.push(profile.id);
    return profile;
  }
  /** The account's case, opened by a signed-in report under R4 that names it by this handle: the case and the report. */
  async function reportedAccount(subjectId: string, named: string) {
    const reporter = await account();
    const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R4"), anAccount(subjectId, named));
    return { caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, intakeId: recorded.intakeId };
  }
  /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id. */
  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  /** A final retirement under R4 by the moderator, with what else the decision holds. */
  const retire = (caseId: string, also: DecisionInput["actions"] = [], more: Partial<DecisionInput> = {}) =>
    decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("retire_handle"), ...(also ?? [])], ...more });
  const profileRow = async (id: string) =>
    (await apiDb.execute<{ handle: string; display_name: string; handle_changed_at: string | null }>(sql`select handle, display_name, handle_changed_at::text from profiles where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  const historyRow = async (handle: string) =>
    (await apiDb.execute<{ profile_id: string; retired: boolean }>(sql`select profile_id, retired_at is not null as retired from handle_history where handle_lower = ${handle.toLowerCase()}`))[0] ?? null;
  const retirementRow = async (decisionId: string) => (await actionsOf(apiDb, decisionId)).find((a) => a.kind === "retire_handle")!;

  test("the routes take the retirement and its reversal now (7.1 item 2)", () => {
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("retire_handle")).toBe(true);
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("unretire_handle")).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting", "lift_suspension", "lift_reporting"] as const) expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has(kind), kind).toBe(false);
  });

  test("invariant 15: a retirement swaps the handle for the placeholder made from the measure's id and clears the change time; the handle is refused to everyone, its former holder included, and the new handle is chosen at once", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    // The account changed its handle once, so the ordinary wait would apply, and the handle it holds now has no row in
    // handle_history yet: the retirement writes it first.
    const judged = newHandle();
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: judged })).handle).toBe(judged);
    expect(await historyRow(judged)).toBeNull();
    const { caseId, intakeId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, judged);
    // A signed-in notice of illegal content about the same account joins the case: its sender is mailed the outcome.
    const noticer = await account();
    const notice = await intake(apiDb, ground.illegal(noticer.id), anAccount(subject.id, judged));
    expect(notice.items[0]!.caseId).toBe(caseId);
    const caseRead = () => world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(admin.session, caseId);
    expect((await caseRead()).standing).toMatchObject({ snapshotHandleRetired: false });
    const decisionId = await retire(caseId);
    const row = await retirementRow(decisionId);
    // The case answer names the handle on the retirement's row, and says that a retirement now would change nothing.
    const after = await caseRead();
    expect(after.decisions.find((d) => d.id === decisionId)!.actions).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "retire_handle", handle: judged, inForce: true, noEffect: null })]);
    expect(after.standing).toMatchObject({ snapshotHandleRetired: true });
    expect(row.no_effect).toBeNull();
    const placeholder = placeholderOf(row.id);
    expect(placeholder).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: placeholder, handle_changed_at: null });
    expect(await historyRow(judged)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: true });
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: false });

    // Refused to everyone, its former holder included, by the flows' own check: handle_retired, 409.
    const stranger = await account();
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: judged }))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: judged.toUpperCase() }))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: judged, displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: judged.toUpperCase(), displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    // The placeholder's prefix is reserved in the handle rule: handle_reserved, 400.
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: placeholder }))).toBe("handle_reserved");
    // The repository and the store answer the trigger's codes where a caller skipped the handle rule.
    expect(await s.repo.changeHandle(stranger.id, "retired_0123456789ab", new Date())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_reserved" });
    expect(await s.repo.changeHandle(subject.id, judged, new Date())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: "retired_0123456789ab", displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_reserved" });
    // A direct write as korbat_api meets the trigger, for every role but the migrator.
    expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = ${judged} where id = ${stranger.id}::uuid`))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = 'retired_0123456789ab' where id = ${stranger.id}::uuid`))).toBe("handle_reserved");
    expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${judged.toUpperCase()}, 'Late')`))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect((await profileRow(stranger.id)).handle).toBe(stranger.handle);

    // The statement names the handle and the placeholder, and the end that fits the decision's own measures.
    const found = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, decisionId))!;
    expect(found.statement.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, handle: judged, placeholder }]);
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.retire(judged, placeholder, "at_once"));
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);

    // The reporter reads 3c's restricted outcome with the retired phrase in place of the display name's.
    await apiDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
    const [item] = await noticeItems(apiDb, intakeId);
    const status = await itemStatus(world.moderation.deps, item!);
    expect(status.scope).toBe("account_retired");
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(status)!.endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired}`)).toBe(true);
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(status)!.startsWith("access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R4")).toBe(true);
    // The notice's sender is mailed the same line by the dispatch job.
    const mailed = (await pendingOutcomeLines(apiDb)).find((line) => line.intakeId === notice.intakeId)!;
    expect(mailed).toMatchObject({ targetType: "account", retired: true });
    expect(updateLine(world.moderation.deps, mailed).outcome).toBe(itemOutcomeWords(status));

    // A new handle at once: the swap cleared the change time, so the change made minutes ago sets no wait.
    const next = newHandle();
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: next })).handle).toBe(next);
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle_changed_at).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("the retirement is stored first beside a reset of the display name, which then copies the placeholder; a retirement that is not its decision's first row is refused", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const { caseId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    // The signed list is in its one order, the reset first; the decide route inserts the retirement before it.
    const decisionId = await retire(caseId, [act("reset_display_name")]);
    const placeholder = placeholderOf((await retirementRow(decisionId)).id);
    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: placeholder, display_name: placeholder });
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, decisionId)).map((a) => [a.kind, a.no_effect])).toEqual([
      ["reset_display_name", null],
      ["retire_handle", null],
    ]);
    // Below the route, in the order of the list: the trigger refuses the retirement after the reset (invalid_decision).
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const other = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
      const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.finding(moderator.id, "R4"), anAccount(other.id, other.handle));
      const params = await decisionParams(tx, moderator, recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("reset_display_name"), act("retire_handle")] });
      const rows = (order: ("reset_display_name" | "retire_handle")[]) =>
        refusal(
          tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
            const id = randomUUID();
            await insertDecision(sp, { id, caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, decidedBy: moderator.id, params });
            for (const kind of order) await insertAction(sp, id, { kind, mediaId: null });
          }),
        );
      expect(await rows(["reset_display_name", "retire_handle"])).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await rows(["retire_handle", "reset_display_name"])).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("the reversal, while the profile holds the placeholder: a review of the appeal gives the handle back, clears the retirement and the change time", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const { caseId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    const decisionId = await retire(caseId);
    const placeholder = placeholderOf((await retirementRow(decisionId)).id);
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle).toBe(placeholder);
    await appealOf(apiDb, decisionId, subject.id);
    const outcome = await world.reviewAs(reviewer, decisionId, { outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("unretire_handle")] });
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the review was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: subject.handle, handle_changed_at: null });
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: false });
    // The review's statement names the handle given back.
    const found = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, outcome.decisionId))!;
    expect(found.statement.reversals).toEqual([{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, handle: subject.handle }]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(found.statement)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.unretired(subject.handle));
    // It is the account's again, and nobody else's.
    const stranger = await account();
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: subject.handle }))).toBe("handle_taken");
  });

  test("the reversal, once the holder moved on: a correction keeps the new handle, clears the change time, and the old handle can be taken back at once", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const { caseId, intakeId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    const decisionId = await retire(caseId);
    const moved = newHandle();
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: moved })).handle).toBe(moved);
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle_changed_at).not.toBeNull();
    const correction = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("unretire_handle")] });
    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: moved, handle_changed_at: null });
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: false });
    expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(apiDb, correction))!.statement)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.unretired(subject.handle));
    // Another account still cannot take it; its former holder takes it back at once, without the wait.
    const stranger = await account();
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: subject.handle }))).toBe("handle_taken");
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: subject.handle })).handle).toBe(subject.handle);
    // The reporter's line, once released, reads the reversal alone: never "korbat retired the handle" after it.
    await apiDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
    const [item] = await noticeItems(apiDb, intakeId);
    // Released after the correction, the item reads as reversed (item_current_outcome), and nothing follows the phrase.
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(await itemStatus(world.moderation.deps, item!))).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
  });

  test("no_effect: already when the snapshot's handle is retired, deleted for a deleted account; neither touches the profile", async () => {
    // Two reports in one open case, the second arriving before anything changed: one snapshot. The first retirement answers
    // only the first report, so the case stays open, and the second answers the other with the same snapshot.
    const subject = await account();
    const first = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    const second = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    expect(second.caseId).toBe(first.caseId);
    const retiring = await retire(first.caseId, [], { throughSeq: 1 });
    const placeholder = placeholderOf((await retirementRow(retiring)).id);
    const again = await retire(first.caseId);
    expect((await retirementRow(again)).no_effect).toBe("already");
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle).toBe(placeholder);
    const already = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, again))!.statement;
    expect(already.measures[0]).toMatchObject({ handle: subject.handle, noEffect: "already", placeholder: null });
    expect(statementParagraphs(already)[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireLead(subject.handle)} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireAlready}`);

    const gone = await account();
    const goneCase = await reportedAccount(gone.id, gone.handle);
    await apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone.id}::uuid`);
    const onDeleted = await retire(goneCase.caseId);
    expect((await retirementRow(onDeleted)).no_effect).toBe("deleted");
    expect((await profileRow(gone.id)).handle).toBe(gone.handle);
    expect(await historyRow(gone.handle)).toBeNull();
    expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(apiDb, onDeleted))!.statement)[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireLead(gone.handle)} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedAccount}`);
  });

  test("row 24: a retirement that cites R4 is final for months and never meets the R4 redaction: no candidate, no erasure, never counted as late", async () => {
    // The built text of the retention job and of the overview: REDACTABLE names exactly 3c's four kinds.
    const source = readFileSync(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../src/moderation/repo.ts"), "utf8");
    const redactable = source.slice(source.indexOf("const REDACTABLE = sql`"), source.indexOf("`;", source.indexOf("const REDACTABLE = sql`")));
    expect(redactable).toContain("m.kind in ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name')");
    const subject = await account();
    const decisionId = await retire((await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle)).caseId);
    const periods = { intakeDays: 30, statementMonths: 12, draftHours: 24, accessLogMonths: 12 };
    await rolledBack(world.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const late = (await lateErasures(tx, periods)).redactions;
      // Final for its author long ago, as only the migrator can make it here.
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = informed_at - interval '7 months', decided_at = decided_at - interval '7 months' where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
      const [final] = await tx.execute<{ final: boolean }>(sql`select public.decision_final_at(${decisionId}::uuid) < now() - interval '1 day' as final`);
      expect(final!.final).toBe(true);
      expect(await dueRedactions(tx)).not.toContain(decisionId);
      expect((await lateErasures(tx, periods)).redactions).toBe(late);
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${decisionId}::uuid)`)))).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
    // The handle stays retired: refusing it needs it (6.7).
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: true });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  }, 120_000);
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/standing.lab.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import type { StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../../src/auth";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { createSocialRepo, type HandleChangeResult } from "../../src/social/repo";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "../integration/moderation-decide";
import { act, anAccount, decisionParams, ground, intake, removeFixtures } from "../integration/moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "../integration/social-fixtures";

/**
 * The labs of account sanctions on the real code (3e design, section 12.3), run by hand as contention.lab.ts is, on a
 * quiet machine, with their numbers recorded in the report of the task that runs them. Task 2 creates the file with lab
 * E; each later task of 3e adds the labs of its own code.
 *
 * Lab E: the retiring decision against a handle change back to the judged handle. Each account had the handle a case's
 * snapshot judged, then changed it, so the judged handle is in its history and its own to take back. For the first half
 * of the accounts, a retirement through the decide route's own code (a real confirmation by a staff key, made ready
 * first) and the social repository's changeHandle back to the judged handle are fired together; the other half are only
 * retired. It passes when no account is left holding a retired handle: a change that came second is refused (the claim
 * statement, or the guard under a race), and one that came first gets the placeholder from the retirement's
 * compare-and-set. It records the retirements committed, the refusals, the race winners given the placeholder, the
 * decisions' times and how busy the machine was. What it commits is removed at the end, but the audit rows of its
 * confirmed decisions, which are the record (as every committed decision's are), and the staff accounts' rows in the
 * auth schema, as the integration suites leave theirs.
 *
 * From apps/api, with the scratch stack's data services up and the test database migrated:
 *
 *     node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.lab.config.ts test/lab/standing.lab.ts
 *
 * LAB_E_ACCOUNTS sets the number of accounts (60 unless set, as the design's LAB E); LAB_OUT the file of the lines.
 */

/** Where the measurements go, one line of JSON each: the file LAB_OUT names, or lab-standing.jsonl in the repository's .data folder (the lab runs from apps/api). */
const OUT = process.env.LAB_OUT ?? path.resolve(process.cwd(), "../../.data/lab-standing.jsonl");
function line(name: string, result: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  const text = JSON.stringify({ name, at: new Date().toISOString(), ...result });
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(OUT), { recursive: true });
  appendFileSync(OUT, text + String.fromCharCode(10));
  console.log(`LAB ${text}`);
}

/** The share of processor time that was not idle over this many milliseconds, across all cores: how loaded the machine is. */
async function busy(ms = 1500): Promise<number> {
  const read = () => os.cpus().reduce((sum, cpu) => ({ idle: sum.idle + cpu.times.idle, all: sum.all + cpu.times.user + cpu.times.nice + cpu.times.sys + cpu.times.irq + cpu.times.idle }), { idle: 0, all: 0 });
  const before = read();
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  const after = read();
  return Math.round((1 - (after.idle - before.idle) / Math.max(1, after.all - before.all)) * 100);
}

/** The value at a share of the sorted list, or null for none. */
const percentile = (sorted: readonly number[], share: number): number | null => (sorted.length === 0 ? null : sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(share * sorted.length))]!);

/** At most this many decisions of one staff account in an hour (0016's decision_cap, as moderation_limits holds it by default). */
const DECISIONS_PER_STAFF = 50;
/** How many races run at once. */
const BATCH = 6;

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("lab: the standing ledger on the real code", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(() => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 16 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }
  }, 600_000);

  test("lab E: retirements through the decide route against changes back to the judged handle leave no account holding a retired handle", async () => {
    const accounts = Number(process.env.LAB_E_ACCOUNTS ?? 60);
    const racing = Math.floor(accounts / 2);
    const repo = createSocialRepo(apiDb);
    const staff: RealStaff[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.ceil(accounts / DECISIONS_PER_STAFF); i++) staff.push(await world.staff("moderator"));

    // Each account: its case opened on the handle it holds (the snapshot judges that one), then a change to another, so
    // the judged handle is in its history; then a confirmation of its retirement, made ready before any race starts.
    type Prepared = { id: string; judged: string; member: RealStaff; confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed };
    const prepared: Prepared[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < accounts; i++) {
      const member = staff[Math.floor(i / DECISIONS_PER_STAFF)]!;
      const profile = await newProfile(apiDb);
      made.push(profile.id);
      const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.finding(member.id, "R4"), anAccount(profile.id, profile.handle));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      const moved = await repo.changeHandle(profile.id, `lab_${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`, new Date());
      if (!moved.ok) throw new Error(`lab E: the account could not leave its judged handle (${moved.reason})`);
      const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, member, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("retire_handle")] });
      prepared.push({ id: profile.id, judged: profile.handle, member, confirmed: await world.confirm(member, caseId, params) });
    }

    const busyPercent = await busy();
    const decisionMs: number[] = [];
    const counts = { retirements: 0, retirementsFailed: 0, changesRefusedRetired: 0, changesRefusedOther: 0, raceWinners: 0, raceWinnersGivenPlaceholder: 0, changeErrors: 0 };
    const started = performance.now();
    for (let from = 0; from < prepared.length; from += BATCH) {
      await Promise.all(
        prepared.slice(from, from + BATCH).map(async (account, offset) => {
          const index = from + offset;
          const retire = async () => {
            const start = performance.now();
            try {
              const outcome = await world.moderation.forStaff.decide(account.member.session, account.confirmed, { requestId: `lab-${randomUUID()}` });
              decisionMs.push(Math.round(performance.now() - start));
              if (typeof outcome === "string") counts.retirementsFailed++;
              else counts.retirements++;
            } catch {
              counts.retirementsFailed++;
            }
          };
          if (index >= racing) return retire();
          // A jitter of up to 25 ms on the change, so that each side wins some races.
          const change = async (): Promise<HandleChangeResult | "error"> => {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Math.floor(Math.random() * 25)));
            return repo.changeHandle(account.id, account.judged, new Date()).catch(() => "error" as const);
          };
          const [, changed] = await Promise.all([retire(), change()]);
          if (changed === "error") counts.changeErrors++;
          else if (changed.ok) counts.raceWinners++;
          else if (changed.reason === "handle_retired") counts.changesRefusedRetired++;
          else counts.changesRefusedOther++;
        }),
      );
    }
    const elapsedMs = Math.round(performance.now() - started);
    await world.moderation.settle();

    // The outcome: no lab account holds a handle whose row of handle_history is retired, and every race winner got the
    // placeholder of its retirement (the profile holds a handle of the placeholder's form).
    const ids = `{${prepared.map((account) => account.id).join(",")}}`;
    const [held] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(
      sql`select count(*)::int as n from profiles p where p.id = any(${ids}::uuid[]) and exists (select 1 from handle_history h where h.handle_lower = lower(p.handle) and h.retired_at is not null)`,
    );
    const onPlaceholder = await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from profiles where id = any(${ids}::uuid[]) and handle ~ '^retired_[0-9a-f]{12}$'`);
    counts.raceWinnersGivenPlaceholder = onPlaceholder.length;
    const retiredRows = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from handle_history where profile_id = any(${ids}::uuid[]) and retired_at is not null`);
    const sorted = [...decisionMs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    line("lab-E", {
      accounts,
      racing,
      ...counts,
      retiredHandles: retiredRows[0]!.n,
      profilesHoldingRetiredHandle: held!.n,
      decisionP50Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.5),
      decisionP95Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.95),
      elapsedMs,
      busyPercent,
    });
    expect(held!.n).toBe(0);
    expect(counts.retirements).toBe(accounts);
    expect(counts.changeErrors).toBe(0);
    // Every race ends one of two ways: the change was refused because the handle was retired, or it won and the
    // retirement then gave the profile its placeholder.
    expect(counts.changesRefusedRetired + counts.raceWinners).toBe(racing);
    expect(counts.raceWinnersGivenPlaceholder).toBe(counts.raceWinners);
  }, 1_800_000);
});
```

```ts
/**
 * An account's case that holds an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material and reaches images that are still
 * served: the seal and "Do not seal now" are offered on it. Its newest snapshot holds the account's fields as they read
 * now, so nothing asks for a fresh one.
 */
export function sealableCase(id: string, accountId: string): CaseView {
  const fields = { handle: "an_account", displayName: HOSTILE.quote, bio: LOOKALIKE.label };
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id,
    target: { type: "account", id: accountId, ...fields, deleted: false },
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 2, images: 3, sealed: 0, served: 3, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "5a5a5a5a"), targetId: accountId, authorHandle: fields.handle, ...fields }],
    // An item of its own, so that no two fixture cases hold the same one.
    items: base.items.map((each) => ({ ...each, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "6b6b6b6b") })),
    history: [],
  });
}

/**
 * A post's case as an admin meets it: a rule report, then a report of child sexual abuse material that nobody has
 * answered, then a second rule report. Its two images are still served and cannot be opened, and nothing was done while
 * deciding. Its items are its own, so that no two fixture cases hold the same one.
 */
export function adminCase(): CaseView {
  return frozenCase({
    id: CASE_ADMIN,
    intakeSeq: 3,
    decisions: [],
    sealsDeclined: [],
    history: [],
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    items: [
      item({ id: "e4c7d6c9-38f5-47c9-80d5-14b302f7e6d1", seq: 1, ruleId: "R1", lane: 2 }),
      item({ id: "e4c7d6c9-38f5-47c9-80d5-14b302f7e6d2", seq: 2, csam: true, suspect: true, allegesIllegal: true, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", lane: 0, explanation: null, source: SOURCES.anonymous }),
      item({ id: "e4c7d6c9-38f5-47c9-80d5-14b302f7e6d3", seq: 3, ruleId: "R6", lane: 2, explanation: null }),
    ],
  });
}

/** A post's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report and nothing else: no decision, no note, an item of its own. */
export function plainCase(id: string, itemId: string): CaseView {
  return postCase({ id, stateVersion: 1, intakeSeq: 1, items: [item({ id: itemId })], decisions: [], notes: [], history: [] });
}

/**
 * A closed case about a post whose final removal, by another staff member, its author appealed: the appeal waits, and
 * the reading person may review it. The appellant's statement is a string no page may run.
 */
export function appealedCase(): CaseView {
  const removal = decision({ id: DECISION_APPEALED, kind: "final", staffHandle: "mod_anna", throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1, facts: "The post offers followers for money.", reason: "That is spam.", actions: [{ ...decision().actions[0]!, id: "17fa09fc-6b28-4afc-b308-47e635ca1912", kind: "remove" }] });
  return postCase({
    id: CASE_APPEALED,
    answeredSeq: 2,
    closedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z",
    target: { type: "post", id: POST_ID, link: `http://localhost:8081/post/${POST_ID}`, authorHandle: HOSTILE.bidi, state: "removed", level: "removed" },
    items: [item({ outcome: "restricted_rule", answeredBy: DECISION_APPEALED })],

    notes: [],
  });
}

/**
 * 3e: an account's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report under R4 about its handle, unanswered, with a snapshot
 * whose handle is the one the profile holds now unless told otherwise, and the account's standing. `live` is the handle
 * the profile holds now; `snapped` the one the newest snapshot copied.
 */
export function retireCase(live = "Ada_L", snapped = "Ada_L", standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}): CaseView {
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_RETIRE,
    lane: 2,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: live, displayName: "Ada", bio: "", deleted: false },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, authorHandle: snapped, handle: snapped, displayName: "Ada", bio: "" }],
```

```tsx
/**
 * The decision composer (3c design, sections 7.5 and 8): what it offers to whom, the sentences it says beside each
 * choice, the params it builds from what the page shows, the preview, which is the statement exactly as its author will
 * get it, and the confirmation by the key. Its pure parts are tested as functions, its screen server-rendered.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
/** A text as React writes it into HTML. */
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;

const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const HEX = "cd".repeat(32);

/** The composer for a case as the page opens it, with the draft changed as a test says. */
function composer(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}, extra: Partial<ComposerViewProps> = {}) {
  const draft = { ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role), ...change };
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop, ...extra };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

/** A suspect case about a post: a rule report, then the suspect item, then a second rule report. */
function rangeCase(more: Partial<CaseView> = {}): CaseView {
  return frozenCase({
    intakeSeq: 3,
    answeredSeq: 0,
    decisions: [],
    sealsDeclined: [],
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    items: [
      item({ id: ITEM_NOTIFIER, seq: 1, ruleId: "R1", lane: 2, source: SOURCES.reporter }),

}

    expect(moderator).not.toContain(esc(COMPOSER.admin.unseen));
  });

  test("the range of an admin's answer: through the newest unanswered suspect item, not the newest item; the later reports stay open, and the page says so beside the composer, never in the preview", () => {
    const view = rangeCase();

    expect(out).toContain(STAYS);

  });
});

describe("the params the key confirms", () => {
  test("are built from what the page shows: the case's version, the snapshot it displayed with the digest computed here, the digests of the saved texts and the sorted actions", async () => {
    const view = postCase();
    const draft: CaseDraft = {
      ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR),
      kind: "final",
      ruleId: "R6",
      category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6,

        { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
        { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      ],
    };
    const shown = view.snapshots[0]!;
    if (shown.withheld) throw new Error("the fixture's newest snapshot shows its content");
    const digest = await shownSnapshotDigest(shown);
    // The console's own computation over the displayed members, not the digest the answer carried.
    expect(digest).toBe(await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, media: shown.media }));
    expect(digest).not.toBe(shown.digest);
    const params = decisionParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: digest, facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null });
    expect(params).toEqual({
      kind: "final",
      stateVersion: 3,
      throughSeq: 2,
      reviewsDecisionId: null,
      snapshotId: shown.id,
      snapshotDigest: digest,
      outcome: "restricted",
      ground: "incompatible",
      ruleId: "R6",
      rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
      redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
      category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD",
      categoryKeyword: null,
      actions: [
        { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
        { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
        // 3e: the case answer says a strike is due, so the console adds it; the person never chooses it.
        { kind: "strike", mediaId: null },
      ],
      factsDigest: "aa".repeat(32),
      reasonDigest: "bb".repeat(32),
      legalReferenceDigest: null,
      unfounded: [],
      replaced: false,
    });
    // A decision on the law names no rule, carries its reference's digest and, when ticked, the terrorist-content keyword.
    const law = decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, ground: "illegal", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", terrorist: true, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] }, { snapshot: digest, facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: "cc".repeat(32) });
    expect(law).toMatchObject({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", legalReferenceDigest: "cc".repeat(32) });
    // A no-action decision carries no ground, and its facts and its reason when they are written.
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, outcome: "no_violation", actions: [] }, { snapshot: digest, facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toMatchObject({ ground: null, ruleId: null, factsDigest: null, reasonDigest: null, actions: [] });
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, outcome: "no_violation", actions: [] }, { snapshot: digest, facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: "cc".repeat(32) })).toMatchObject({ ground: null, ruleId: null, factsDigest: "aa".repeat(32), reasonDigest: "bb".repeat(32), legalReferenceDigest: null });
    // What the contracts refuse is refused here, before any key is asked: a restriction without a measure's texts.
    expect(() => decisionParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: digest, facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toThrow();
  });

  test("the terrorist-content checkbox is offered only with the ground of the law", () => {
    const TERROR = "Terrorist content (Regulation (EU) 2021/784, Article 2(7))";
    expect(composer(postCase(), MODERATOR, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal" })).toContain(TERROR);
    expect(composer(postCase(), MODERATOR, { kind: "final", ground: "incompatible" })).not.toContain(TERROR);
  });

  test("the source the preview names is the one the database will record: a notice, a report or the moderator's own finding, from the items the decision considers", () => {
    expect(predictedSource(postCase(), "final")).toBe("notice");
    expect(predictedSource(postCase({ items: [item()], intakeSeq: 1 }), "final")).toBe("report");
    expect(predictedSource(postCase({ items: [item({ source: SOURCES.staff })], intakeSeq: 1 }), "interim")).toBe("own_initiative");
    // An answered notice is no longer considered.
    expect(predictedSource(postCase({ answeredSeq: 2, intakeSeq: 3, items: [item({ outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: "x" }), item({ id: ITEM_NOTIFIER, seq: 2, allegesIllegal: true, outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: "x", source: SOURCES.notifier }), item({ id: ITEM_FINDING, seq: 3, source: SOURCES.staff })] }), "final")).toBe("own_initiative");
  });
});

describe("the preview", () => {
  test("is the statement exactly as the author will receive it, from the drafts: the same function renders both", () => {
    const view = postCase();
    const draft: CaseDraft = {
      ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR),
      kind: "final",
      ruleId: "R6",
      category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6,
      actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }],
      written: { facts: "The post offers followers for money.", reason: "That is a deceptive scheme.", legal_reference: "", review_reason: "" },
    };
    const input = previewOf(view, draft, NOW);
    expect(input).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION, source: "notice", decidedAt: NOW.toISOString(), post: { createdAt: "2026-09-30T12:00:00.000Z" } });
    const out = composer(view, MODERATOR, draft);
    for (const paragraph of statementParagraphs(input)) expect(out, paragraph.slice(0, 50)).toContain(paragraph.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;"));
    expect(out).toContain("korbat removed your post of 2026-09-30 12:00 UTC: other people can no longer see it.");
    expect(out).toMatch(/<h4[^>]*>Preview: the statement as its author will receive it<\/h4>/);
    // A text someone could have copied in is only ever text.
    const hostile = composer(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, facts: "<script>alert(1)</script>" } });
    expect(hostile).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    expect(hostile).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(hrefs(hostile)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("says which measures taken while deciding end with a final decision: every one with the decision that closes the case, a seal with the admin's answer", () => {
    // The fixture's interim withhold is in force; a final decision through the newest item closes the case and ends it.
    const view = postCase();
    const closing = previewOf(view, { ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR), kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }, NOW);
    expect(closing.endedMeasures).toEqual([{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null }]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(closing)[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.ended(MEASURES.withhold.label));
    // A decision taken while deciding ends nothing.
    expect(previewOf(view, newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR), NOW).endedMeasures).toEqual([]);
    // The seal taken while deciding ends with the admin's answer, also when the case stays open; not when the answer seals for good.
    const sealedCase = rangeCase({ decisions: frozenCase().decisions });
    const answer = previewOf(sealedCase, { ...newDraft(caseId(sealedCase.id), sealedCase, ADMIN), kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }, NOW);
    expect(answer.endedMeasures.map((ended) => ended.kind)).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
    const forGood = previewOf(sealedCase, withSeal(sealedCase, { ...newDraft(caseId(sealedCase.id), sealedCase, ADMIN), kind: "final" }), NOW);
    expect(forGood.endedMeasures).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a final decision that leaves the case open may lift a withhold taken while deciding: Lift beside each", () => {
    const withheld = rangeCase({ decisions: [decision()] });
    expect(liftable(withheld)).toEqual([{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }]);
    const out = composer(withheld, ADMIN, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    expect(out).toContain(`Lift: ${MEASURES.withhold.label}`);
    // A decision that closes the case ends the withhold anyway, and one taken while deciding lifts nothing here.
    expect(composer(postCase(), MODERATOR, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" })).not.toContain("Lift: ");
    expect(composer(withheld, ADMIN, { kind: "interim" })).not.toContain("Lift: ");
  });
});

describe("lifting and correcting", () => {
  const sealAction = frozenCase().decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
  const interimSeal: CaseDecision = decision({ ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", suspect: true, actions: [sealAction] });
  const finalRemoval: CaseDecision = decision({ id: "9daebfc0-d1e2-43f4-9560-8b9cadbecfd0", kind: "final", throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1, actions: [{ ...decision().actions[0]!, kind: "remove" }] });

  test("beside each decision taken while deciding with a measure in force: Lift what was done while deciding, for anyone eligible", () => {
    const view = postCase();
    expect(correctable(view, view.decisions[0]!, MODERATOR)).toEqual({ label: "Lift what was done while deciding", measures: view.decisions[0]!.actions });
    expect(html(<CorrectControl view={view} decision={view.decisions[0]!} role={MODERATOR} disabled={false} onCorrect={noop} />)).toContain(">Lift what was done while deciding</button>");
    // A measure that is no longer in force leaves nothing to lift.
    const ended = decision({ actions: [{ ...decision().actions[0]!, inForce: false }] });
    expect(correctable(postCase({ decisions: [ended] }), ended, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    expect(html(<CorrectControl view={postCase({ decisions: [ended] })} decision={ended} role={ADMIN} disabled={false} onCorrect={noop} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("beside each final restriction with a measure in force: Correct this decision, for admins only where the decision needed one", () => {
    const view = postCase({ decisions: [finalRemoval] });
    expect(correctable(view, finalRemoval, MODERATOR)?.label).toBe("Correct this decision");
    const adminOnly = { ...finalRemoval, needsAdmin: true };
    expect(correctable(postCase({ decisions: [adminOnly] }), adminOnly, MODERATOR)).toBeNull();
    expect(correctable(postCase({ decisions: [adminOnly] }), adminOnly, ADMIN)?.label).toBe("Correct this decision");
    // A decision that restricted nothing, and a correction itself, are not corrected.
    const noAction = decision({ kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", actions: [] });
    expect(correctable(postCase({ decisions: [noAction] }), noAction, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("Lift the seal is offered to an admin only, inside the correction, with when a seal may be lifted", () => {
    const view = rangeCase({ decisions: [interimSeal] });
    // A moderator may lift what a decision did while deciding, but never its seal: with nothing else to lift, nothing is offered.
    expect(correctable(view, interimSeal, MODERATOR)).toBeNull();
    expect(correctable(view, interimSeal, ADMIN)?.measures.map((measure) => measure.kind)).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
    const draft = correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, interimSeal, ADMIN);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: interimSeal.id, actions: [] });
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] });
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.unseal_media.label);
    expect(out).toContain("Lift a seal taken while deciding only when it was taken in error: on the wrong case, or on a report that gives no reason to believe it.");
    // A seal for good: the sentence of the review composer on the reason.
    const forGood = { ...interimSeal, kind: "final" as const, needsAdmin: true, throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1 };
    const good = composer(rangeCase({ decisions: [forGood] }), ADMIN, { ...correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), rangeCase({ decisions: [forGood] }), forGood, ADMIN), actions: [{ kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] });
    expect(good).toContain(
      "A seal for good is lifted only on the authority's answer that the images are not child sexual abuse material. Say in the reason that the authority has answered, and the date of its answer. Never write its reference or anything that names a person: the reference stays in the operator's records, off the server.".replace(/'/g, "&#x27;"),
    );
    // A moderator's correction of a decision that holds a seal beside a withhold offers the withhold alone.
    const both = decision({ actions: [decision().actions[0]!, sealAction] });
    expect(correctable(rangeCase({ decisions: [both] }), both, MODERATOR)?.measures.map((measure) => measure.kind)).toEqual(["withhold"]);
  });

  test("a correction's params: reversals only, the corrected decision's category and rules version, its own reason, and reversed only when nothing of the decision stays in force", () => {
    const two = decision({ kind: "final", rulesVersion: 1, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD", throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1, actions: [{ ...decision().actions[0]!, kind: "remove" }, { ...decision().actions[0]!, id: "c0d1e2f3-0415-4627-8893-becfd0e1f203", kind: "remove_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }] });
    const view = postCase({ decisions: [two] });
    const draft = correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, two, MODERATOR);
    const part = decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }, { snapshot: HEX, facts: null, reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null });
    expect(part).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: two.id, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 1, redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD", categoryKeyword: null, factsDigest: null, legalReferenceDigest: null, reasonDigest: "bb".repeat(32), actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] });
    const all = decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }, { snapshot: HEX, facts: null, reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null });
    expect(all).toMatchObject({ outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }] });
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse(all).success).toBe(true);
    // The preview of a correction renders the corrected decision's rule from its own version.
    const preview = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }], written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "The post is satire." } }, NOW));
    expect(preview[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.corrected("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", true));
    expect(preview).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "${getRule("R1", 1)!.title}": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`);
    expect(preview).toContain("Why korbat changed it: The post is satire.");
  });
});

describe("the decision, confirmed by the key", () => {
  const view = postCase({ decisions: [] });
  const base: CaseDraft = { ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR), actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], written: { facts: "The post offers followers for money.", reason: "That is spam.", legal_reference: "", review_reason: "" } };
  const after = postCase({ stateVersion: 4, decisions: [decision()] });

  /** The whole exchange against a fake API: the saves, /me, the options (bound to whatever `bind` says), and the decision. */
  async function run(options: { bind?: (action: ReturnType<typeof decisionAction>) => ReturnType<typeof decisionAction> | object; decision?: { status: number; body: unknown }; view?: CaseView; draft?: CaseDraft } = {}) {
    const saves: { kind: string; text: string; salt: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    let action: ReturnType<typeof decisionAction> | null = null;
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: makeMe() },
      [`POST /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/decisions`]: options.decision ?? { status: 201, body: after },
      [`POST /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/snapshots`]: { status: 200, body: { id: "8c9daebf-c0d1-42e3-845f-7a8b9cadbecf", digest: HEX } },
      [`GET /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`]: { status: 200, body: view },
    });
    // The saves answer the digest that was sent, and the options bind the action the page sent, unless a test says otherwise.
    const fetch: typeof fake.fetch = async (input, init) => {
      const body = typeof init?.body === "string" ? (JSON.parse(init.body) as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined;
      if (input === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/texts` && init?.method === "POST") {
        await fake.fetch(input, init);
        saves.push(body as (typeof saves)[number]);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: "bfc0d1e2-f304-4516-b782-adbecfd0e1f2", digest: body!.digest }), { status: 201, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
      }
      if (input === "/api/staff/step-up/options") {
        await fake.fetch(input, init);
        action = body as ReturnType<typeof decisionAction>;
        const bound = options.bind ? options.bind(action) : action;
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(stepUpOptions(await stepUpChallenge(SESSION_HANDLE, bound as never))), { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
      }
      return fake.fetch(input, init);
    };
    const credentials = fakeCredentials();
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch, cookie: () => "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf=t" });
    const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api, credentials, random: (length) => new Uint8Array(length).fill(7) }, caseId(CASE_POST), options.view ?? view, options.draft ?? base);
    return { outcome, credentials, requests: fake.requests, saves, action: action as ReturnType<typeof decisionAction> | null };
  }

  test("the texts are saved first, the key confirms params built from the console's own digests, and the answer is the case as it now stands", async () => {
    const done = await run();
    expect(done.outcome).toEqual({ view: after });
    expect(done.credentials.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(done.saves.map((save) => save.kind)).toEqual(["facts", "reason"]);
    const salt = "07".repeat(32);
    const [facts, reason] = [await textDigest(salt, "The post offers followers for money."), await textDigest(salt, "That is spam.")];
    const shown = view.snapshots[0]!;
    if (shown.withheld) throw new Error("the fixture's newest snapshot shows its content");
    expect(done.action).toEqual({
      action: "case_decided",
      target: { type: "case", id: CASE_POST },
      params: decisionParamsOf(view, base, { snapshot: await shownSnapshotDigest(shown), facts, reason, legalReference: null }),
    });
    const sent = done.requests.at(-1)!;
    expect(`${sent.method} ${sent.url} ${sent.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`).toBe(`POST /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/decisions 1`);
    expect(sent.body).toMatchObject({ ...done.action!.params, stepUp: { type: "public-key" } });
    // Every request was the person's own.
    expect(done.requests.filter((request) => request.headers["x-staff-activity"] !== "1")).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("options that bind other params, another case or another action are refused before the key is asked, and no decision is sent", async () => {
    const binds: ((action: ReturnType<typeof decisionAction>) => object)[] = [
      (action) => ({ ...action, params: { ...action.params, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" } }),
      (action) => ({ ...action, params: { ...action.params, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] } }),
      (action) => ({ ...action, target: { type: "case", id: CASE_FROZEN } }),
      () => ({ action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: CASE_POST }, params: {} }),
    ];
    for (const bind of binds) {
      const done = await run({ bind });
      expect(done.outcome).toEqual({ error: new StepUpMismatch().message, code: "step_up_mismatch" });
      expect(done.credentials.calls).toEqual([]);
      expect(done.requests.some((request) => request.url.endsWith("/decisions"))).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a refusal is worded in the console's words, in place, and nothing is thrown: the draft is the caller's to keep", async () => {
    for (const code of ["case_changed", "profile_changed", "staff_recused", "staff_target", "admin_required", "decision_cap", "snapshot_mismatch", "snapshot_erased", "text_not_found", "invalid_decision"] as const) {
      const done = await run({ decision: { status: 409, body: envelope(code) } });
      expect(done.outcome, code).toEqual({ error: MODERATION_MESSAGES[code], code });
    }
  });

  test("a save answered with another digest ends the decision there: the key is never asked", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({ [`POST /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/texts`]: { status: 201, body: { id: "bfc0d1e2-f304-4516-b782-adbecfd0e1f2", digest: "ee".repeat(32) } } });
    const credentials = fakeCredentials();
    const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api: createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" }), credentials }, caseId(CASE_POST), view, base);
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_answer" });
    expect(credentials.calls).toEqual([]);
    expect(fake.requests.map((request) => request.url)).toEqual([`/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/texts`]);
  });

  test("a restriction without its facts or its reason, or a decision without a measure, is not sent at all", async () => {
    const empty = await run({ draft: { ...base, written: { ...base.written, facts: "  " } } });
    expect(empty.outcome).toEqual({ error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" });
    expect(empty.requests).toEqual([]);
    const bare = await run({ draft: { ...base, actions: [] } });
    expect(bare.outcome).toEqual({ error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" });
    expect(bare.requests).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a case whose newest snapshot is withheld gets a fresh one first, and the page shows it before anything is confirmed", async () => {
    const hidden = postCase({ decisions: [], snapshots: [{ id: "8c9daebf-c0d1-42e3-845f-7a8b9cadbecf", takenAt: "2026-10-01T08:00:00.000Z", digest: HEX, withheld: true }] });
    const done = await run({ view: hidden });
    expect(done.outcome).toEqual({ fresh: view, notice: COMPOSER.freshSnapshot });
    expect(done.credentials.calls).toEqual([]);
    expect(done.requests.map((request) => `${request.method} ${request.url}`)).toEqual([`POST /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/snapshots`, `GET /api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`]);
  });

  test("the action is the case with params of ids, enums, numbers and digests, and nothing typed", () => {
    const params = decisionParamsOf(view, base, { snapshot: HEX, facts: HEX, reason: HEX, legalReference: null });
    expect(decisionAction(CASE_POST, params)).toEqual({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: CASE_POST }, params });
    expect(() => decisionAction(CASE_POST.toUpperCase(), params)).toThrow();
    expect(() => decisionAction(CASE_POST, { ...params, facts: "free text" } as never)).toThrow();
    expect(typeof decideWithKey).toBe("function");
  });
});

describe("the fixtures of these tests", () => {
  test("are cases as the contracts describe them", () => {
    for (const view of [rangeCase(), sealableAccount(), postCase({ snapshots: [postSnapshot()] })]) expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success, view.id).toBe(true);
    expect([CASE_ACCOUNT, CASE_FROZEN].every((id) => parseCaseId(id) !== null)).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
```
