```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ProfileView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { SocialError } from "../../src/social/context";
import { HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS, PROFILE_EDITS_PER_HOUR, changeHandle, editProfile } from "../../src/social/flows/profile-edit";
import { DAY_MS, HOUR_MS } from "../../src/social/tiers";
import { profileHarness } from "./profile-harness";

const nobody = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009";

/** The SocialError a flow rejects with; anything else fails the test. */
async function failure(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<SocialError> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof SocialError) return err;
    throw err;
  }
  throw new Error("expected the flow to reject");
}

describe("profile editing", () => {
  test("updates the display name, the bio or both, records profile_updated without content, and returns the owner's view", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada");
    const named = await editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { displayName: "Ada Lovelace" });
    expect(ProfileView.parse(named)).toMatchObject({ id: ada.id, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada Lovelace", bio: "", verified: false, counts: { posts: 0, followers: 0, following: 0 } });
    expect(named.viewer).toBeUndefined();
    expect((await editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { bio: "Analytical engines." })).bio).toBe("Analytical engines.");
    const both = await editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { displayName: "Ada", bio: "" });
    expect([both.displayName, both.bio]).toEqual(["Ada", ""]);
    const stored = (await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(ada.id))!;
    expect([stored.displayName, stored.bio, stored.handle]).toEqual(["Ada", "", "ada"]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([
      { userId: ada.id, type: "profile_updated", metadata: undefined },
      { userId: ada.id, type: "profile_updated", metadata: undefined },
      { userId: ada.id, type: "profile_updated", metadata: undefined },
    ]);
  });

  test("allows 10 edits an hour per account, then rate_limited with a Retry-After until the window passes", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada");
    const bob = h.profile("bob");
    for (let i = 0; i < PROFILE_EDITS_PER_HOUR; i++) await editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { bio: `edit ${i}` });
    const err = await failure(editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { bio: "one too many" }));
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: HOUR_MS / 1000 });
    expect((await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(ada.id))!.bio).toBe("edit 9");
    expect((await editProfile(h.deps, bob.id, { bio: "bob's own window" })).bio).toBe("bob's own window");
    h.advance(HOUR_MS + 1);
    expect((await editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { bio: "next hour" })).bio).toBe("next hour");
    expect(h.events.filter((e) => e.userId === ada.id)).toHaveLength(PROFILE_EDITS_PER_HOUR + 1);
  });

  test("an edit with nothing in it is invalid_request, an unknown profile is not_found, and neither is recorded", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    expect(await failure(editProfile(h.deps, h.profile("ada").id, {}))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_request", status: 400 });
    expect(await failure(editProfile(h.deps, nobody, { bio: "x" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "not_found", status: 404 });
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("works without an events dependency, as the 2a tests run the module", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada");
    delete h.deps.events;
    expect((await editProfile(h.deps, ada.id, { bio: "quiet" })).bio).toBe("quiet");
    expect((await changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_two" })).handle).toBe("ada_two");
  });
});

describe("handle change", () => {
  test("lowercases the handle, checks its format and the reserved list, and refuses the current one", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada_l");
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ab" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_invalid", status: 400 });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "no-dashes" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_invalid", status: 400 });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "Admin" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_reserved", status: 400 });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ADA_L" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_request", status: 400 });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, nobody, { handle: "ghost" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "not_found", status: 404 });
    const stored = (await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(ada.id))!;
    expect([stored.handle, stored.handleChangedAt]).toEqual(["ada_l", null]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("moves the old handle into the history, stamps the change, records handle_changed with from and to, and returns the view", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada_l");

    expect(ProfileView.parse(view)).toMatchObject({ id: ada.id, handle: "ada_lovelace", displayName: "Profile ada_l" });
    expect(view.viewer).toBeUndefined();
    const stored = (await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(ada.id))!;
    expect(stored.handle).toBe("ada_lovelace");
    expect(stored.handleChangedAt).toEqual(h.now());
    expect(h.history.get("ada_l")).toBe(ada.id);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([{ userId: ada.id, type: "handle_changed", metadata: { from: "ada_l", to: "ada_lovelace" } }]);
  });

  test("a handle another profile holds, in any case, or ever held is handle_taken; the profile itself may go back to its own", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada_l");
    const bob = h.profile("bob_b");
    await changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_lovelace" });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, bob.id, { handle: "ADA_LOVELACE" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_taken", status: 409 });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, bob.id, { handle: "ada_l" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_taken", status: 409 });
    expect((await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(bob.id))!.handle).toBe("bob_b");
    h.advance(HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS);
    expect((await changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_l" })).handle).toBe("ada_l");
    expect(h.history.get("ada_lovelace")).toBe(ada.id);
    expect(h.history.get("ada_l")).toBe(ada.id);
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.metadata)).toEqual([
      { from: "ada_l", to: "ada_lovelace" },
      { from: "ada_lovelace", to: "ada_l" },
    ]);
  });

  test("waits 30 days between changes, answering handle_cooldown with the seconds left as Retry-After", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();

    const atOnce = await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_three" }));
    expect(atOnce).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_cooldown", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS / 1000 });
    h.advance(10 * DAY_MS);
    expect((await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_three" }))).retryAfterSeconds).toBe((20 * DAY_MS) / 1000);
    h.advance(20 * DAY_MS - 500);
    expect((await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_three" }))).retryAfterSeconds).toBe(1);
    h.advance(500);
    expect((await changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_three" })).handle).toBe("ada_three");
    expect((await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(ada.id))!.handleChangedAt).toEqual(h.now());
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.metadata)).toEqual([
      { from: "ada_l", to: "ada_two" },
      { from: "ada_two", to: "ada_three" },

  test("3e: a retired handle is handle_retired (409) for its former holder and for anyone else; a handle with the placeholder prefix is handle_reserved (400)", async () => {

    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_l" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_retired", status: 409, message: "That handle was retired by korbat. Nobody can use it." });
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, bob.id, { handle: "ADA_L" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_retired", status: 409 });
    for (const handle of ["retired_0a1b2c3d4e5f", "retired_bob"]) expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, bob.id, { handle })), handle).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_reserved", status: 400 });
    expect((await h.deps.repo.findProfileById(bob.id))!.handle).toBe("bob_b");
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.metadata)).toEqual([{ from: "ada_l", to: "ada_two" }]);
  });

  test("3e: the guard of handles refusing under a race answers with its code, as the claim statement would", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada_l");
    for (const reason of ["handle_retired", "handle_reserved"] as const) {
      const real = h.deps.repo.changeHandle;
      h.deps.repo.changeHandle = async () => ({ ok: false, reason });
      expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_new" })), reason).toMatchObject({ code: reason, status: reason === "handle_retired" ? 409 : 400 });
      h.deps.repo.changeHandle = real;
    }

  });

  test("3e: after a retirement swapped the handle for the placeholder and cleared the change time, the first change has no wait", async () => {
    const h = profileHarness();
    const ada = h.profile("ada_l");
    await changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_two" });
    // Minutes after a change, a retirement swaps the handle for the placeholder and clears the change time.
    h.retire(ada.id, "retired_0a1b2c3d4e5f");
    expect((await changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_three" })).handle).toBe("ada_three");
    // The ordinary wait applies again from that change on.
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_four" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_cooldown" });
    // The retired handle stays refused to its former holder.
    h.advance(HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS);
    expect(await failure(changeHandle(h.deps, ada.id, { handle: "ada_two" }))).toMatchObject({ code: "handle_retired" });
  });
});
```

### Replace `apps/api/test/social/profile-harness.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pino from "pino";
import type { AuthEventType } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { WITHOUT_MEDIA, type SocialDeps, type SocialEvents } from "../../src/social/context";
import type { HandleChangeResult, ProfileRow, SocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";

export interface RecordedEvent {
  userId: string;
  type: AuthEventType;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
}

/** An events dependency that keeps what the flows asked the auth module to record, instead of writing auth_events. */
export function recordingEvents(): SocialEvents & { recorded: RecordedEvent[] } {
  const recorded: RecordedEvent[] = [];
  return {
    recorded,
    async append(userId, type, metadata) {
      recorded.push({ userId, type, metadata });
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The profile-edit flows without a database: profiles by id, and the handle history as the real
 * table keeps it (one row per lowercase handle, owned by one profile for good). The repository fake
 * has only the three methods those flows call, checked against the real signatures; the limit store
 * is in memory; the clock moves only when a test says so, so timestamps compare exactly; and the
 * events fake records what the server would write to auth_events.
 */
export function profileHarness(start = 1_789_000_000_000) {
  let t = start;
  const rows = new Map<string, ProfileRow>();
  /** handle_history: the lowercase handle and the profile it belongs to. */
  const history = new Map<string, string>();
  /** 3e: the handles of the history that a retirement in the ledger keeps from everyone, their former holder included. */
  const retired = new Set<string>();
  const events = recordingEvents();
  const repo = {
    async findProfileById(id: string): Promise<ProfileRow | null> {
      const row = rows.get(id);
      return row ? { ...row } : null;
    },
    async updateProfile(id: string, patch: { displayName?: string; bio?: string }): Promise<boolean> {
      const row = rows.get(id);
      if (!row) return false;
      if (patch.displayName !== undefined) row.displayName = patch.displayName;
      if (patch.bio !== undefined) row.bio = patch.bio;
      return true;
    },
    async changeHandle(id: string, to: string, now: Date): Promise<HandleChangeResult> {
      const row = rows.get(id);
      if (!row) return { ok: false, reason: "not_found" };
      if (row.handle.toLowerCase() === to) return { ok: false, reason: "unchanged" };
      // As the real claim statement: a retired handle is refused before anything else, to its former holder too.
      if (retired.has(to)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" };
      const inUse = [...rows.values()].some((other) => other.id !== id && other.handle.toLowerCase() === to);
      if (inUse || (history.has(to) && history.get(to) !== id)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
      const from = row.handle;
      // As the real insert with "on conflict do nothing": a handle already in the history keeps its owner.
      if (!history.has(from.toLowerCase())) history.set(from.toLowerCase(), id);
      row.handle = to;
      row.handleChangedAt = now;
      return { ok: true, from };
    },
  } satisfies Pick<SocialRepo, "findProfileById" | "updateProfile" | "changeHandle">;
  const deps: SocialDeps = {
    repo: repo as unknown as SocialRepo,
    media: WITHOUT_MEDIA,
    limits: new MemoryStore(() => t),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now: () => new Date(t),
    events,
  };
  return {
    deps,
    events: events.recorded,
    history,
    retired,
    now: () => new Date(t),
    advance(ms: number) {
      t += ms;
    },
    /** 3e: what a retirement does to a profile that still holds the handle: the placeholder, and no change time. */
    retire(id: string, placeholder: string): void {
      const row = rows.get(id)!;
      retired.add(row.handle.toLowerCase());
      row.handle = placeholder;
      row.handleChangedAt = null;
    },
    /** A profile as onboarding leaves it: the handle chosen then is in the history. */
    profile(handle: string): ProfileRow {
      const id = randomUUID();
      const row: ProfileRow = { id, handle, displayName: `Profile ${handle}`, bio: "", verified: false, followerCount: 0, followingCount: 0, postCount: 0, createdAt: new Date(t), handleChangedAt: null };
      rows.set(id, row);
      history.set(handle.toLowerCase(), id);
      return row;
    },
  };
}
```

```tsx
    expect(client).toContain('contact: (ref: string, token: string, choice: "confirm" | "stop") => api("/api/notices/contact", { json: { ref, token, choice } })');
    // Before the fragment is read, and without one, the page says the link is no report's: it asks the API nothing.

    expect(textOf(html(<NoticePage />))).not.toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    // The page is outside the settings, whose layout would send a signed-out reader to sign in.
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "notice"))).toEqual(["[ref].tsx"]);
  });
});

describe("Cases, under Settings", () => {
  test("the settings row has Cases, whose screens live in a folder of their own inside the settings layout", () => {
    const out = html(<SettingsNav current="cases" />);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(["/settings/security", "/settings/privacy", "/settings/profile", "/settings/account", "/settings/cases"]);
    const current = (out.match(/<a\b[^>]*>/g) ?? []).filter((tag) => tag.includes('aria-current="page"'));
    expect(current).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(current[0]).toContain('href="/settings/cases"');
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain("Cases");
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "settings", "cases")).sort()).toEqual(["[id].tsx", "index.tsx"]);
    for (const file of ["index.tsx", "[id].tsx"]) expect(read("app", "settings", "cases", file), file).toContain('<SettingsNav current="cases" />');
    // Two tabs, and the list each shows.
    const screen = read("app", "settings", "cases", "index.tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain('accessibilityRole="tablist"');
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.cases(");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.reports(");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.resumeReportMail()");
  });

  const row = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow> = {}): AuthorCaseRow => ({
    id: id(3),
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    decidedOn: "2026-10-05",
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME },
    actions: ["remove"],
    endedInterim: false,
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("About you lists each decision with its day, what was done, the post's time, the rule or the law and where its appeal stands, each a link to its screen", () => {
    const rows = [
      row(),
      row({ id: id(4), kind: "interim", actions: ["seal_media", "withhold"], ruleId: null, legal: true, appealUntil: null }),
      row({ id: id(5), post: null, actions: ["reset_bio"], ruleId: "R6", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }),
      row({ id: id(6), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], endedInterim: true, ruleId: null, appealUntil: null }),
      row({ id: id(7), kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null }),
    ];
    const out = html(<DecisionsList decisions={rows} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(rows.map((one) => `/settings/cases/${one.id}`));
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.decidedOn("2026-10-05"))).toBe(5);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(TIME)));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.profile);
    // What was done, in the measures' own labels.
    for (const label of ["Remove", "Seal the images this case reaches", "Withhold the post", "Reset bio", "Lift the restriction of the post"]) expect(text, label).toContain(label);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.rule("R3"));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.law);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.ended);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.correction);
    expect(count(text, "You can appeal until")).toBe(1);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute("2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z")));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noDecisions);
  });

  test("the answer to an appeal that kept the decision reads as a kept decision, never as No action; a reversal by what it lifted", () => {
    const kept = row({ id: id(8), kind: "review", outcome: "kept", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const reversed = row({ id: id(9), kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const text = textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[kept, reversed, row()]} />));
    expect(CASES_WORDS.keptDecision).toBe("korbat kept its decision");
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.keptDecision)).toBe(1);
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
    expect(text).toContain(MEASURES.restore.label);
    // A final decision without a measure that ended nothing still reads No action.
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row({ id: id(10), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null })]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
  });

  const reports = (extra: Partial<ReportsPage> = {}): ReportsPage => ({
    reports: [
      { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ link: `${APP}/u/old_handle`, scope: "account", outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(21) }, { ...waiting, position: 2, id: id(22) }] },
      { ref: "N-BCDEFGH234", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ outcome: "not_evident", unseen: true, reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(23) }] },
    ],
    nextCursor: null,
    reportMailStopped: false,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("Your reports lists each report with its items as the status page words them: the account under the handle the report named, the outcome once released, and whether it can still be examined again", () => {
    const answer = reports();
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={answer} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    expect(text).toContain(`${APP}/u/old_handle`);
    expect(text).toContain(itemOutcomeWords(answer.reports[0]!.items[0]!)!);
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(UNTIL)));
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.waiting);
    expect(text).toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
    // Without a stop there is no notice and no button.
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(textOf(html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reports: [] })} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noReports);
  });

  test("when the account's address stopped korbat's report mails, the tab says so above the list, with the button that resumes them and what that also allows", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reportMailStopped: true })} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([CASES_WORDS.resume]);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.resumeHint);
    expect(text.indexOf(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("N-ABCDEFGH23"));
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain('resumeReportMail: () => api("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST" })');
  });
});

describe("a decision's screen", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final" as const,
    outcome: "restricted" as const,
    ground: "incompatible" as const,
    ruleId: "R3" as const,
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
    reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
    source: "report" as const,
    decidedAt: TIME,
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },
    measures: [{ kind: "remove" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
  };
  const image = (n: number) => ({ id: id(n), alt: `picture ${n}`, width: 800, height: 600, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
  const view = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}): DecisionView => ({
    id: id(3),
    ...statement,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    content: { kind: "post", body: "the words that were judged", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [image(7)], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: null },
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const screen = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}) => html(<DecisionDetail view={view(extra)} />);

  test("a final restriction: the statement as the mail rendered it, the post's time, the content it was made on, and Appeal with its deadline", () => {
    const out = screen();
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const paragraph of statementParagraphs(view())) expect(text).toContain(paragraph);
    expect(text).toContain(`"${getRule("R3", 2)!.title}"`);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
    expect(text).toContain("the words that were judged");
    // The image comes from the app's own image route, with its description.
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining(`/api/media/${id(7)}/small.webp`)]);
    expect(out).toContain('alt="picture 7"');
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appeal);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appealUntil("2027-04-04 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a decision taken while korbat decides: the interim redress, and no Appeal", () => {
    const interim = { kind: "interim" as const, measures: [{ kind: "withhold" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }], appealUntil: null };
    const text = textOf(screen(interim));
    expect(text).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.interim);
    // Neither the section nor its sentence: the interim redress never says the word.
    expect(text).not.toContain("Appeal");
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a restriction reversed in full says on which day, in place of Appeal", () => {
    const text = textOf(screen({ appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }));
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text: each sealed image is drawn as its placeholder, and nothing is loaded for it", () => {
    const sealed = {
      kind: "interim" as const,
      ruleId: "R2" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }],
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "post" as const, body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" as const },
    };
    const out = screen(sealed);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("text beside the images");
    expect(count(text, SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealPost("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC", 2));
  });

  test("a post its author deleted: korbat's copy of the text under its own heading, and its images kept and not shown", () => {
    const out = screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deleted);
    expect(text.indexOf(DECISION_WORDS.deleted)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("deleted since"));
    expect(count(text, DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages)).toBe(1);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    // A deleted post without images says nothing of images.
    expect(textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } }))).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages);
  });

  test("content korbat no longer holds: erased under the retention rules on its day, with the profile sentence only for a post its author kept; or erased by the R4 decision", () => {
    const kept = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: true } }));
    expect(kept).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06")} ${DECISION_WORDS.postKept}`);
    const gone = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: false } }));
    expect(gone).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06"));
    expect(gone).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.postKept);
    const redacted = textOf(screen({ ruleId: "R4", content: { kind: "r4_redacted" } }));
    expect(redacted).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted);
    expect(redacted).not.toContain("was erased on");
    // The post's time stays on the screen whatever became of the content.
    for (const text of [kept, gone, redacted]) expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, and links the decision that reset a field while its value is still kept", () => {
    const reset = {
      post: null,
      ruleId: "R6" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const text = textOf(screen(reset));
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.bio} what the bio said`);
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.displayName} Ada`);
    expect(text).not.toContain("Your post of");
    // A later decision that lifts the reset: its statement says where the old value can be read, and the screen links there.
    const lifted = {
      kind: "correction" as const,
      outcome: "reversed" as const,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      facts: null,
      post: null,
      measures: [],
      reversals: [{ kind: "restore_bio" as const, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: id(3), oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R6" as const }],
      reviewed: { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: TIME },
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const out = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKept);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    // Once the old value is gone, nothing links there.
    const erased = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted, reversals: [{ ...lifted.reversals[0]!, oldValueKept: false }] });
    expect(hrefs(erased)).not.toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
  });

  test("the screen asks for the decision by the id in its address and says when there is none for this account", () => {
    const source = read("app", "settings", "cases", "[id].tsx");
    expect(source).toContain("moderation.decision(id)");
    expect(source).toContain("DECISION_WORDS.notFound");
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain("decision: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/decisions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: DecisionView })");
  });
});

describe("the chips and the labels", () => {
  const post = (extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView => ({
    id: id(1),
    author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
    body: "my own post",
    createdAt: TIME,
    state: "removed",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const me = (userId: string) => ({ status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: userId, onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "ada" } } });
  const image = (n: number, moderation?: MediaView["moderation"]): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp`, ...(moderation ? { moderation } : {}) });

  test("the chip's four texts: under review or removed, under a rule or as illegal content", () => {
    expect(CHIP_WORDS).toEqual({ underReview: "Under review", removed: "Removed", illegal: "illegal content" });
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe("Under review: R4");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true })).toBe("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: "R3", interim: false })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false })).toBe("Removed: illegal content");
  });

  test("3e: a removed post's chip names its strike while the strike stands and counts, with the day it stops counting", () => {
    const until = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3" as const, legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: until };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe(`Removed: R3, strike until ${standingDay(until)}`);
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, strikeUntil: null })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = textOf(html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: decision })} />));
    expect(removed).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.chip("Removed: R3", until));
  });

  test("the author's own withheld or removed post shows the chip as a link to the decision's statement, amber while korbat decides and red once removed", () => {
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(removed)).toContain("Removed: R3");
    expect(hrefs(removed)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    const held = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: id(4), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(held)).toContain("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(hrefs(held)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(4)}`);
    // The colours are class names, which a render without the style compiler does not carry: they are read from the source.
    const card = read("components", "social", "PostCard.tsx");
    expect(card).toContain('const amber = decision ? decision.interim : post.state === "withheld";');
    expect(card).toContain('const surface = `self-start rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 ${amber ? "bg-amber-500/15" : "bg-red-500/15"}`;');
    // Without the decision's facts the chip still says the state, and links nowhere.
    const bare = html(<PostCard post={post()} />);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain("Removed");
    expect(hrefs(bare).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    // A post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place, without a chip: the post itself is visible.
    const sealedMedia: HiddenMedia[] = [{ id: id(21), hidden: true, sealed: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true, sealed: true }];
    const sealed = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: sealedMedia })} />);
    expect(textOf(sealed)).toContain("my own post");
    expect(count(textOf(sealed), SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(hrefs(sealed).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
    // Anyone else reads the placeholder of a hidden image for each of them.
    const others = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: [{ id: id(21), hidden: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true }] })} />);
    expect(count(textOf(others), HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(textOf(others)).not.toContain(SEALED_IMAGE);
  });

  test("the author's own withheld image says Under review on itself and a removed one Removed, in the post and in the viewer; anyone else gets one placeholder for both", () => {
    const own = html(<MediaGrid media={[image(1, "withheld"), image(2, "removed"), image(3)]} postId={id(1)} own />);
    const text = textOf(own);
    expect(count(text, "Under review")).toBe(1);
    expect(count(text, "Removed")).toBe(1);
    // The author still sees their own images.
    expect(loaded(own)).toHaveLength(3);
    const noop = () => undefined;
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(1, "withheld")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Under review");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(2, "removed")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Removed");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(3)]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
    // For anyone else the API sends the same hidden image for a withheld and a removed one: one placeholder, which does not say which.
    const hidden: HiddenMedia = { id: id(1), hidden: true };
    const others = textOf(html(<MediaGrid media={[hidden, { ...hidden, id: id(2) }]} postId={id(1)} />));
    expect(count(others, HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(others).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
  });
});

describe("3e: strikes on Cases and on the decision's screen (design, sections 9.2 and 9.4)", () => {
  const COUNTS = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
  const row = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow> = {}): AuthorCaseRow => ({
    id: id(3),
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    decidedOn: "2026-10-12",
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME },
    actions: ["remove", "strike"],
    endedInterim: false,
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    appealUntil: null,
    reversedOn: null,
    appeal: null,
    strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, overruledAt: null },
    ...extra,
  });
  const list = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow>, now = new Date("2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z")) => textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row(extra)]} now={now} />));

  test("the numbers of the sentences are STANDING_RULES', and a time names the device's minute and the UTC one", () => {
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(2)).toBe("Active strikes: 2 of 3. At 3, a moderator may announce a suspension; you would be told first and could reply.");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none).toBe("You have no active strikes.");
    expect(standingTime("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z").endsWith("(14:05 UTC)")).toBe(true);
    expect(standingTime("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z").startsWith(standingDay("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z"))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("Your standing stands above About you: the active strikes and what that many leads to, or that there are none", () => {
    expect(textOf(html(<StandingBlock activeStrikes={0} />))).toBe(`${STANDING_TEXTS.cases.title} ${STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none}`);
    expect(textOf(html(<StandingBlock activeStrikes={2} />))).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(2));
    const screen = read("app", "settings", "cases", "index.tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain("setActiveStrikes(page.activeStrikes)");
    expect(screen.indexOf("<StandingBlock")).toBeLessThan(screen.indexOf("<DecisionsList"));
  });

  test("a row names the strike after the post measure, with where it stands, and an overruling in its own words", () => {
    expect(list({})).toContain(`Remove, ${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.counts(COUNTS)})`);
    expect(list({}, new Date("2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z"))).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.expired})`);
    expect(list({ strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, overruledAt: "2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z" } })).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.overruled})`);
    expect(list({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["overrule", "restore"], strike: null })).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule}, ${MEASURES.restore.label}`);
  });

  test("the decision's screen says where its strike stands now, below the statement", () => {
    const view: DecisionView = {
      id: id(3),
      kind: "final",
      outcome: "restricted",
```

```ts
  const [decision, correction] = full.moderation.decisions;

  const withDecision = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [{ ...decision, ...change }], reports: [], strikes: [] });
  const withReport = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [{ ...report, ...change }], strikes: [] });
  const withItem = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReport({ items: [{ ...released, ...change }] });

    expect(withModeration({ reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [] })).toBe(false);

    for (const noEffect of ["already", "deleted", null]) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect }] }), String(noEffect)).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: "no" }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["restore", "unseal_media", "restore_media", "restore_display_name", "restore_bio"]) expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind, mediaId: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A text that is not held, or that the decision never had, is null, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toBe(true);
    for (const text of ["facts", "reason", "legalReference"]) expect(withDecision({ [text]: undefined }), text).toBe(false);

    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: "kept" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result: null } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "withdrawn", result: null } })).toBe(false);

    expect(parsed.moderation.decisions).toEqual([decision]);

    expect(withReport({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" })).toBe(true);
    // A report on the path for child sexual abuse material records no sender, so it is in nobody's export.
    expect(withReport({ ground: "csam" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: "R9" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // Read with its own members and no more.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], reports: [{ ...report, reporterId: id(1), contactId: id(23), lookupHash: "f".repeat(64), token: "secret" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports).toEqual([report]);

  test("an item carries its place in the report, its link and whether it is a re-examination; its outcome, the outcome's words and whether a re-examination is open come together, with the release, or not at all", () => {
    expect(withItem({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ items: [waiting] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ position: 21 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ link: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexamines: undefined })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withItem({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: false })).toBe(true);
    // Released, all three are told; before the release, none is.
    expect(withItem({ outcome: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ outcomeText: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, reexaminationOpen: false }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, outcomeText: "no action" }] })).toBe(false);
    // An item is read with its own members and no more: the list's id of an item is not part of the export.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], reports: [{ ...report, items: [{ ...released, id: id(24), caseId: id(25), answeredBy: id(26) }] }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports[0]!.items).toEqual([released]);

});
```

```ts
  EmailChangeResponse,
  EmailChangeStartRequest,
  EmailChangeVerifyRequest,
  EmailRevertRequest,
  EmailVerifyResponse,
  MeProfile,
  MeResponse,
  MfaVerifyRequest,
  OpaqueId,
  Phone,
  ReauthRequest,
  ReauthResponse,
  RecoveryCode,
  SessionInfo,
  SessionsResponse,
  SignupCompleteRequest,
  TotpDisableRequest,
} from "../src/index";

const flow = "a".repeat(43);
const userId = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

/** A minimal well-formed authentication assertion, for the passkey re-authentication variant. */
const reauthAssertion = {
  id: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  rawId: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  type: "public-key",
  response: { clientDataJSON: "A".repeat(200), authenticatorData: "A".repeat(50), signature: "A".repeat(96) },
  clientExtensionResults: {},
};

describe("auth primitives", () => {
  test("email is trimmed and lowercased, invalid rejected", () => {
    expect(Email.parse("  Alice@Example.COM ")).toBe("alice@example.com");
    expect(Email.safeParse("not-an-email").success).toBe(false);
    expect(Email.safeParse(`${"a".repeat(250)}@x.io`).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("opaque ids are exactly 43 base64url characters", () => {
    expect(OpaqueId.safeParse(flow).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OpaqueId.safeParse("a".repeat(42)).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OpaqueId.safeParse(`${"a".repeat(42)}=`).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("device ids are 22 to 64 url-safe characters", () => {
    expect(DeviceId.safeParse("x".repeat(22)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(DeviceId.safeParse("x".repeat(21)).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DeviceId.safeParse("x".repeat(65)).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("recovery codes are normalised to lowercase base32 groups", () => {
    expect(RecoveryCode.parse(" ABCD-EF23-GH45 ")).toBe("abcd-ef23-gh45");
    expect(RecoveryCode.safeParse("abcd-ef01-gh45").success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("display names reject control characters and more than 50 characters", () => {
    expect(DisplayName.parse("  Ada Lovelace ")).toBe("Ada Lovelace");
    expect(DisplayName.safeParse(`bad${String.fromCharCode(7)}name`).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DisplayName.safeParse("x".repeat(51)).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("phone numbers are E.164 once spaces, hyphens and parentheses are dropped", () => {
    expect(Phone.parse(" +44 7911 123-456 ")).toBe("+447911123456");
    expect(Phone.parse("+1 (415) 555-0132")).toBe("+14155550132");
    expect(Phone.parse("+1234567")).toBe("+1234567");
    expect(Phone.parse(`+${"9".repeat(15)}`)).toBe(`+${"9".repeat(15)}`);
    // No plus, a leading zero, too short, too long, letters, a plus in the middle.
    for (const bad of ["447911123456", "+0447911123456", "+123456", `+${"9".repeat(16)}`, "+44 7911 ext 12", "44+7911123456", ""]) {
      expect(Phone.safeParse(bad).success, bad).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

describe("auth requests and responses", () => {
  test("email verify response is discriminated by result", () => {
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.parse({ result: "signup_required" })).toEqual({ result: "signup_required" });
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.parse({ result: "mfa_required", mfaTicket: flow }).result).toBe("mfa_required");
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.safeParse({ result: "session" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.parse({ result: "session", mustReenrollMfa: false })).toEqual({ result: "session", mustReenrollMfa: false });
  });
  test("mfa verify takes exactly one of code or recoveryCode", () => {
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow, code: "123456" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow, recoveryCode: "abcd-ef23-gh45" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow, code: "123456", recoveryCode: "abcd-ef23-gh45" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("reauth accepts password, totp, email, recovery and passkey methods only", () => {
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "password", password: "x" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "totp", code: "000000" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "email", flowId: flow, code: "000000" }).success).toBe(true);
    // A recovery code (1c design, section 7.2), normalised as the MFA step normalises it.
    expect(ReauthRequest.parse({ method: "recovery", recoveryCode: " ABCD-EF23-GH45 " })).toEqual({ method: "recovery", recoveryCode: "abcd-ef23-gh45" });
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "recovery", recoveryCode: "abcd-ef01-gh45" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "recovery", code: "000000" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A passkey re-authentication carries an assertion (1c design, section 7.2); a registration is not one.
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "passkey", response: reauthAssertion }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "passkey" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "passkey", response: { ...reauthAssertion, response: {} } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "sms", code: "000000" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("the reauth answer carries the level reached, the rotated token for native clients and, after a recovery code, the re-enrolment flag", () => {
    expect(ReauthResponse.parse({ level: 1 })).toEqual({ level: 1 });
    expect(ReauthResponse.parse({ level: 2, token: "kb1_x", mustReenrollMfa: true })).toEqual({ level: 2, token: "kb1_x", mustReenrollMfa: true });
    expect(ReauthResponse.safeParse({ level: 3 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthResponse.safeParse({ level: "2" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthResponse.safeParse({ token: "kb1_x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("turning TOTP off takes an empty body: the re-authentication already spent the code, and a code sent anyway is dropped", () => {
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.parse({ code: "123456" })).toEqual({});
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.safeParse(null).success).toBe(false);
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.safeParse("code").success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("signup completion needs an ISO calendar date", () => {
    expect(SignupCompleteRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, dateOfBirth: "2008-02-29", termsVersion: "draft" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SignupCompleteRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, dateOfBirth: "29/02/2008", termsVersion: "draft" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("a listed session is named by its handle, a uuid that stays while its token rotates, and never by the token's hash", () => {
    const session = { id: userId, deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", platform: "web", createdAt: "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z", lastUsedAt: "2026-09-24T10:05:00.000Z", current: true };
    expect(SessionsResponse.parse({ sessions: [session, { ...session, id: "0b0e7c1a-5a53-4f0e-8a3f-2f6f8f5d9c11", platform: "ios", current: false }] }).sessions.map((s) => [s.id, s.current])).toEqual([
      [userId, true],
      ["0b0e7c1a-5a53-4f0e-8a3f-2f6f8f5d9c11", false],
    ]);
    // What the list carried before: sha256 of the token, which a rotation replaces, so a listed session could not be revoked after one.
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, id: "a".repeat(64) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, id: "not-a-uuid" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, id: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, platform: "desktop" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("me response carries email, the count of passkeys and a nullable profile", () => {
    const me = {
      user: { id: userId, email: "a@b.io", role: "user", onboarded: false, mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: false, passkeys: 0 },
      profile: null,
    };
    expect(MeResponse.parse(me)).toEqual(me);
    // The count decides whether the app offers a passkey re-authentication and the suggestion card (1c design, section 9), so it is never left out.
    expect(MeResponse.parse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: 3 } }).user.passkeys).toBe(3);
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: -1 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: 1.5 } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("the own profile in the me response says when the handle last changed, whether the badge is held and whether the account's posts show in Explore", () => {
    const user = { id: userId, email: "a@b.io", role: "user", onboarded: true, mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: false, passkeys: 0 };
    const profile = { id: userId, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", handleChangedAt: null, verified: false, showInExplore: true };
    expect(MeResponse.parse({ user, profile })).toEqual({ user, profile });
    expect(MeProfile.parse({ ...profile, handleChangedAt: "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z", verified: true }).verified).toBe(true);
    // The author's own switch (2c design, section 8), off as well as on.
    expect(MeProfile.parse({ ...profile, showInExplore: false }).showInExplore).toBe(false);
    // The three fields are facts the account and privacy screens rely on, so a profile without them is not a valid answer.
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ user, profile: { id: userId, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeProfile.safeParse({ ...profile, handleChangedAt: "yesterday" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeProfile.safeParse({ ...profile, verified: "yes" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeProfile.safeParse({ ...profile, showInExplore: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeProfile.safeParse({ ...profile, showInExplore: "on" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("every documented auth error code exists", () => {
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toHaveLength(35);
    // 3e (design, section 10.5): a handle korbat retired, refused to everyone, its former holder included.
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toContain("handle_retired");
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toContain("password_check_unavailable");
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["handle_cooldown", "email_in_use", "phone_in_use", "badge_unavailable", "verify_unavailable"]));
    // Passkeys (1c design, section 8).
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(["passkey_invalid", "passkey_unsupported", "passkey_limit", "passkey_suspended", "passkey_not_found", "challenge_expired"]),
    );
  });
});

describe("account lifecycle requests and responses", () => {
  test("an email change starts with an address under the sign-up rules and verifies with a flow id and code", () => {
    expect(EmailChangeStartRequest.parse({ email: " New@Example.COM " })).toEqual({ email: "new@example.com" });
    expect(EmailChangeStartRequest.safeParse({ email: "not-an-email" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailChangeStartRequest.safeParse({}).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailChangeVerifyRequest.parse({ flowId: flow, code: "123456" })).toEqual({ flowId: flow, code: "123456" });
    expect(EmailChangeVerifyRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "12345" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailChangeVerifyRequest.safeParse({ flowId: "short", code: "123456" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailChangeResponse.parse({ email: "new@example.com" })).toEqual({ email: "new@example.com" });
    expect(EmailChangeResponse.safeParse({ email: "nope" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("the undo link of an email change carries one opaque token", () => {
    expect(EmailRevertRequest.parse({ token: flow })).toEqual({ token: flow });
    expect(EmailRevertRequest.safeParse({ token: "a".repeat(42) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailRevertRequest.safeParse({ token: `${"a".repeat(42)}/` }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailRevertRequest.safeParse({}).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("the badge starts with a phone number and verifies with a flow id and a six-digit code", () => {
    expect(BadgeStartRequest.parse({ phone: "+44 7911 123456" })).toEqual({ phone: "+447911123456" });
    expect(BadgeStartRequest.safeParse({ phone: "07911123456" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(BadgeStartRequest.safeParse({}).success).toBe(false);
    expect(BadgeVerifyRequest.parse({ flowId: flow, code: "000000" })).toEqual({ flowId: flow, code: "000000" });
    expect(BadgeVerifyRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "abcdef" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(BadgeVerifyRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "0000000" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(BadgeVerifyResponse.parse({ verified: true })).toEqual({ verified: true });
    expect(BadgeVerifyResponse.safeParse({ verified: false }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("deletion starts with a flow id and is confirmed with the code and the typed handle", () => {
    expect(DeleteStartResponse.parse({ flowId: flow })).toEqual({ flowId: flow });
    expect(DeleteStartResponse.safeParse({ flowId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DeleteConfirmRequest.parse({ flowId: flow, code: "123456", handle: " Ada_Lovelace " })).toEqual({ flowId: flow, code: "123456", handle: "ada_lovelace" });
    expect(DeleteConfirmRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "123456" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DeleteConfirmRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "123456", handle: "" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DeleteConfirmRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, handle: "ada" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  CaseSnapshot,
  CaseDecisionAction,
  CaseView,
  FINDING_CATEGORIES,
  ErasureOverdue,
  FindingRequest,
  FindingResponse,
  IdentityRevealRequest,
  QUEUE_PAGE_SIZE,
  QueuePage,
  QueueQuery,
  RevealResponse,
  SOURCE_LABELS,
  STAFF_TEXT_KINDS,
  STAFF_TEXT_MAX,
  SourceSummary,
  StaffOverview,
  StaffSnapshotTaken,
  StaffTextSaveRequest,
  StaffTextSaved,
  StaffTextsResponse,
  TDB_CATEGORIES,
  reporterLabel,
  snapshotDigest,
  staffTextProblem,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * The console's requests and answers on cases (3c design, section 10): what a moderator's own finding may say, what a
 * saved text must be, and the shapes the queue, the case and the home screen are parsed with.
 */

const CASE = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const POST = "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36";
const OTHER = "5b0e4a52-3c1d-4f6e-9a8b-7c6d5e4f3a2b";
const HEX = "ab".repeat(32);
const TIME = "2026-10-04T08:15:30.123Z";
/** The seven members of 3e on a ledger row of 3c, where each is null. */
const NO_STANDING_COLUMNS = { days: null, announced: null, basis: null, restsOn: null, earliestStart: null, countsUntil: null, period: null, restedOnBy: null } as const;

describe("FindingRequest", () => {
  const finding = { target: { kind: "post", id: POST }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" };

  test("a moderator's finding cites a korbat rule, R2 among them, about a post, an account or a korbat link", () => {
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

  test("the answer names the case the finding opened or joined", () => {
    expect(FindingResponse.parse({ caseId: CASE })).toEqual({ caseId: CASE });
    expect(FindingResponse.safeParse({ caseId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

describe("a source's summary", () => {
  const reporter = { kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", accountAge: "1_to_12_months", itemsFiled: "2_to_9", actedOn: "under_half", answeredUnseen: "none", named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };

  test("names nobody: a letter given per case, bands instead of counts, and for a notifier what was given, never what", () => {
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse(reporter).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "notifier", label: SOURCE_LABELS.notifier, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["anonymous", "staff", "unlinked"] as const) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind, label: SOURCE_LABELS[kind], accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    }
    // Bands only: an exact count is no value of any of them.
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, itemsFiled: "7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, actedOn: "0.4" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, answeredUnseen: "3" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, accountAge: "3_days" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its label is one of the console's own: a reporter's letter or the fixed words of its kind, never a text an answer could choose", () => {
    expect(reporterLabel(0)).toBe("Reporter A");
    expect(reporterLabel(1)).toBe("Reporter B");
    expect(reporterLabel(25)).toBe("Reporter Z");
    expect(reporterLabel(26)).toBe("Reporter AA");
    expect(reporterLabel(27)).toBe("Reporter AB");
    expect(reporterLabel(26 + 26 * 26)).toBe("Reporter AAA");
    for (const label of ["korbat: verified notice from police", "Reporter a", "Reporter", "Reporter A ", "<b>Reporter A</b>", SOURCE_LABELS.staff]) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, label }).success, label).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "staff", label: "Reporter A" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

    };
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview).success).toBe(true);
    // Each of the three lists holds at most as many rows as the reveals' list does.
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, interimSeals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.interimSeals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, lanes: overview.lanes.slice(0, 2) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reveals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.reveals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("erasureOverdue is one count for each due rule of retention: all eight, each a whole number from 0", () => {
    const counts = { caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 1, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 3 };
    expect(ErasureOverdue.parse(counts)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(Object.keys(ErasureOverdue.shape).sort()).toEqual(["accessLog", "caseEvidence", "contacts", "drafts", "images", "intakeRecords", "redactions", "statements"]);
    for (const key of Object.keys(counts)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...missing } = counts as Record<string, number>;
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse(missing).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: -1 }).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: 1.5 }).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    // The overview carries it: an answer without it is refused, so a console never reads "nothing is late" from a missing member.
    const parsed = StaffOverview.safeParse({ lanes: [], erasureOverdue: counts });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape)).toContain("erasureOverdue");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE,
  ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE,
  ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE,
  CaseDecisionAction,
  CaseStanding,
  DecisionStrike,
  ITEM_OUTCOMES,
  NoticeItemStatus,
  OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  PERIOD_STATES,
  PostModeration,
  REPLY_TEXT_MAX,
  RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX,
  STANDING_BASES,
  STANDING_DAYS,
  STANDING_DRAFTS,
  STANDING_RULES,
  StatementMeasure,
  StatementReversal,
  UNFOUNDED_MAX,
  isRetiredPlaceholder,
  outcomeWords,
  type ItemOutcome,
} from "../src/index";

// Account sanctions (3e design, section 10.1): the constants every word of the console and the app is printed from. The
// database test (apps/api, standing-ledger.test.ts) holds STANDING_RULES to the SQL function standing_rules() name by name.

describe("STANDING_RULES", () => {
  test("holds the cautious defaults of the design, each one line to change", () => {
    expect(STANDING_RULES).toEqual({
      strikeDays: 90,
      ladderStrikes: 3,
      ladderDays: [3, 7, 30],
      ladderMemoryDays: 365,
      replyWindowHours: 168,
      undeliveredHours: 336,
      threatDays: 30,
      terroristDays: 30,
      floodDays: 7,
      protectiveDays: 14,
      floodPosts: 20,
      floodMinutes: 60,
      basisAgeDays: 30,
      reportFrameDays: 90,
      reportWarnMarks: 5,
      reportWarnShare: 0.5,
      reportRestrictMarks: 3,
      reportRestrictDays: 30,
    });
  });

  test("its numbers fit together: the undelivered window is twice the reply window, and no measure is longer than its days allow", () => {
    expect(STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours).toBe(2 * STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours);
    const longest = Math.max(...STANDING_RULES.ladderDays, STANDING_RULES.threatDays, STANDING_RULES.terroristDays, STANDING_RULES.floodDays, STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays, STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays);
    expect(longest).toBeLessThanOrEqual(STANDING_DAYS.max);
    expect(STANDING_DAYS).toEqual({ min: 1, max: 30 });
    // The rungs grow.
    expect([...STANDING_RULES.ladderDays].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual([...STANDING_RULES.ladderDays]);
  });
});

describe("the other constants of 3e", () => {
  test("the bases, the bounds of a reply and of a decision's marks, and the states of a period", () => {
    expect(STANDING_BASES).toEqual(["strikes", "threat", "terrorist", "flood", "protective", "threat_repeat", "ladder_end", "reports"]);
    expect(REPLY_TEXT_MAX).toBe(2000);
    expect(UNFOUNDED_MAX).toBe(100);
    expect(PERIOD_STATES).toEqual(["unfixed", "announced", "held", "running", "ended", "never", "lifted", "basis_ended"]);
  });

  test("the composer's drafts are W.5's ten texts, each placeholder one the case answer fills", () => {
    const texts = [...Object.values(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts), ...Object.values(STANDING_DRAFTS.reason)];
    expect(texts).toHaveLength(10);
    expect(Object.keys(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts)).toEqual(["strikes", "ladder_end", "threat", "terrorist", "threat_repeat", "flood", "protective", "warn", "restrict"]);
    expect(Object.keys(STANDING_DRAFTS.reason)).toEqual(["protective"]);
    const known = new Set(["activeStrikes", "n", "ladderMemoryDays", "day", "posts", "from", "to", "sealedOn", "frameDays", "readDay", "reports", "unfounded", "marked", "warnedOn", "marksSince"]);
    for (const text of texts) {
      for (const match of text.matchAll(/[{]([a-zA-Z]+)[}]/g)) expect(known.has(match[1]!), `${match[1]} in "${text}"`).toBe(true);
    }
    // A draft that holds a count says when it was counted: the key signs the text, the database counts at the commit.
    expect(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.strikes).toMatch(/^When this was written/);
    expect(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.ladder_end).toMatch(/^When this was written/);
    // Nothing of a protective suspension says or implies that the images are such material, or promises a later look.
    for (const text of [STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.protective, STANDING_DRAFTS.reason.protective]) {
      expect(text).not.toMatch(/nobody at korbat has seen|until an admin has looked/i);
    }
    expect(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.protective).toContain("korbat has not assessed them");
    expect(STANDING_DRAFTS.reason.protective).toContain("korbat makes no finding that this account broke the law or a korbat rule");
  });
});

describe("what the app reads of a strike", () => {

    const chip = { decisionId: "4a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false };

    expect(PostModeration.parse({ ...chip, strikeUntil: null }).strikeUntil).toBeNull();
    expect(PostModeration.safeParse(chip).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision's strike counts, ran out or was overruled; a statement's strike carries its end and how many counted then", () => {
    for (const state of ["counts", "expired", "overruled"] as const) expect(DecisionStrike.parse({ countsUntil: "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", state, overruledAt: null }).state).toBe(state);
    expect(DecisionStrike.safeParse({ countsUntil: "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", state: "paused", overruledAt: null }).success).toBe(false);
    const strike = { kind: "strike", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, endsAt: "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", activeThen: 2 };
    expect(StatementMeasure.parse(strike)).toEqual(strike);
    // 3c's measures carry neither, and parse as they did.
    expect(StatementMeasure.parse({ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null })).toEqual({ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null });
  });
});

describe("the retirement of a handle (3e design, sections 10.1, 10.2, 10.3 and W.1)", () => {
  test("a placeholder is the reserved prefix and 12 lower-case hex digits: a valid handle of 20 characters that nobody can choose", () => {
    expect(RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX).toBe("retired_");
    const placeholder = `${RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX}0a1b2c3d4e5f`;
    expect(placeholder).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(placeholder).toMatch(/^[a-z0-9_]{3,20}$/);
    expect(isRetiredPlaceholder(placeholder)).toBe(true);
    // The form only: upper-case or too few digits are no placeholder, nor is a handle that merely starts with the word.
    for (const other of ["retired_0A1B2C3D4E5F", "retired_0a1b2c3d4e5", "retired_0a1b2c3d4e5f0", "retired_ghijklmnopqr", "retiredada", "ada"]) expect(isRetiredPlaceholder(other), other).toBe(false);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE: two phrases, neither of which names a suspension, an access or a duration", () => {
    expect(ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE).toEqual({
      retired: "korbat retired the handle.",
      measure: "korbat took a measure on the account. It does not report here which, or for how long.",
    });
    for (const phrase of Object.values(ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE)) {
      expect(phrase).not.toMatch(/suspen|terminat|access|day|hour|week|until/i);
    }
  });

  const words = (outcome: ItemOutcome, scope: "account" | "account_retired" | "account_suspect") =>
    outcomeWords({ outcome, rule: outcome === "restricted_rule" ? { id: "R4", title: "No doxxing" } : null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope });

  test("a reporter's line for an item that a retirement answered carries the retired phrase in place of ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, after a restriction and nowhere else", () => {
    expect(NoticeItemStatus.shape.scope.unwrap().options).toEqual(["account", "quote", "account_suspect", "account_retired"]);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", "account_retired")).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R4 (No doxxing). ${ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", "account_retired")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.restricted_legal}. ${ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired}`);
    // A reversal's phrase stands alone: the handle given back is never followed by "korbat retired the handle".
    expect(words("reversed", "account_retired")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed", "account_retired")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, "account_retired"), outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE);
      expect(words(outcome, "account_retired"), outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
      for (const scope of ["account", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, scope), `${outcome} ${scope}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired);
    }
```
