 * The SQL of the retention job and of the overview's late erasures (3c design, sections 6.4, 7.3 and 7.9). Every time is
 * the database's own: each erase function checks its due rule against the database's now(), so the job asks with the same
 * clock, and one clock decides what is due. The periods are the contracts' RETENTION, handed over as numbers.
 *
 * The candidates are read from the partial indexes that hold only what is left to erase, so a round's work follows what
 * is left, never every case ever closed. The freeze is read here only to keep a case that holds nothing but snapshots of
 * a frozen post out of the candidates: for every snapshot the one function that erases one decides.
 */

/** The cases that hold a row erase_case_evidence would change: an unerased snapshot that is not of a frozen post, an unerased note or draft, an appeal statement, or an unreleased hold. */
const CANDIDATE_CASES = sql`
  select s.case_id from evidence_snapshots s where s.erased_at is null and not (s.target_type = 'post' and public.post_frozen(s.target_id))
  union select t.case_id from staff_texts t where t.confirmed_at is null and t.erased_at is null
  union select d.case_id from appeals a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id where a.statement is not null
  union select h.case_id from media_holds h where h.released_at is null`;

/** A final decision citing R4 that is not redacted yet and one of whose R4 measures is in force, as `d`. */
const REDACTABLE = sql`d.kind = 'final' and d.rule_id = 'R4' and d.redacted_at is null
  and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = d.id and m.kind in ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name'))`;

/** A decision one of whose statement texts is unerased, as `d`, joined to the profile `p` of its case's subject. */
const STATEMENT_HELD = sql`from decisions d
  join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
  join profiles p on p.id = case when c.target_type = 'account' then c.target_id else (select x.author_id from posts x where x.id = c.target_id) end
  where exists (select 1 from staff_texts t where t.digest in (d.facts_digest, d.reason_digest, d.legal_reference_digest) and t.erased_at is null)`;

/** The candidate cases whose evidence is due now, in id order. */
export async function dueCases(q: Runner): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`select k.case_id as id from (${CANDIDATE_CASES}) k where public.case_evidence_due_at(k.case_id) <= now() order by 1`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** The unerased intakes whose record is due now. None is due before `days` days after it was received, which the index is read by. */
export async function dueIntakes(q: Runner, days: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select n.id from intakes n where n.erased_at is null and n.received_at <= now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int) and public.intake_due_at(n.id) <= now() order by n.received_at, n.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** The R4 decisions that are final for their author and not redacted yet. The redaction itself answers false for one whose post is frozen. */
export async function dueRedactions(q: Runner): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`select d.id from decisions d where ${REDACTABLE} and public.decision_final_at(d.id) <= now() order by d.decided_at, d.id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** The decisions that still hold a statement text and whose subject's profile was deleted at least `months` months ago. */
export async function dueStatements(q: Runner, months: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`select d.id ${STATEMENT_HELD} and p.deleted_at <= now() - make_interval(months => ${months}::int) order by d.decided_at, d.id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

const changedBy = async (q: Runner, call: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<number> => (await rows<{ n: number }>(q, sql`select ${call} as n`))[0]!.n;

/** Deletes the drafts nobody confirmed that are older than `hours` hours; never a note, a recorded choice not to seal or a confirmed text. */
export const sweepStaffTexts = (q: Runner, hours: number) => changedBy(q, sql`public.sweep_staff_texts(now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours}::int))`);
/** Erases a due case's snapshots (never one of a frozen post), notes, drafts and appeal statements, and releases its holds. */
export const eraseCaseEvidence = (q: Runner, caseId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_case_evidence(${caseId}::uuid)`);
/** Erases a due intake's record: its explanation, its cited law, who sent it and its re-examinations' statements. */
export const eraseIntake = (q: Runner, intakeId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_intake(${intakeId}::uuid)`);
/** Erases the statement texts of a decision whose subject's account has been deleted for 12 months. */
export const eraseStatementTexts = (q: Runner, decisionId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_statement_texts(${decisionId}::uuid)`);
/** Deletes the access rows older than `months` months, erasing first the reveal reasons they name. */
export const deleteAccessLog = (q: Runner, months: number) => changedBy(q, sql`public.delete_access_log(now() - make_interval(months => ${months}::int))`);
/** Forgets that a deleted account sent its reports; 0 for an account whose auth row is not marked deleted. */
export const forgetReporter = (q: Runner, accountId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.forget_reporter(${accountId}::uuid)`);

/** Makes an R4 restriction's erasure final; false when it changed nothing (its post is frozen, or another round was faster). */
export async function redactR4(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await rows<{ done: boolean }>(q, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${decisionId}::uuid) as done`))[0]!.done;
}

/** The overview's late erasures that this module's tables answer: what each step should have changed more than a day ago. */
export interface LateErasures {
  caseEvidence: number;
  intakeRecords: number;
  statements: number;
  redactions: number;
  drafts: number;
  accessLog: number;
}

/**
 * How much each due rule is late by more than a day. A case that holds only snapshots of a frozen post is no candidate
 * and never counted, and a redaction whose post is frozen would change nothing now, so it is not counted either: both
 * wait for an admin's answer, not for the job.
 */
export async function lateErasures(q: Runner, periods: { intakeDays: number; statementMonths: number; draftHours: number; accessLogMonths: number }): Promise<LateErasures> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ case_evidence: number; intake_records: number; statements: number; redactions: number; drafts: number; access_log: number }>(
    q,
    sql`select
      (select count(*)::int from (${CANDIDATE_CASES}) k where public.case_evidence_due_at(k.case_id) < now() - interval '1 day') as case_evidence,
      (select count(*)::int from intakes n
        where n.erased_at is null and n.received_at <= now() - make_interval(days => ${periods.intakeDays}::int) and public.intake_due_at(n.id) < now() - interval '1 day') as intake_records,
      (select count(*)::int ${STATEMENT_HELD} and p.deleted_at < now() - make_interval(months => ${periods.statementMonths}::int) - interval '1 day') as statements,
      (select count(*)::int from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
        where ${REDACTABLE} and public.decision_final_at(d.id) < now() - interval '1 day'
          and not (c.target_type = 'post' and public.post_frozen(c.target_id))) as redactions,
      (select count(*)::int from staff_texts t
        where t.kind not in ('note', 'seal_declined') and t.confirmed_at is null and t.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => ${periods.draftHours}::int) - interval '1 day') as drafts,
      (select count(*)::int from case_access_log l where l.at < now() - make_interval(months => ${periods.accessLogMonths}::int) - interval '1 day') as access_log`,
  );
  return { caseEvidence: row!.case_evidence, intakeRecords: row!.intake_records, statements: row!.statements, redactions: row!.redactions, drafts: row!.drafts, accessLog: row!.access_log };
}

import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { iso, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries of account sanctions (3e design, sections 6.2 and 7.12): an account's standing as the views of the standing
 * ledger give it, the strike rule's answer for a post case, and the period of each standing measure. Every number comes
 * from the database's own standing_rules(), and every "now" is the database's clock, so the case answer reads what the
 * ledger's triggers would read at the same moment. Nothing here is stored: each answer is computed at the request.
 */

/** A UTC day of a timestamptz expression. The expression is written here, never input. */
const day = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')`);

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * What strike_due answers for a final restriction of this case on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests on no suspect
 * item (the rule passed is R1: strike_due asks only that it is not R2), and whether the case's post already carries a
 * strike that stands, which is the first of the two reasons it can answer false.
 */
export async function strikeDueOf(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select public.strike_due(${caseId}::uuid, 'incompatible', 'R1', false, null) as due,
               exists (select 1 from cases c
                         join cases x on x.target_type = 'post' and x.target_id = c.target_id
                         join decisions d on d.case_id = x.id
                         join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike'
                        where c.id = ${caseId}::uuid
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)) as struck`,
  );
  return { due: row?.due ?? false, struck: row?.struck ?? false };
}

/** An active strike of an account, as the case answer lists it. */
export interface StrikeRow {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  ruleId: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  countsUntil: string;
}

/** The facts an account's standing is built from, each read from the ledger's views at the database's clock. */
export interface StandingFacts {
  /** The active strikes, oldest first. */
  strikes: StrikeRow[];
  /** The rule of the newest active strike. */
  ladderRule: string | null;
  /** Whether a strike is newer than the newest measure of the ladder that stands, or there is none. */
  newStrikeSinceLadder: boolean;
  /** The suspensions of the ladder that stand, whose basis holds, decided in the last ladder_memory_days, and the day of the newest. */
  suspensionsInYear: number;
  lastSuspendedOn: string | null;
  /** The live standing measure (standing_live), with its kind and its period's state now; null when none. */
  live: { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean } | null;
  /** The account's posts of the last flood_minutes, and the interval they were counted in. */
  flood: { posts: number; from: string; to: string };
  /** The grounds of a measure at once whose facts hold now, by the rows of decision_actions_check's table. */
  threat: boolean;
  terrorist: boolean;
  threatRepeat: boolean;
  /** The day of the newest seal for good of the account's images that a protective suspension may rest on now. */
  sealOn: string | null;
}

/**
 * An account's standing: its active strikes, its ladder, its live measure, and the facts of the grounds of a measure at
 * once, read as the rows of decision_actions_check's table read them. An aid to the console: the database decides at the
 * commit, and a fact that moves between this read and the key is refused there.
 */
export async function standingFacts(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<StandingFacts> {
  const account = sql`${accountId}::uuid`;
  const strikes = await rows<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string; rule_id: string; decided_at: string; counts_until: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.decision_id, d.case_id, d.rule_id, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, ${iso("s.ends_at")} as counts_until
          from active_strikes s join decisions d on d.id = s.decision_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} order by s.created_at, s.action_id`,
  );
  const [ladder] = await rows<{ new_strike: boolean; in_year: number; last_on: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select coalesce((select max(s.created_at) from active_strikes s where s.account_id = ${account})
                          > (select max(a.created_at) from decision_actions a
                              where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.basis in ('strikes', 'ladder_end')
                                and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)), true) as new_strike,
               count(y.id)::int as in_year, max(${day("y.decided_at")}) as last_on
          from (select 1) one
          left join (select a.id, d.decided_at from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id cross join standing_rules() k
                      where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'strikes'
                        and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                        and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                        and d.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)) y on true`,
  );
  const [live] = await rows<{ kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, coalesce(p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp(), false) as running
          from standing_live s join decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = s.action_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} limit 1`,
  );
  const [grounds] = await rows<{ posts: number; from_at: string; to_at: string; threat: boolean; terrorist: boolean; threat_repeat: boolean; seal_on: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select (select count(*)::int from posts p where p.author_id = ${account} and p.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes)) as posts,
               ${iso("(now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes))")} as from_at, ${iso("now()")} as to_at,
               exists (select 1 from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                        where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as threat,
               exists (select 1 from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                        where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.ground = 'illegal' and x.category_keyword = 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT'
                          and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as terrorist,
               exists (select 1 from decision_actions a join decisions ad on ad.id = a.decision_id
                         join posts xp on xp.author_id = ${account} and xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
                         join cases xc on xc.target_type = 'post' and xc.target_id = xp.id
                         join decisions x on x.case_id = xc.id
                        where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'threat'
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                          and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                          and ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)
                          and x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as threat_repeat,
               (select ${day("x.decided_at")} from measures_in_force m join decisions x on x.id = m.decision_id
                 where m.kind = 'seal_media' and m.decision_kind = 'final' and m.subject_account_id = ${account}
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions p where p.kind = 'suspend' and p.basis = 'protective' and m.decision_id = any(p.rests_on))
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as seal_on
          from standing_rules() k`,
  );
  return {
    strikes: strikes.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.decision_id, caseId: row.case_id, ruleId: row.rule_id, decidedAt: row.decided_at, countsUntil: row.counts_until })),
    ladderRule: strikes.at(-1)?.rule_id ?? null,
    newStrikeSinceLadder: ladder!.new_strike,
    suspensionsInYear: ladder!.in_year,
    lastSuspendedOn: ladder!.last_on,
    live: live ? { kind: live.kind, running: live.running } : null,
    flood: { posts: grounds!.posts, from: grounds!.from_at, to: grounds!.to_at },
    threat: grounds!.threat,
    terrorist: grounds!.terrorist,
    threatRepeat: grounds!.threat_repeat,
    sealOn: grounds!.seal_on,
  };
}

/** Whether the case holds an unanswered item of a user's report: such a case holds the ladder's, the protective and the reporting measures back. */
export async function openReportsIn(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ open: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select exists (select 1 from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where i.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and i.answered_by is null and n.kind = 'user') as open`,
  );
  return row?.open ?? false;
}

/**
 * Whether the handle of the case's newest snapshot (the one a decision made now names) is retired: a retirement now would
 * change nothing (decision_actions_check step 10, no_effect `already`), which the composer says beside its control.
 */
export async function snapshotHandleRetired(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ retired: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select exists (select 1 from handle_history h
                         where h.retired_at is not null
                           and h.handle_lower = (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid order by s.taken_at desc, s.id desc limit 1)) as retired`,
  );
  return row?.retired ?? false;
}

/** A ledger row's columns of 3e, and for a standing measure where its period stands now. */
export interface StandingColumns {
  days: number | null;
  announced: boolean | null;
  basis: string | null;
  restsOn: string[] | null;
  earliestStart: string | null;
  countsUntil: string | null;
  period: { startsAt: string | null; endsAt: string | null; state: string } | null;
  /** On a strike: the kinds of the standing measures that rest on its decision and stand (not lifted, basis whole). */
  restedOnBy: string[] | null;
  /** On a retirement: the handle it retired, from its decision's snapshot in lower case (Task 2); null on every other kind. */
  handle: string | null;
}

/**
 * The columns of 3e of a case's ledger rows, by id: what the key signed (days, announced), what the trigger forced (the
 * basis, what it rests on, the earliest start, a strike's or a warning's end of counting) and, for a suspension or a
 * termination, its period as suspension_periods gives it with its state at the database's clock: lifted (before its
 * start: never), its basis broken, ended, running, announced (a start fixed and ahead), held by a reply filed on time,
 * or unfixed.
 */
export async function standingColumns(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<Map<string, StandingColumns>> {
  const found = await rows<{
    id: string;
    days: number | null;
    announced: boolean | null;
    basis: string | null;
    rests_on: string[] | null;
    earliest_start: string | null;
    counts_until: string | null;
    rested_on_by: string[] | null;
    handle: string | null;
    standing: boolean;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    state: string | null;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.id, a.days, a.announced, a.basis, a.rests_on::text[] as rests_on,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               case when a.kind in ('strike', 'warn_reporting') then ${iso("a.ends_at")} end as counts_until,
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then coalesce((
                 select array_agg(distinct m.kind::text order by m.kind::text) from decision_actions m
                  where m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
                    and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id)
                    and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) is null), '{}') end as rested_on_by,
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' then (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.id = d.snapshot_id) end as handle,
               a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') as standing,
               ${iso("p.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("p.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               case
                 when l.id is not null then case when p.starts_at is null then 'never' else 'lifted' end
                 when public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is not null then 'basis_ended'
                 when p.starts_at is not null and p.ends_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'ended'
                 when p.starts_at is not null and p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'running'
                 when p.starts_at is not null then 'announced'
                 when r.on_time and r.answered_by is null then 'held'
                 else 'unfixed'
               end as state
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = a.id
          left join decision_actions l on l.reverses_action_id = a.id
          left join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = a.id
         where d.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`,
  );
  return new Map(
    found.map((row) => [
      row.id,
      {
        days: row.days,
        announced: row.announced,
        basis: row.basis,
        restsOn: row.rests_on,
        earliestStart: row.earliest_start,
        countsUntil: row.counts_until,
        restedOnBy: row.rested_on_by,
        handle: row.handle,

import { STANDING_RULES, type AtOnceGround, type AuthorStanding, type CaseStanding, type StrikeDue } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { openReportsIn, snapshotHandleRetired, standingFacts, strikeDueOf, type StandingFacts } from "./standing-repo";
import type { Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * Account sanctions as the console reads them on a case (3e design, sections 7.4 and 10.3): on a post case whether a
 * final restriction gives a strike and the author's standing in bands, on an account case the account's standing with
 * what the database would accept now. Every member is an aid that lets a control say why it is greyed before the key is
 * asked; the database decides at the commit.
 */

/**
 * strikeDue of a post case: the database's strike_due for a final restriction on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests
 * on no suspect item, and why it answers false: the post already carries a strike that stands, or it was made before its
 * author was told of their newest strike (strike_due's third and fourth rules).
 */
export async function strikeDue(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<StrikeDue> {
  const answer = await strikeDueOf(q, caseId);
  if (answer.due) return { due: true, why: "due" };
  return { due: false, why: answer.struck ? "already_struck" : "before_last_strike" };
}

/** A count as the bands of the author's standing print it. */
const strikesBand = (n: number): AuthorStanding["activeStrikes"] => (n <= 0 ? "0" : n === 1 ? "1" : n === 2 ? "2" : "3_or_more");
const suspensionsBand = (n: number): AuthorStanding["suspensionsInYear"] => (n <= 0 ? "0" : n === 1 ? "1" : "2_or_more");

/** What the live standing measure of an account is now, in the words of the bands. */
function nowOf(facts: StandingFacts): AuthorStanding["now"] {
  if (facts.live === null) return "none";
  if (!facts.live.running) return "announced";
  return facts.live.kind === "terminate" ? "terminated" : "suspended";
}

/** authorStanding of a post case: the author's standing in bands, so that the moderator knows what a strike here leads to. */
export async function authorStanding(q: Runner, authorId: string): Promise<AuthorStanding> {
  const facts = await standingFacts(q, authorId);
  return { activeStrikes: strikesBand(facts.strikes.length), suspensionsInYear: suspensionsBand(facts.suspensionsInYear), now: nowOf(facts) };
}

/**
 * standing of an account case, read as decision_actions_check reads it. The ladder holds with at least ladderStrikes
 * active strikes of which one is newer than the account's newest measure of the ladder that stands; an announced
 * suspension then takes the rung of the suspensions of the ladder decided in the year, and a termination can be announced
 * after as many of them as there are rungs. While a standing measure is live nothing more can be taken (standing_conflict).
 */
export async function caseStanding(q: Runner, caseId: string, accountId: string): Promise<CaseStanding> {
  const facts = await standingFacts(q, accountId);
  const live = facts.live !== null;
  const rungs = STANDING_RULES.ladderDays;
  const ladder = !live && facts.strikes.length >= STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes && facts.newStrikeSinceLadder;
  const atOnce: AtOnceGround[] = [];
  if (!live) {
    if (facts.threat) atOnce.push("threat");
    if (facts.terrorist) atOnce.push("terrorist");
    if (facts.flood.posts >= STANDING_RULES.floodPosts) atOnce.push("flood");
    if (facts.sealOn !== null) atOnce.push("protective");
    if (facts.threatRepeat) atOnce.push("threat_repeat");
  }
  return {
    activeStrikes: facts.strikes.length,
    strikes: facts.strikes.map((strike) => ({ ...strike, ruleId: strike.ruleId as CaseStanding["strikes"][number]["ruleId"] })),
    ladderRule: facts.ladderRule as CaseStanding["ladderRule"],
    suspensionsInYear: facts.suspensionsInYear,
    lastSuspendedOn: facts.lastSuspendedOn,
    maxDays: ladder ? rungs[Math.min(facts.suspensionsInYear, rungs.length - 1)]! : null,
    mayTerminate: ladder && facts.suspensionsInYear >= rungs.length,
    live,
    openReports: await openReportsIn(q, caseId),
    atOnce,
    flood: facts.flood,
    seal: facts.sealOn === null ? null : { decidedOn: facts.sealOn },
    // Task 2: whether a retirement now would change nothing, the newest snapshot's handle being retired already.
    snapshotHandleRetired: await snapshotHandleRetired(q, caseId),
  };
}

import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ActionKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { iso, rows, type Runner, type TargetType } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries a statement of reasons is read from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10): the decision with its texts and the
 * decision it is about, its ledger rows, and the measures taken while deciding that ended with it. Every surface an
 * author reads a statement on (the decision's screen, the mail, the export, the answer to an appeal) is rendered from
 * these, so they are kept apart from the module's other queries: a test refuses the names of the tables of reports and
 * notices in this file, but for one pinned read in endedMeasures, which answers true or false of the case's own items.

/** A decision as its statement is rendered from it, with what the mail and the staff alerts need beside it. */
export interface StatementDecisionRow {

  postCreatedAt: string | null;

  /** The decision a review or a correction is about. */
  reviewed: { kind: "interim" | "final"; ground: string | null; ruleId: string | null; rulesVersion: number; legalReference: string | null; decidedAt: string } | null;

export async function statementDecision(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementDecisionRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.case_id, d.kind, d.outcome, d.ground, d.rule_id, d.rules_version, d.redress_version, d.source, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, d.suspect, d.author_mail, d.decided_by,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal_reference,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               case when c.target_type = 'post' then (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) else c.target_id end as subject_id,
               r.kind as reviewed_kind, r.ground as reviewed_ground, r.rule_id as reviewed_rule, r.rules_version as reviewed_rules_version, ${iso("r.decided_at")} as reviewed_at,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = r.legal_reference_digest) as reviewed_legal
          from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id left join decisions r on r.id = d.reviews_decision_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    caseId: row.case_id as string,
    kind: row.kind as StatementDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    ground: row.ground as string | null,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    rulesVersion: row.rules_version as number,
    redressVersion: row.redress_version as number,
    source: row.source as string,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at as string,
    suspect: row.suspect as boolean,
    authorMail: row.author_mail as string,
    decidedBy: row.decided_by as string,
    facts: row.facts as string | null,
    reason: row.reason as string | null,
    legalReference: row.legal_reference as string | null,
    targetType: row.target_type as TargetType,
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    postCreatedAt: row.post_created_at as string | null,
    subjectId: row.subject_id as string | null,

  };

/** One ledger row of a decision as its statement tells of it: for a reversal the measure it lifts, for a seal what its list held. */
export interface StatementActionRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null;
  /** For a reversal: the decision that holds the lifted measure, its rule, whether that measure changed anything, and whether korbat still kept that decision's snapshot when this one was made. */
  lifted: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean } | null;

  endsAt: string | null;

  announced: boolean | null;

}

/** A decision's measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds. */
export async function statementActions(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementActionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect, l.decision_id as lifted_decision, ld.rule_id as lifted_rule, l.no_effect as lifted_no_effect,

               (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_posts,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_images,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s join posts p on p.id = s.post_id
                 where s.action_id = a.id and p.state = 'deleted_by_author' and p.deleted_at <= a.created_at) as sealed_deleted,
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then ${iso("a.ends_at")} end as ends_at,
               -- What the ledger held at the decision's time, never later: a strike that counted then, and was not overruled by then.
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then (select count(*)::int from decision_actions s
                     where s.subject_account_id = a.subject_account_id and s.kind = 'strike' and s.created_at <= a.created_at and s.ends_at > a.created_at
                       and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = s.id and r.created_at <= a.created_at)) end as active_then,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then a.announced end as announced,
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' then (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.id = d.snapshot_id)
                    when a.kind = 'unretire_handle' then lower(ls.handle) end as handle,
               -- The placeholder exactly as decision_actions_apply computes it, for a retirement that wrote it.
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' and a.no_effect is null
                    then 'retired_' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12) end as placeholder
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join decision_actions l on l.id = a.reverses_action_id
          left join decisions ld on ld.id = l.decision_id
          left join evidence_snapshots ls on ls.id = ld.snapshot_id
         where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind as ActionKind,
    mediaId: row.media_id as string | null,
    noEffect: row.no_effect as StatementActionRow["noEffect"],
    lifted: row.lifted_decision === null ? null : { decisionId: row.lifted_decision as string, ruleId: row.lifted_rule as string | null, noEffect: row.lifted_no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.lifted_snapshot_kept as boolean },
    sealedPosts: row.sealed_posts as number,
    sealedImages: row.sealed_images as number,
    sealedDeletedImages: row.sealed_deleted as number,
    endsAt: row.ends_at as string | null,
    activeThen: row.active_then as number | null,
    announced: row.announced as boolean | null,
    handle: row.handle as string | null,
    placeholder: row.placeholder as string | null,
  }));
}

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with a final decision, without a reversal. */
export interface EndedMeasureRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  decisionId: string;
  ruleId: string | null;
  noEffect: string | null;
  snapshotKept: boolean;
}

/**
 * The measures taken while deciding that ended with this final decision, of those their author was told of: every one
 * that was still in force when the decision closed its case, and a seal taken while deciding whose suspect items the
 * decision answered, unless the decision itself seals (the images then stay sealed). It reads only what stood when the
 * decision was made: a reversal recorded later, or an item that arrived later, changes nothing here.
 */
export async function endedMeasures(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedMeasureRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, i.id as decision_id, i.rule_id, a.no_effect, (s.erased_at is null or s.erased_at > d.decided_at) as snapshot_kept
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join decisions i on i.case_id = d.case_id and i.kind = 'interim' and i.decided_at < d.decided_at and i.author_mail <> 'none'
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = i.id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = i.snapshot_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind = 'final'
           and a.kind in ('withhold', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id and r.created_at <= d.decided_at)
           and case when a.kind = 'seal_media'
                 then exists (select 1 from intake_items x where x.case_id = d.case_id and x.suspect and x.answered_by = d.id and x.created_at <= i.decided_at)
                      and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions own where own.decision_id = d.id and own.kind = 'seal_media')
                 else c.closed_at = d.decided_at end
         order by i.decided_at, a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind as ActionKind, mediaId: row.media_id as string | null, decisionId: row.decision_id as string, ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null, noEffect: row.no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.snapshot_kept as boolean }));
}

import { MEASURES, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind, type RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { DecisionMessage } from "../auth";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { beginMailRecord, lockPendingAuthorMail, recordAuthorMail, type MailState } from "./repo";
import { endedMeasures, statementActions, statementDecision, type StatementDecisionRow } from "./statement-repo";

/**
 * The data a statement of reasons and its mail are rendered from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10). A decision is the
 * statement: every element is a column, a ledger row or a saved text, read here into the one shape that @korbat/rules
 * renders for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview. Nothing read here is changed by a later event, so
 * a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 */

/** A decision's statement with what mailing it needs: whom it is about, and whether its mail is still owed. */
export interface StatementFound {
  statement: DecisionStatement;
  decision: StatementDecisionRow;
}

/** Whether a field reset's old value was still kept when the decision that ends or lifts it was made, and where it can be read. */
function resetFacts(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind, held: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean }) {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null };
  // The reset's own snapshot holds the old value, by its compare-and-set; a reset that changed nothing removed none.
  return { resetDecisionId: held.decisionId, oldValueKept: held.noEffect === null && held.snapshotKept, resetRuleId: held.ruleId as RuleId | null };
}

/** The statement's data of one decision, or null when no decision has the id. */
export async function decisionStatement(q: ModerationDeps["apiDb"], decisionId: string): Promise<StatementFound | null> {
  const decision = await statementDecision(q, decisionId);
  if (!decision) return null;
  const actions = await statementActions(q, decisionId);
  const ended = decision.kind === "final" ? await endedMeasures(q, decisionId) : [];
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that restricts (it holds a measure), with a correction and with a
  // review. Those of a decision without a measure are the case's record, for staff: such a decision tells its author at
  // most that what korbat did while deciding has ended, so the statement's data holds neither, and no mail, screen or
  // export that is rendered from it can carry them.
  const told = decision.kind === "correction" || decision.kind === "review" || actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  const statement: DecisionStatement = {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome as DecisionStatement["outcome"],
    ground: decision.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
    ruleId: decision.ruleId as RuleId | null,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: decision.legalReference,
    facts: told ? decision.facts : null,
    reason: told ? decision.reason : null,
    source: decision.source as DecisionStatement["source"],
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    post: decision.targetType === "post" && decision.postCreatedAt !== null ? { id: decision.targetId, createdAt: decision.postCreatedAt } : null,
    measures: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        noEffect: action.noEffect,
        sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: action.sealedPosts, images: action.sealedImages, deletedImages: action.sealedDeletedImages } : null,
        // 3e: what the ledger fixed for good about a strike, a standing measure and a retirement, so its statement reads as
        // it was sent (a retirement's sentence reads its end from whether the decision suspends or terminates at once).
        ...(action.kind === "strike" ? { endsAt: action.endsAt, activeThen: action.activeThen } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate" ? { announced: action.announced } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "retire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle, placeholder: action.placeholder } : {}),
      })),
    reversals: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as ReversalKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        ...(action.lifted === null ? { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } : resetFacts(action.kind, action.lifted)),
        // 3e: the handle a reversal of a retirement gives back.
        ...(action.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle } : {}),
      })),
    endedMeasures: ended.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, ...resetFacts(measure.kind, measure) })),
    reviewed:
      decision.reviewed === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: decision.reviewed.kind,
            ground: decision.reviewed.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
            ruleId: decision.reviewed.ruleId as RuleId | null,
            // The reviewed decision's own rulebook version: its rule is rendered as it was worded when that decision was made.
            rulesVersion: decision.reviewed.rulesVersion,
            legalReference: decision.reviewed.legalReference,
            decidedAt: decision.reviewed.decidedAt,
          },
  };
  return { statement, decision };
}

/**
 * The subject of the statement's mail, by the decision's kind and outcome (3c design, section 7.15), as a key of the mail
 * template's own table: a seal first, whatever else the decision holds; then a decision taken while deciding, on a post
 * or on an account; a final restriction; a final decision that restricts nothing but ends or lifts what was done while
 * deciding, and a correction of a decision taken while deciding; a reversal of a final decision; and a kept appeal.
 */
export function mailSubjectOf(statement: DecisionStatement): DecisionMessage["subject"] {
  const seals = statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media");
  const post = statement.post !== null;
  if (statement.kind === "interim") return seals ? "seal_deciding" : post ? "post_deciding" : "profile_deciding";
  if (statement.kind === "final") {
    if (seals) return "seal_final";
    if (statement.outcome === "restricted") return post ? "post_restricted" : "profile_restricted";
    return "lifted_deciding";
  }
  if (statement.kind === "correction") return statement.reviewed?.kind === "interim" ? "lifted_deciding" : "reversed";
  return statement.outcome === "kept" ? "appeal_kept" : "reversed";
}

/**
 * Mails a decision's statement to its author when that mail is still owed, and records what became of it: `sent`,
 * `no_address` for an account that is gone, `failed` when the relay refused the address for good. A failure of the relay
 * is thrown, and the mail stays pending for the dispatch job. Answers what was recorded, or "none" when nothing was owed.
 *
 * The decision's row is taken before the mail is sent, in the transaction that records the result (beginMailRecord): a
 * database that cannot write refuses that, and nothing is sent, so a mail is never sent again and again for want of a
 * record. Two senders of one statement (the decision's own request and the dispatch job) then send it once: the second
 * waits for the row and finds the mail recorded.
 */
export async function sendStatement(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth">, decisionId: string): Promise<MailState | "none"> {
  const found = await decisionStatement(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!found || found.decision.authorMail !== "pending") return "none";
  const subject = found.decision.subjectId;
  // The statement is rendered before anything is sent: one that cannot be rendered is no mail, and stays pending.
  const message: DecisionMessage = { template: "moderation_decision", subject: mailSubjectOf(found.statement), paragraphs: statementParagraphs(found.statement) };
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await beginMailRecord(tx);
    if (!(await lockPendingAuthorMail(tx, decisionId))) return "none";
    const result = subject === null ? "no_address" : await deps.auth.mailAccount(subject, message);
    // A stop of the address never holds a statement back, so "suppressed" is never answered for it.
    const state: MailState = result === "sent" ? "sent" : result === "refused" ? "failed" : "no_address";
    await recordAuthorMail(tx, decisionId, state);
    return state;
  });
}

import { and, eq, isNotNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import { handleHistory, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { handleRefusal, isUniqueViolation, type ProfileStore } from "../auth";

/**
 * Public profiles through the korbat_api pool. Onboarding writes the profile and the reservation of
 * its handle in one transaction; the unique index on lower(handle) and the primary key of
 * handle_history decide races and refuse a handle another profile holds or ever held. A handle korbat retired (3e) is
 * refused first, in the same transaction, with its own answer; the database's guard of handles refuses the same, and a
 * placeholder's form, under a race or to a caller that skipped the handle rule, and is answered alike.
 */
export function createProfileStore(apiDb: Db): ProfileStore {
  const columns = { id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle, displayName: profiles.displayName };
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      try {
        const profile = await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          // 3e: a retired handle is nobody's, so it is refused before the unique index would call it taken.
          const [retired] = await tx
            .select({ handle: handleHistory.handleLower })
            .from(handleHistory)
            .where(and(eq(handleHistory.handleLower, handle.toLowerCase()), isNotNull(handleHistory.retiredAt)))
            .limit(1);
          if (retired) return null;
          const [created] = await tx.insert(profiles).values({ id, handle, displayName }).returning(columns);
          // The handle chosen at onboarding is reserved like every later one (1b design, section 6); a row for it under another profile ends the transaction.
          await tx.insert(handleHistory).values({ handleLower: handle.toLowerCase(), profileId: id });
          return created!;
        });
        return profile === null ? { ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" } : { ok: true, profile };
      } catch (err) {
        const guarded = handleRefusal(err);
        if (guarded !== null) return { ok: false, reason: guarded };
        if (isUniqueViolation(err)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
        throw err;
      }
    },
    async find(id) {
      const [profile] = await apiDb
        .select({ ...columns, handleChangedAt: profiles.handleChangedAt, verifiedAt: profiles.verifiedAt, showInExplore: profiles.showInExplore })
        .from(profiles)
        .where(eq(profiles.id, id))
        .limit(1);
      if (!profile) return null;
      const { handleChangedAt, verifiedAt, showInExplore, ...pub } = profile;
      // The badge is a fact of the profile row (verified_at), read here so the account screen sees it on /me; so is the
      // author's Explore switch, which the privacy screen shows and the public profile never carries.
      return { ...pub, handleChangedAt: handleChangedAt?.toISOString() ?? null, verified: verifiedAt !== null, showInExplore };
    },
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      await apiDb.update(profiles).set({ verifiedAt: at }).where(eq(profiles.id, id));
    },
  };
}

import type { PostImage } from "../../media";
import { SocialError, type SocialDeps } from "../context";
import type { ExportKey, ExportPage, ExportedPostRow, HandleRefRow, PostRefRow } from "../repo";

/** An image on one of the exported posts, as the media module reports it; the account module names its file in the archive. */
export interface ExportedMedia {
  id: string;
  altText: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export type ExportedPost = ExportedPostRow & { media: ExportedMedia[] };

/**
 * The social module's part of the data export (1b design, section 7.5): the profile with every handle
 * it ever had and its Explore switch (2c design, section 8), every post it wrote whatever its state,
 * with its images, what it liked, reposted and bookmarked, and the accounts it follows, blocks and
 * mutes by the handle they have now. Times are Dates here; the account module writes them as ISO text.
 *
 * The profile is read at once; each list is read page by page while the account module writes it, so
 * an account with many rows never has them all in memory. A list can be iterated more than once; each
 * iteration reads it again from the start.
 */
export interface ProfileExport {
  /** `retiredHandles` (3e design, W.8): the handles of the history that korbat retired and that are still retired, with when. */
  profile: { handle: string; displayName: string; bio: string; createdAt: Date; handleHistory: string[]; showInExplore: boolean; retiredHandles: { handle: string; retiredAt: Date }[] };
  posts: AsyncIterable<ExportedPost[]>;
  likes: AsyncIterable<PostRefRow[]>;
  reposts: AsyncIterable<PostRefRow[]>;
  bookmarks: AsyncIterable<PostRefRow[]>;
  following: AsyncIterable<HandleRefRow[]>;
  blocks: AsyncIterable<HandleRefRow[]>;
  mutes: AsyncIterable<HandleRefRow[]>;
}

/** Rows per page of an export list: one statement each, and at most this many rows of a list in memory at once. */
export const EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE = 1_000;

/**
 * A list read in keyset pages, in (created_at, id) order: each page starts after the key of the last row
 * of the page before, and is read only once that page has been used. The walk ends at a page that is not
 * full.
 */
function paged<T>(read: (after: ExportKey | null) => Promise<ExportPage<T>>): AsyncIterable<T[]> {
  return {
    async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
      let after: ExportKey | null = null;
      do {
        const page: ExportPage<T> = await read(after);
        if (page.rows.length > 0) yield page.rows;
        after = page.next;
      } while (after !== null);
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Each page of posts with its images, fetched from the media module for that page's posts only. The author's own
 * withheld and removed images are listed like any other: they stay with their author. A sealed image is exported to
 * nobody, its author included, so the list does not name it (3c design, section 7.10), and the media module lists no
 * image of a deleted post and no erased image at all.
 */
function withMedia(deps: SocialDeps, pages: AsyncIterable<ExportedPostRow[]>): AsyncIterable<ExportedPost[]> {
  return {
    async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
      for await (const rows of pages) {
        const media: Map<string, PostImage[]> = await deps.media.forPosts(rows.map((post) => post.id));
        yield rows.map((post) => ({
          ...post,
          media: (media.get(post.id) ?? []).flatMap((image) => (image.state === "sealed" ? [] : [{ id: image.id, altText: image.alt, width: image.width, height: image.height }])),
        }));
      }
    },
  };
}

export async function exportProfile(deps: SocialDeps, userId: string, pageSize: number = EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE): Promise<ProfileExport> {
  const head = await deps.repo.exportHead(userId);
  if (!head) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);

  // handle_history holds the handle chosen at onboarding and every one later left behind, so the current handle
  // is there only when the account went back to one it had before; the list names every handle, the current one included.
  const handleHistory = [...head.handleHistory];
  const current = head.profile.handle.toLowerCase();
  if (!handleHistory.includes(current)) handleHistory.push(current);

  return {
    profile: {
      handle: head.profile.handle,
      displayName: head.profile.displayName,
      bio: head.profile.bio,
      createdAt: head.profile.createdAt,
      handleHistory,
      showInExplore: head.showInExplore,
      retiredHandles: head.retiredHandles,
    },
    posts: withMedia(
      deps,
      paged((after) => deps.repo.exportPosts(userId, after, pageSize)),
    ),
    likes: paged((after) => deps.repo.exportPostRefs(userId, "likes", after, pageSize)),
    reposts: paged((after) => deps.repo.exportPostRefs(userId, "reposts", after, pageSize)),
    bookmarks: paged((after) => deps.repo.exportPostRefs(userId, "bookmarks", after, pageSize)),
    following: paged((after) => deps.repo.exportHandleRefs(userId, "follows", after, pageSize)),
    blocks: paged((after) => deps.repo.exportHandleRefs(userId, "blocks", after, pageSize)),
    mutes: paged((after) => deps.repo.exportHandleRefs(userId, "mutes", after, pageSize)),
  };
}

import type { HandleChangeRequest, ProfileEditRequest, ProfileView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { checkHandle } from "../../auth";
import { SocialError, type SocialDeps } from "../context";
import { enforceAccountLimit } from "../limits";
import type { ProfileRow } from "../repo";
import { DAY_MS, HOUR_MS } from "../tiers";
import { profileView } from "./profiles";

/** A handle may change again this long after the last change (1b design, section 7.2). */
export const HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS = 30 * DAY_MS;
/** Edits of the display name or the bio an account may make in an hour. */
export const PROFILE_EDITS_PER_HOUR = 10;

/** The viewer's own profile row, which the edits below start from. A session always has one; a missing row means the account is gone. */
async function own(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string): Promise<ProfileRow> {
  const row = await deps.repo.findProfileById(viewer);
  if (!row) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  return row;
}

/** Sets the display name, the bio, or both, and answers with the profile as its owner sees it on the profile route. */
export async function editProfile(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, input: ProfileEditRequest): Promise<ProfileView> {
  // The contract refuses an empty edit; a caller that skipped it gets the same answer instead of an update with nothing to set.
  if (input.displayName === undefined && input.bio === undefined) throw new SocialError("invalid_request", 400, "Nothing to change.");
  await enforceAccountLimit(deps.limits, "profile-edit", viewer, PROFILE_EDITS_PER_HOUR, HOUR_MS);
  if (!(await deps.repo.updateProfile(viewer, input))) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  // The event says that the profile changed, not what it says now: the events table holds no content.
  await deps.events?.append(viewer, "profile_updated");
  return profileView(await own(deps, viewer));
}

/**
 * Moves the account to a new handle: the handle rules and the reserved list first, then the 30-day
 * cooldown, then the repository's transaction, which decides whether the handle is free. The handle
 * left behind stays reserved for this account, which may take it back after the next cooldown.
 *
 * 3e (design, section 7.10): a handle korbat retired is refused to everyone, its former holder included
 * (handle_retired, 409), and the placeholder's prefix is in the reserved list. A retirement clears the
 * change time when it swaps the handle, so the first change after it meets no cooldown.
 */
export async function changeHandle(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, input: HandleChangeRequest): Promise<ProfileView> {
  const to = input.handle.toLowerCase();
  const problem = checkHandle(to);
  if (problem) throw new SocialError(problem, 400);
  const current = await own(deps, viewer);
  if (current.handle.toLowerCase() === to) throw new SocialError("invalid_request", 400, "That is already your handle.");
  const now = deps.now();
  if (current.handleChangedAt) {
    const allowedAt = current.handleChangedAt.getTime() + HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS;
    // Retry-After says when the next change is allowed, in whole seconds and never zero.
    if (now.getTime() < allowedAt) throw new SocialError("handle_cooldown", 429, undefined, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((allowedAt - now.getTime()) / 1000)));
  }
  const result = await deps.repo.changeHandle(viewer, to, now);
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.reason === "handle_taken" || result.reason === "handle_retired") throw new SocialError(result.reason, 409);
    // The database's guard refused a placeholder's form that the handle rule let through: answered as that rule answers it.
    if (result.reason === "handle_reserved") throw new SocialError("handle_reserved", 400);
    // The row changed under us (a second request of the same account) and already holds this handle.
    if (result.reason === "unchanged") throw new SocialError("invalid_request", 400, "That is already your handle.");
    throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  }
  await deps.events?.append(viewer, "handle_changed", { from: result.from, to });
  return profileView(await own(deps, viewer));
}

  handle_changed_at: string | null;
}

/** A row of the Explore page statement: the page's facts on every row, and a post on each row but a lone one for an empty page. */
interface RawExplorePage {
  current: number | null;
  generation: number | null;
  as_of: string | null;
  after: number | null;
  post_id: string | null;
  position: number | null;
}

interface RawExploreFacts {
  author_id: string;
  reply: boolean;
  quote: boolean;
  visible: boolean;
  shown: boolean;
  outside_window: boolean;
  generation: number | null;
  as_of: string | null;
  holds_post: boolean;
  newer: boolean | null;
}

/** A timestamptz expression as ISO text with milliseconds, in UTC. The expression is a column reference written here, never input. */
const iso = (column: string): SQL => sql.raw(`to_char(${column} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')`);

/** The same with the microseconds a timestamp column holds, for the export's page keys, which must round-trip exactly. */
const isoMicro = (column: string): SQL => sql.raw(`to_char(${column} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')`);

/** Rows after `after` in (created_at, id) order: the keyset condition of an export page. Always true for the first page. */
const exportAfter = (after: ExportKey | null, at: SQL, id: SQL): SQL => (after ? sql`(${at}, ${id}) > (${after.at}::timestamptz, ${after.id}::uuid)` : sql`true`);

/** The page a query answered, with its next key when the page is full (a full page may be followed by more). */
function exportPage<R extends { key_at: string; key_id: string }, T>(raw: R[], limit: number, map: (row: R) => T): ExportPage<T> {
  const last = raw.at(-1);
  return { rows: raw.map(map), next: raw.length === limit && last ? { at: last.key_at, id: last.key_id } : null };
}

/** A list of ids as one parameter, split into a uuid array in SQL. */
const uuidArray = (ids: string[]): SQL => sql`string_to_array(${ids.join(",")}, ',')::uuid[]`;

const toPost = (r: RawPost): PostRow => ({
  id: r.id,
  authorId: r.author_id,
  body: r.body,
  replyToId: r.reply_to_id,
  quoteOfId: r.quote_of_id,
  state: r.state,
  likeCount: r.like_count,
  repostCount: r.repost_count,
  replyCount: r.reply_count,
  quoteCount: r.quote_count,
  createdAt: new Date(r.created_at),
  deletedAt: r.deleted_at ? new Date(r.deleted_at) : null,
  author: { id: r.author_id, handle: r.author_handle, displayName: r.author_display_name, verified: r.author_verified },
  replyToHandle: r.reply_to_handle,
  replyToAuthorId: r.reply_to_author_id,
  replyToState: r.reply_to_state,
});

const toListRow = (r: RawListRow): ListRow => ({ postId: r.post_id, sortAt: new Date(r.sort_at), reposterId: r.reposter_id });

const toProfileListRow = (r: RawProfileListRow): ProfileListRow => ({ profileId: r.profile_id, sortAt: new Date(r.sort_at) });

const toProfile = (r: RawProfile): ProfileRow => ({
  id: r.id,
  handle: r.handle,
  displayName: r.display_name,
  bio: r.bio,
  verified: r.verified,
  followerCount: r.follower_count,
  followingCount: r.following_count,
  postCount: r.post_count,
  createdAt: new Date(r.created_at),
  handleChangedAt: r.handle_changed_at ? new Date(r.handle_changed_at) : null,
});

/** `p` is the posts alias in every read below. */
const visibleTo = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`p.state = 'visible'`
    : sql`(p.state = 'visible' or (p.author_id = ${viewer}::uuid and p.state in ('withheld', 'removed')))`;

/** No block in either direction between the viewer and the author of `p`. */
const authorNotBlocked = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`true`
    : sql`not exists (select 1 from blocks b where (b.blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocked_id = p.author_id) or (b.blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocker_id = p.author_id))`;

/** No block in either direction with the author or the reposter of a timeline item `i`. */
const itemNotBlocked = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`true`
    : sql`not exists (select 1 from blocks b where (b.blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocked_id in (i.author_id, i.reposter_id)) or (b.blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocker_id in (i.author_id, i.reposter_id)))`;

const itemNotMuted = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null ? sql`true` : sql`not exists (select 1 from mutes m where m.muter_id = ${viewer}::uuid and m.muted_id in (i.author_id, i.reposter_id))`;

/** Raw queries take timestamps as ISO text, never as Date objects. */
const at = (cursor: Cursor): string => new Date(cursor.t).toISOString();

const before = (cursor: Cursor | undefined, sortAt: SQL, id: SQL): SQL =>
  cursor ? sql`(${sortAt}, ${id}) < (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid)` : sql`true`;

const after = (cursor: Cursor | undefined, sortAt: SQL, id: SQL): SQL =>
  cursor ? sql`(${sortAt}, ${id}) > (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid)` : sql`true`;

const beforeItem = (cursor: Cursor | undefined): SQL =>
  cursor
    ? sql`(i.sort_at, i.post_id, coalesce(i.reposter_id, ${NO_REPOSTER}::uuid)) < (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid, ${cursor.r ?? NO_REPOSTER}::uuid)`
    : sql`true`;

const POST_COLUMNS = sql`p.id, p.author_id, p.body, p.reply_to_id, p.quote_of_id, p.state, p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count, p.quote_count,
  ${iso("p.created_at")} as created_at, ${iso("p.deleted_at")} as deleted_at,
  a.handle as author_handle, a.display_name as author_display_name, (a.verified_at is not null) as author_verified,
  rp.handle as reply_to_handle, pp.author_id as reply_to_author_id, pp.state as reply_to_state`;
const POST_JOINS = sql`from posts p join profiles a on a.id = p.author_id left join posts pp on pp.id = p.reply_to_id left join profiles rp on rp.id = pp.author_id`;
const PROFILE_COLUMNS = sql`id, handle, display_name, bio, (verified_at is not null) as verified, follower_count, following_count, post_count, ${iso("created_at")} as created_at, ${iso("handle_changed_at")} as handle_changed_at`;
const PROFILE_SELECT = sql`select ${PROFILE_COLUMNS} from profiles`;

/** No block in either direction between the viewer and the account `other` names (a column reference). */
const otherNotBlocked = (viewer: string | null, other: SQL): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`true`
    : sql`not exists (select 1 from blocks b where (b.blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocked_id = ${other}) or (b.blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocker_id = ${other}))`;

/** The viewer neither blocks, is blocked by, nor mutes the account `other` names. */
const otherWelcome = (viewer: string, other: SQL): SQL =>
  sql`${otherNotBlocked(viewer, other)} and not exists (select 1 from mutes m where m.muter_id = ${viewer}::uuid and m.muted_id = ${other})`;

/** A keyset bound on the three sort columns of a timeline branch. */
const beforeTriple = (cursor: Cursor | undefined, sortAt: SQL, id: SQL, reposter: SQL): SQL =>
  cursor ? sql`(${sortAt}, ${id}, ${reposter}) < (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid, ${cursor.r ?? NO_REPOSTER}::uuid)` : sql`true`;

/** The outer select of a list query whose inner query `i` carries post_id, sort_at and reposter_id. */
const LIST_COLUMNS = sql`i.post_id, ${iso("i.sort_at")} as sort_at, i.reposter_id`;

/** Durations built in SQL from the formula's numbers, so each number travels as a parameter. */
const hours = (n: number): SQL => sql`(${n}::float8 * interval '1 hour')`;
const minutes = (n: number): SQL => sql`(${n}::float8 * interval '1 minute')`;

/**
 * The rules of one Explore formula as of one time (2c design, section 7), as SQL fragments. The refresh ranks with them
 * and the author's status judges one post with them, so the two cannot disagree; the time and every number of the formula
 * travel as parameters. `post` narrows the candidates and the engagement to one post, which the status reads through that
 * post's own indexes; the rules are the same either way.
 */
function exploreRules(asOf: Date, formula: ExploreFormula) {
  const at = sql`${asOf.toISOString()}::timestamptz`;
  // A candidate is younger than the window, and only engagement inside the window counts.
  const since = sql`${at} - ${hours(formula.windowHours)}`;
  // Engagement counts once it has stood this long, so a like made just before a round and undone after it never counts.
  const settled = sql`${at} - ${minutes(formula.standingMinutes)}`;
  const onePost = (column: SQL, post?: string): SQL => (post ? sql` and ${column} = ${post}::uuid` : sql.empty());
  /**
   * The one candidate predicate: visible top-level posts that are not quotes, by live authors who have not switched
   * Explore off, created in the window up to the time. Later rules about imports, suspension and restoration belong here.
   */
  const candidates = (post?: string): SQL => sql`
    select p.id, p.author_id, p.created_at from posts p join profiles a on a.id = p.author_id
    where p.reply_to_id is null and p.quote_of_id is null and p.state = 'visible' and p.created_at > ${since} and p.created_at <= ${at}
      and a.deleted_at is null and a.show_in_explore${onePost(sql`p.id`, post)}`;
  /**
   * The engagement that counts, read from the candidates `c`: likes and reposts in the window that have stood long enough,
   * by live accounts other than the author that were old enough when they engaged.
   */
  const engagement = (post?: string): SQL => sql`
    select x.post_id, x.user_id from (
      select post_id, user_id, created_at from likes where created_at > ${since} and created_at <= ${settled}${onePost(sql`post_id`, post)}
      union all
      select post_id, user_id, created_at from reposts where created_at > ${since} and created_at <= ${settled}${onePost(sql`post_id`, post)}
    ) x
    join c on c.id = x.post_id
    join profiles u on u.id = x.user_id
    where x.user_id <> c.author_id and u.deleted_at is null and u.created_at <= x.created_at - ${hours(formula.engagerMinAgeHours)}`;
  /** The approving accounts per post, read from the engagement `e`: each counted once however it engaged, for the posts that reach the threshold. */
  const approvers = sql`select post_id, count(distinct user_id)::int as approvers from e group by post_id having count(distinct user_id) >= ${formula.threshold}`;
  return {
    at,
    since,
    candidates,
    engagement,
    approvers,
    /**
     * Whether `post` is a candidate that reaches the threshold: the three fragments as the CTEs c, e and ap of a subquery
     * of their own, so one statement can ask at two times.
     */
    met: (post: string): SQL => sql`exists (with c as (${candidates(post)}), e as (${engagement(post)}), ap as (${approvers}) select 1 from ap)`,
  };
}

export function createSocialRepo(db: Db) {
  const rows = async <T>(query: SQL): Promise<T[]> => (await db.execute(query)) as unknown as T[];

  const bump = (column: SQLWrapper, delta: 1 | -1): SQL => (delta === 1 ? sql`${column} + 1` : sql`greatest(0, ${column} - 1)`);

  const profileList = async (query: SQL): Promise<ProfileListRow[]> => (await rows<RawProfileListRow>(query)).map(toProfileListRow);

  return {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------ posts

    /**
     * `within` runs in the same transaction once the post exists, which is how its images are attached.
     * `lockWith` names the author of the post replied to or quoted: the pair is locked and a block
     * between them refused inside the transaction, so a reply cannot land across a concurrent block.
     * The author's profile row is locked and a deleted one refused (not_found), and so is the row of the
     * author of the post replied to or quoted (post_unavailable, as for a post that is gone), so no post
     * lands behind a concurrent purge of either account (lockLive). A post that both replies and quotes writes two
     * other posts' counters: their rows are taken first, in id order, the order in which a report takes the posts it
     * copies (3c design, section 2, Lock order), so the new post never holds one of them while it waits for the other.
     */
    async createPost(input: {
      authorId: string;
      body: string;
      replyToId: string | null;
      quoteOfId: string | null;
      now: Date;
      lockWith?: string | null;
      within?: (tx: DbTx, postId: string) => Promise<void>;
    }): Promise<string> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (input.lockWith) await guardPair(tx, input.authorId, input.lockWith, "post_unavailable");
        await lockLive(tx, sql`id = ${input.authorId}::uuid`);
        if (input.replyToId || input.quoteOfId) {
          await lockLive(tx, sql`id in (select author_id from posts where id in (${input.replyToId}::uuid, ${input.quoteOfId}::uuid))`, "post_unavailable");
        }
        if (input.replyToId && input.quoteOfId) await lockPostsInOrder(tx, [input.replyToId, input.quoteOfId]);
        const [row] = await tx
          .insert(posts)
          .values({ authorId: input.authorId, body: input.body, replyToId: input.replyToId, quoteOfId: input.quoteOfId, createdAt: input.now })
          .returning({ id: posts.id });
        if (input.replyToId) {
          await tx.update(posts).set({ replyCount: bump(posts.replyCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, input.replyToId));
        } else {
          await tx.update(profiles).set({ postCount: bump(profiles.postCount, 1) }).where(eq(profiles.id, input.authorId));
        }
        if (input.quoteOfId) await tx.update(posts).set({ quoteCount: bump(posts.quoteCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, input.quoteOfId));
        await input.within?.(tx, row!.id);
        return row!.id;
      });
    },

    /**
     * Blanks the body and marks the post deleted; adjusts the counters it contributed to. False when there was nothing to
     * delete. `within` runs in the same transaction. The author's profile row is taken first, in the mode the counter
     * update below needs: a decision about the author holds that row before it takes the post, so a deletion that took
     * the post first and the profile second would deadlock with it, and one that takes the profile first waits its turn.
     * Then every post this transaction writes is taken, in id order, before any is written: the post itself and the post
     * it replies to or quotes, whose counter goes down. A report takes the posts it copies for share in that order (3c
     * design, section 2, Lock order), and one of child sexual abuse material about a quoting post reaches the quoted post
     * by itself: a deletion that wrote its own post first and then asked for a quoted post with a lower id would hold
     * what that report asks for next while it waits for what the report holds. The two ids never change, so a plain read
     * names the right rows; only the author's own post is read, so nobody else's request locks anything here.
     */
    async deletePost(id: string, authorId: string, now: Date, within?: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${authorId}::uuid for no key update`);
        const [own] = (await tx.execute(sql`select reply_to_id, quote_of_id from posts where id = ${id}::uuid and author_id = ${authorId}::uuid`)) as unknown as {
          reply_to_id: string | null;
          quote_of_id: string | null;
        }[];
        if (!own) return false;
        await lockPostsInOrder(tx, [id, own.reply_to_id, own.quote_of_id]);
        const [old] = await tx
          .update(posts)
          .set({ state: "deleted_by_author", deletedAt: now, body: "" })
          .where(and(eq(posts.id, id), eq(posts.authorId, authorId), ne(posts.state, "deleted_by_author")))
          .returning({ replyToId: posts.replyToId, quoteOfId: posts.quoteOfId });
        if (!old) return false;
        if (old.replyToId) {
          await tx.update(posts).set({ replyCount: bump(posts.replyCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, old.replyToId));
        } else {
          await tx.update(profiles).set({ postCount: bump(profiles.postCount, -1) }).where(eq(profiles.id, authorId));
        }
        if (old.quoteOfId) await tx.update(posts).set({ quoteCount: bump(posts.quoteCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, old.quoteOfId));
        await within?.(tx);
        return true;
      });
    },

    /** Posts by id with their author and the handle they reply to, in no particular order. Includes deleted and hidden posts; callers apply visibility. */
    async findPosts(ids: string[]): Promise<Map<string, PostRow>> {
      if (ids.length === 0) return new Map();
      const raw = await rows<RawPost>(sql`select ${POST_COLUMNS} ${POST_JOINS} where p.id = any(${uuidArray(ids)})`);
      return new Map(raw.map((r) => [r.id, toPost(r)]));
    },

    /** Ids of the reply chain above a post, root first, at most MAX_ANCESTORS long. */
    async ancestorIds(postId: string): Promise<string[]> {
      const raw = await rows<{ id: string }>(sql`
        with recursive chain as (
          select p.id, p.reply_to_id, 1 as depth from posts p where p.id = (select reply_to_id from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid)
          union all
          select p.id, p.reply_to_id, c.depth + 1 from posts p join chain c on p.id = c.reply_to_id where c.depth < ${MAX_ANCESTORS}
        )
        select id from chain order by depth desc`);
      return raw.map((r) => r.id);
    },

    /** Direct replies visible to the viewer, oldest first. */
    async replies(postId: string, viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        select p.id as post_id, ${iso("p.created_at")} as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id from posts p
        where p.reply_to_id = ${postId}::uuid and ${visibleTo(viewer)} and ${authorNotBlocked(viewer)} and ${after(cursor, sql`p.created_at`, sql`p.id`)}
        order by p.created_at asc, p.id asc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ engagement

    /**
     * `other` is the post's author when that is someone else: the pair is locked and a block refused inside the
     * transaction. The liker's and the author's profile rows are locked too and a deleted one refused, so a like
     * cannot land on an account a concurrent purge is removing (lockLive); the same goes for reposts and bookmarks.
     */
    async like(userId: string, postId: string, now: Date, other?: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (other) await guardPair(tx, userId, other, "not_found");
        await lockLive(tx, actorAndAuthor(userId, postId));
        const inserted = await tx.insert(likes).values({ userId, postId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ postId: likes.postId });
        if (inserted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ likeCount: bump(posts.likeCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unlike(userId: string, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const deleted = await tx.delete(likes).where(and(eq(likes.userId, userId), eq(likes.postId, postId))).returning({ postId: likes.postId });
        if (deleted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ likeCount: bump(posts.likeCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        return deleted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async repost(userId: string, postId: string, now: Date, other?: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (other) await guardPair(tx, userId, other, "not_found");
        await lockLive(tx, actorAndAuthor(userId, postId));
        const inserted = await tx.insert(reposts).values({ userId, postId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ postId: reposts.postId });
        if (inserted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ repostCount: bump(posts.repostCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unrepost(userId: string, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const deleted = await tx.delete(reposts).where(and(eq(reposts.userId, userId), eq(reposts.postId, postId))).returning({ postId: reposts.postId });
        if (deleted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ repostCount: bump(posts.repostCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        return deleted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async bookmark(userId: string, postId: string, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
      // A transaction of its own only for the lock: a bookmark counts nothing, but it must not outlive a purge of either account.
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await lockLive(tx, actorAndAuthor(userId, postId));
        const inserted = await tx.insert(bookmarks).values({ userId, postId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ postId: bookmarks.postId });
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unbookmark(userId: string, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
