```ts
export type SourceSummary = z.infer<typeof SourceSummary>;

const SnapshotImage = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), alt: z.string().nullable(), width: z.number().int().positive(), height: z.number().int().positive() });

/**
 * A snapshot of a case's evidence. Shown, it carries everything its digest covers, each member under the name
 * snapshotDigest reads it by, so the console recomputes the digest from exactly what it displays. Withheld (erased, or
 * a copy of content that was erased since), it carries its id, its time and its digest and no content.
 */
export const CaseSnapshot = z.discriminatedUnion("withheld", [
  z.object({ id: z.uuid(), takenAt: z.iso.datetime(), digest: Hex64, withheld: z.literal(true) }),
  z.object({
    id: z.uuid(),
    takenAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    digest: Hex64,
    withheld: z.literal(false),
    salt: Hex64,
    targetType: TargetKind,
    targetId: z.uuid(),
    authorHandle: z.string(),
    postState: StoredPostState.nullable(),
    postCreatedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
    replyToId: z.uuid().nullable(),
    quoteOfId: z.uuid().nullable(),
    body: z.string().nullable(),
    media: z.array(SnapshotImage).nullable(),
    displayName: z.string().nullable(),
    bio: z.string().nullable(),
    handle: z.string().nullable(),
  }),
]);
export type CaseSnapshot = z.infer<typeof CaseSnapshot>;

/**
 * One item of a case, for staff: its ground and what its sender wrote, the image it points at (a hint), and its source
 * as a summary. `link` is the item's korbat address, an account's under the handle as it was named. `quotedByPosition`
 * is set on an item korbat added for a quoted post (the position of the item it was added for), `quotedCaseId` on a
 * suspect item whose post quotes another (the case of that post's item). A re-examination says which item of its notice
 * it re-examines, and whether the person reading decided that item. `erased` marks an item whose intake record was erased.
 */
export const CaseItem = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  seq: z.number().int().positive(),
  position: z.number().int().min(1).max(20),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  lane: LaneNumber,
  link: z.string(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  allegesIllegal: z.boolean(),
  csam: z.boolean(),
  category: z.enum(TDB_CATEGORIES),
  categoryKeyword: z.string().nullable(),
  citedLaw: z.string().nullable(),
  explanation: z.string().nullable(),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  suspect: z.boolean(),
  quotedByPosition: z.number().int().min(1).max(10).nullable(),
  quotedCaseId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  reexaminesPosition: z.number().int().min(1).max(20).nullable(),
  reexaminesYourDecision: z.boolean(),
  statement: z.string().nullable(),
  outcome: ItemOutcome.nullable(),
  answeredBy: z.uuid().nullable(),
  erased: z.boolean(),
  source: SourceSummary,
});
export type CaseItem = z.infer<typeof CaseItem>;

/**
 * One measure or reversal of a decision. A measure says whether it is in force and, when a reversal lifted it, which
 * decision's; `noEffect` says that it changed nothing anyone saw when it was imposed. A seal lists what it covers: the
 * posts and images, how many of the posts their author had deleted, and at most SEAL_LIST_MAX rows of the list itself,
 * oldest first, as text for the report to the police, never content.
 */
export const CaseDecisionAction = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(ACTION_KINDS),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  noEffect: z.enum(["already", "deleted"]).nullable(),
  inForce: z.boolean(),
  reversesActionId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  liftedBy: z.uuid().nullable(),
  sealed: z
    .object({
      posts: Count,
      images: Count,
      deletedPosts: Count,
      list: z.array(z.object({ postId: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime(), images: z.number().int().positive() })).max(SEAL_LIST_MAX),
    })
    .nullable(),
  // 3e (design, section 10.3): the ledger row's own columns, each null on a kind that does not take it.
  /** A suspension's or a restriction of reporting's days. */
  days: z.number().int().min(STANDING_DAYS.min).max(STANDING_DAYS.max).nullable(),
  /** A standing measure announced with the reply window, or taken at once. */
  announced: z.boolean().nullable(),
  basis: z.enum(STANDING_BASES).nullable(),
  /** The decisions the measure rests on. */
  restsOn: z.array(z.uuid()).nullable(),
  /** A standing measure's earliest start, as its statement names it. */
  earliestStart: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  /** A strike's and a warning's last moment of counting. */
  countsUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  /** A standing measure's period as it stands now. */
  period: MeasurePeriod.nullable(),
  /**
   * On a strike: the kinds of the standing measures of the account that rest on this strike's decision and stand (not
   * lifted, their basis whole), so that a review says [review.rests] before the key is asked; null on any other kind.
   */
  restedOnBy: z.array(z.enum(["suspend", "terminate"])).nullable(),
  /**
   * 3e Task 2: on a retirement, the handle it retired, from its decision's snapshot in lower case, which the case page
   * names and the preview of its reversal prints. Absent on every other kind.
   */
  handle: z.string().optional(),
});
export type CaseDecisionAction = z.infer<typeof CaseDecisionAction>;

/**
 * A decision as the case page shows it: the statement's data, who decided (a staff handle), the stored facts that it
 * was taken on a suspicion and with the images out of sight, and its measures. A text is null when the decision has
 * none of that kind or it was erased.
 */
export const CaseDecision = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  redressVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  category: z.enum(TDB_CATEGORIES),
  categoryKeyword: z.string().nullable(),
  source: z.enum(["notice", "report", "own_initiative"]),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  staffHandle: z.string(),
  throughSeq: Count,
  answersFromSeq: Count.nullable(),
  reviewsDecisionId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  snapshotId: z.uuid(),
  suspect: z.boolean(),
  unseen: z.boolean(),
  needsAdmin: z.boolean(),
  endedInterim: z.boolean(),
  facts: z.string().nullable(),
  reason: z.string().nullable(),
  legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
  actions: z.array(CaseDecisionAction),
});
export type CaseDecision = z.infer<typeof CaseDecision>;

/**
 * Whether anyone at korbat may review a pending appeal now, as the database answers it (appeal_reviewer_state):
 * `available`; `none_single_staff` when korbat has at most one staff account that could (one admin, where the review
 * needs an admin); `none_eligible` when it has more and each took part in the case or is too close to someone in it.
 */
export const REVIEWER_STATES = ["available", "none_single_staff", "none_eligible"] as const;
export const ReviewerState = z.enum(REVIEWER_STATES);
export type ReviewerState = z.infer<typeof ReviewerState>;

/**
 * The author's appeal of a decision of the case, with its statement while korbat keeps it, and its answer. For a pending
 * appeal: `reviewer`, whether anyone may review it now; `needsAdmin`, whether its review is an admin's (the appealed
 * decision cites R2 or sealed images); and `mayReview`, whether the reading person may review it: they made none of the
 * case's decisions, opened no finding in it, are not close to anyone in it, and are an admin where one is needed. An
 * answered appeal has no reviewer state and nobody may review it.
 */
export const CaseAppeal = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  decisionId: z.uuid(),
  filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  statement: z.string().nullable(),
  answeredAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  answeredBy: z.uuid().nullable(),
  reviewer: ReviewerState.nullable(),
  needsAdmin: z.boolean(),
  mayReview: z.boolean(),
});
export type CaseAppeal = z.infer<typeof CaseAppeal>;

/** How many appeals one page of the console's list holds. */
export const APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

/**
 * One pending appeal in the console's list: its case, the decision it appeals (when that was decided, the rule or the
 * law it rests on, and what it did), when it was filed, and the end of the decision's appeal window. Then the three
 * marks of CaseAppeal. No row carries the appellant's statement: the reviewer reads it on the case page, whose read is
 * logged and counted.
 */
export const AppealRow = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  caseId: z.uuid(),
  decisionId: z.uuid(),
  filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  deadline: z.iso.datetime(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  legal: z.boolean(),
  actions: z.array(z.enum(ACTION_KINDS)),
  reviewer: ReviewerState,
  needsAdmin: z.boolean(),
  mayReview: z.boolean(),
});
export type AppealRow = z.infer<typeof AppealRow>;

/** GET /api/staff/appeals: the pending appeals, newest first. */
export const AppealsPage = z.object({ appeals: z.array(AppealRow).max(APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable() });
export type AppealsPage = z.infer<typeof AppealsPage>;

export const AppealsQuery = z.object({ cursor: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/).optional() });
export type AppealsQuery = z.infer<typeof AppealsQuery>;

/** A note on a case, or a recorded choice not to seal with its reason: who wrote it (a staff handle), when, and the text. */
export const CaseStaffText = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), staffHandle: z.string(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime(), text: z.string() });
export type CaseStaffText = z.infer<typeof CaseStaffText>;

/** One event of a case's history, in the order of their times: ids, enums and times, never text. */
export const CaseHistoryEntry = z.object({
  at: z.iso.datetime(),
  event: z.enum(["item", "snapshot", "decision", "appeal_filed", "appeal_answered", "note", "seal_declined", "reveal", "evidence_erased", "redaction"]),
  refId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  seq: z.number().int().nullable(),
  intakeKind: z.enum(["user", "finding"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  allegesIllegal: z.boolean().nullable(),
  csam: z.boolean().nullable(),
  reexamination: z.boolean().nullable(),
  decisionKind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]).nullable(),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  staffHandle: z.string().nullable(),
  result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
});
export type CaseHistoryEntry = z.infer<typeof CaseHistoryEntry>;

/**
 * What a case is about, as it stands now: a post with its state and its level, or an account with the handle, display
 * name and bio it holds now. `link` is the post's korbat address, as text: the console links nowhere into the app. A
 * member is null when the row is gone.
 */
export const CaseTarget = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
  z.object({ type: z.literal("post"), id: z.uuid(), link: z.string(), authorHandle: z.string().nullable(), state: StoredPostState.nullable(), level: z.enum(["visible", "withheld", "removed"]).nullable() }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal("account"), id: z.uuid(), handle: z.string().nullable(), displayName: z.string().nullable(), bio: z.string().nullable(), deleted: z.boolean() }),
]);
export type CaseTarget = z.infer<typeof CaseTarget>;

/**
 * What a case on the path for child sexual abuse material shows in place of images: whether a suspect item is
 * unanswered, what the case reaches, and how often an admin answered such a report about this target or this author
 * without a seal in the last SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS months, with the day staff last opened an image of the post in the
 * console. Counts and days only.
 */
export const CaseSuspicion = z.object({
  open: z.boolean(),
  reach: z.object({ posts: Count, images: Count, sealed: Count, served: Count, newestPostOn: UtcDay.nullable() }),
  earlier: z.object({
    target: z.object({ count: Count, lastOn: UtcDay.nullable(), imagesOpenedOn: UtcDay.nullable() }),
    author: z.object({ count: Count, lastOn: UtcDay.nullable() }),
  }),
});
export type CaseSuspicion = z.infer<typeof CaseSuspicion>;

/**
 * GET /api/staff/cases/:case: the case, its target as it stands, its evidence (newest first), its items, its decisions
 * with their measures and texts, its appeals, the reading person's own drafts, the notes and the recorded choices not to
 * seal, and its history. `suspicion` is set for a case that holds a suspect item or a seal. `imagesAllowed` is false
 * while the post is frozen, and for every account case: an account case shows no image.
 */
export const CaseView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  lane: LaneNumber,
  stateVersion: Count,
  intakeSeq: Count,
  answeredSeq: Count,
  openedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  closedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  target: CaseTarget,
  suspicion: CaseSuspicion.nullable(),
  imagesAllowed: z.boolean(),
  snapshots: z.array(CaseSnapshot),
  items: z.array(CaseItem),
  decisions: z.array(CaseDecision),
  appeals: z.array(CaseAppeal),
  drafts: z.array(StaffTextDraft),
  notes: z.array(CaseStaffText),
  sealsDeclined: z.array(CaseStaffText),
  history: z.array(CaseHistoryEntry),
  // 3e (design, section 10.3): on a post case the strike's answer and the author's standing in bands, on an account case
  // the account's standing; each null on the other kind of case.
  strikeDue: StrikeDue.nullable(),
  authorStanding: AuthorStanding.nullable(),
  standing: CaseStanding.nullable(),
});
export type CaseView = z.infer<typeof CaseView>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the statement of reasons

/** A measure as a statement tells of it: what it was, the image of an image measure, whether it changed anything, and what a seal covers. */
export const StatementMeasure = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(MEASURE_KINDS),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  /** Null when the measure changed what someone sees; `already` or `deleted` when it did not. */
  noEffect: z.enum(["already", "deleted"]).nullable(),
  /** For a seal: the posts and images its list held when it was recorded, and how many of those images were on posts their author had deleted by then. */
  sealed: z.object({ posts: Count, images: Count, deletedImages: Count }).nullable(),
  // 3e (design, section 10.2): what the ledger fixes for good about a measure of 3e, so a statement reads as it was sent.
  // Absent on 3c's measures.
  /** A strike's last moment of counting. */
  endsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a strike: the account's strikes that stood and counted at the decision's time, this one included. */
  activeThen: Count.nullable().optional(),
  /** On a suspension or a termination: whether it was announced with the reply window or taken at once. */
  announced: z.boolean().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a retirement: the handle of the decision's snapshot, in lower case, as the database retires it. */
  handle: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a retirement that changed the profile: the placeholder the profile got; null when the measure changed nothing. */
  placeholder: z.string().nullable().optional(),
});
export type StatementMeasure = z.infer<typeof StatementMeasure>;

/**
 * What a statement says of a field reset that ended or was lifted: the decision that holds the reset (whose screen shows
 * the old value), whether korbat still kept that value when this decision was made, and the rule that decision cites,
 * since a value reset under R4 may have been erased by then.
 */
const ResetFacts = { resetDecisionId: z.uuid().nullable(), oldValueKept: z.boolean(), resetRuleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable() };

/** A reversal as a statement tells of it. The reset's facts are set only on the lifting of a field reset. */
export const StatementReversal = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(REVERSAL_KINDS),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  ...ResetFacts,
  /** 3e: on the reversal of a retirement, the handle it gives back, as the lifted decision's snapshot holds it, in lower case. */
  handle: z.string().nullable().optional(),
});
export type StatementReversal = z.infer<typeof StatementReversal>;

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with the decision, without a reversal. The reset's facts are set only on a field reset. */
export const StatementEndedMeasure = z.object({ kind: z.enum(MEASURE_KINDS), mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(), ...ResetFacts });
export type StatementEndedMeasure = z.infer<typeof StatementEndedMeasure>;

/**
 * The statement's data (3c design, section 10): everything a statement of reasons is rendered from, and nothing a later
 * event changes, so a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered. It is the part of a decision that the
 * author's decision view, the console's preview and the mail share; @korbat/rules renders it (statementParagraphs).
 *   - `rulesVersion` and `redressVersion`: the rulebook and the redress texts the decision was made under.
 *   - `facts`, `reason`, `legalReference`: the staff texts, each null when the decision has none or it was erased.
 *   - `post`: the post a post case is about, by its id and creation time, which survive its deletion; null for an account case.
 *   - `endedMeasures`: the measures taken while deciding that ended with this decision. A seal taken while deciding is
 *     left out when the decision itself seals, since the images stay sealed.
 *   - `reviewed`: for a review or a correction, the decision it reviews, whose rule or law the statement renders
 *     under the rulebook version that decision was made under (`reviewed.rulesVersion`), never under its own.
 */
export const DecisionStatement = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  redressVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
  facts: z.string().nullable(),
  reason: z.string().nullable(),
  source: z.enum(["notice", "report", "own_initiative"]),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  post: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  measures: z.array(StatementMeasure),
  reversals: z.array(StatementReversal),
  endedMeasures: z.array(StatementEndedMeasure),
  reviewed: z
    .object({
      kind: z.enum(["interim", "final"]),
      ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
      ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
      rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
      legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
      decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    })
    .nullable(),
});
export type DecisionStatement = z.infer<typeof DecisionStatement>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the app: what the author and the reporter read

/** A page cursor of the app's moderation lists: an opaque word the API wrote. */
const ListCursor = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/);

/** How many decisions one page of the author's list holds. */
export const AUTHOR_CASES_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * One decision in its author's list (3c design, section 7.6): the decisions their author was told of, and no other.
 * `decidedOn` is the decision's UTC day, never the day its case opened, which would tell when a report arrived. `post` is
 * the post a decision about a post concerns, by its id and creation time; null for a decision about the account.
 * `actions` are what the decision did, measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds; `endedInterim` says that
 * what korbat did while deciding ended with it. `ruleId` and `legal` name the rule or the law it rests on (neither for a
 * decision without a ground). `appealUntil` is the end of the appeal's window while an appeal can still be filed, and
 * `reversedOn` the UTC day a final restriction was reversed in full; both null otherwise. `appeal` is where the author's
 * appeal of the decision stands: `pending`, or its answer; null when they filed none.
 */
export const AuthorCaseRow = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  decidedOn: UtcDay,
  post: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  actions: z.array(z.enum(ACTION_KINDS)),
  endedInterim: z.boolean(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  legal: z.boolean(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reversedOn: UtcDay.nullable(),
  appeal: z.enum(["pending", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  /** The strike the decision gave (3e design, section 10.2): until when it counts, and when it was overruled; null for a decision without one. */
  strike: z.object({ countsUntil: z.iso.datetime(), overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() }).nullable(),
});
export type AuthorCaseRow = z.infer<typeof AuthorCaseRow>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/cases: the decisions about the viewer's account, newest first, and how many strikes of the account
 * count now (active_strikes), which the block "Your standing" above the list prints.
 */
export const AuthorCasesPage = z.object({ decisions: z.array(AuthorCaseRow).max(AUTHOR_CASES_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable(), activeStrikes: Count });
export type AuthorCasesPage = z.infer<typeof AuthorCasesPage>;

/** A strike as its decision's screen shows it: until when it counts, whether it still counts, ran out or was overruled, and when. */
export const DecisionStrike = z.object({ countsUntil: z.iso.datetime(), state: z.enum(["counts", "expired", "overruled"]), overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() });
export type DecisionStrike = z.infer<typeof DecisionStrike>;

export const AuthorCasesQuery = z.object({ cursor: ListCursor.optional() });
export type AuthorCasesQuery = z.infer<typeof AuthorCasesQuery>;

/**
 * An image of the content a decision was made on, as the app's own image route serves it to its author. It is listed
 * only while that route serves it: never for a sealed image or one of a post its author deleted.
 */
export const DecisionImage = z.object({ id: MediaId, alt: z.string(), width: z.number().int().positive(), height: z.number().int().positive(), small: z.string(), large: z.string() });
export type DecisionImage = z.infer<typeof DecisionImage>;

/**
 * The content a decision was made on, from the decision's snapshot, or the reason it is not shown; the first that
 * applies, in this order (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10):
 *   - `r4_redacted`: an R4 redaction erased it when the restriction became final;
 *   - `erased`: korbat's copy was erased under its retention rules, on `contentErasedOn` (a UTC day); `postKept` says
 *     that the post itself is still in its author's profile;
 *   - `post`: the post's text, which is never sealed, and its images. `imagesHidden` says why none is listed: `sealed`
 *     (nobody is shown them, the author included), or `deleted_by_author` (kept for the case, served to nobody);
 *     `imageCount` is how many the snapshot holds either way. `deletedByAuthor` says that the author deleted the post;
 *   - `account`: the account's fields as the snapshot held them, which for a field reset is the value the reset removed.
 */
export const DecisionContent = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("r4_redacted") }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("erased"), contentErasedOn: UtcDay, postKept: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({
    kind: z.literal("post"),
    body: z.string(),
    deletedByAuthor: z.boolean(),
    images: z.array(DecisionImage),
    imageCount: Count,
    imagesHidden: z.enum(["sealed", "deleted_by_author"]).nullable(),
  }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("account"), handle: z.string(), displayName: z.string(), bio: z.string() }),
]);
export type DecisionContent = z.infer<typeof DecisionContent>;

/**
 * The author's appeal as the decision's screen shows it (3c design, sections 7.7 and 10).
 *   - `pending`: `reviewer` says whether anyone at korbat may review it now and, when nobody may, whether that is
 *     because korbat has one moderator (or one admin); `needsAdmin` that its review is an admin's, which is true only
 *     when the decision cites R2 or sealed images, both of which its author was told. Neither says who took part in
 *     the case or why someone may not review it.
 *   - `answered`: the result, the UTC day, and the answering decision with its statement's data, which the screen
 *     renders as it renders every statement: the review, or the correction that reversed everything before a review.
 */
export const DecisionAppeal = z.discriminatedUnion("state", [
  z.strictObject({ state: z.literal("pending"), filedAt: z.iso.datetime(), reviewer: ReviewerState, needsAdmin: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({
    state: z.literal("answered"),
    filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    answeredOn: UtcDay,
    result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
    answeredBy: z.uuid(),
    statement: DecisionStatement,
  }),
]);
export type DecisionAppeal = z.infer<typeof DecisionAppeal>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/decisions/:id: one decision as its author reads it (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10). It is the
 * statement's data, which the app renders with statementParagraphs exactly as the mail was rendered, and what the
 * author's screen adds: `appealUntil` and `reversedOn` as the list gives them, the content actioned, and `appeal`, the
 * author's appeal of this decision (null when they filed none).
 */
export const DecisionView = DecisionStatement.extend({
  id: z.uuid(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reversedOn: UtcDay.nullable(),
  content: DecisionContent,
  appeal: DecisionAppeal.nullable(),
  /** The strike the decision gave, read fresh (3e design, section 10.2); null for a decision without one. */
  strike: DecisionStrike.nullable(),
});
export type DecisionView = z.infer<typeof DecisionView>;

/** How many reports one page of the reporter's list holds. */
export const REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * One item of a report in its sender's own list: the item as the status page gives it, and its id, by which the signed-in
 * sender asks for its re-examination. The status page, which anyone holding a link may open, names an item by its
 * position and never carries an id.
 */
export const ReportItem = NoticeItemStatus.extend({ id: z.uuid() });
export type ReportItem = z.infer<typeof ReportItem>;

/** One report or notice in its sender's list: its reference, when korbat received it, and its items as the status page gives them, each with its id. */
export const ReportRow = z.object({ ref: NoticeRef, receivedAt: z.string(), items: z.array(ReportItem) });
export type ReportRow = z.infer<typeof ReportRow>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/reports: the viewer's own reports and notices, newest first, while korbat keeps their records.
 * `reportMailStopped` says that korbat's mails about reports to the account's address are stopped, which someone who
 * holds that address asked for.
 */
export const ReportsPage = z.object({ reports: z.array(ReportRow).max(REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable(), reportMailStopped: z.boolean() });
export type ReportsPage = z.infer<typeof ReportsPage>;

export const ReportsQuery = z.object({ cursor: ListCursor.optional() });
export type ReportsQuery = z.infer<typeof ReportsQuery>;

/** How many rows each of the overview's lists holds at most; its total says how many there are. */
export const OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX = 100;

const MailCounts = z.object({ receipts: Count, authorMails: Count, outcomes: Count });

/**
 * What retention should have erased or deleted more than a day ago and has not, one count for each due rule: closed
 * cases whose evidence is due, intake records, statements of accounts deleted for 12 months, R4 redactions, image rows
 * that nothing retains, unconfirmed drafts, access rows, and notifiers' contacts and confirmations. The retention job and
 * the auth janitor each run every ten minutes, so any count above zero means a step keeps failing, or that the retention
 * job is switched off. The API reads the counts at most once a minute, for all staff.
 */
export const ErasureOverdue = z.object({ caseEvidence: Count, intakeRecords: Count, statements: Count, redactions: Count, images: Count, drafts: Count, accessLog: Count, contacts: Count });
export type ErasureOverdue = z.infer<typeof ErasureOverdue>;
const HandleCount = z.object({ handle: z.string(), count: Count });

/**
 * GET /api/staff/overview: what the home screen shows every staff member. Per lane the open cases and since when the
 * oldest unanswered item waits; the appeals waiting, how many of them the reading person may review
 * (`appealsYouMayReview`, by CaseAppeal's rule) and how many no staff account may review now
 * (`appealsWithoutReviewer`: the database's appeal_reviewer_state is not `available`); every reveal of a source in the last 30 days, newest first, with
 * its staff handle and its case; per staff handle the images viewed and the findings opened today (UTC); the mails
 * waiting for more than an hour and those given up in the last 30 days; the decided items the daily release has not
 * released after 26 hours; what retention should have erased more than a day ago and has not (`erasureOverdue`); and
 * whether the emergency switch is on. And, of the path for child sexual abuse material,
 * three lists every staff member sees: the decisions of the last 30 days that lifted the protection of reported images
 * (a lifted seal, `unsealed`, or an admin's final answer to such a report without a seal, `dismissed`), the recorded
 * choices not to seal of the last 30 days, and the seals taken while deciding that are in force, each with what it
 * covers. Counts, times, handles and cases only.
 */
export const StaffOverview = z.object({
  lanes: z.array(z.object({ lane: LaneNumber, open: Count, oldestAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() })).length(3),
  appealsWaiting: Count,
  appealsYouMayReview: Count,
  appealsWithoutReviewer: Count,
  reveals: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid() })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
  imagesToday: z.array(HandleCount),
  findingsToday: z.array(HandleCount),
  mailsWaiting: MailCounts,
  mailsFailed: MailCounts,
  releaseOverdue: Count,
  erasureOverdue: ErasureOverdue,
  deferUnproven: z.boolean(),
  protectionLifted: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid(), kind: z.enum(["unsealed", "dismissed"]) })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
  sealsDeclined: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid() })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
  interimSeals: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid(), posts: Count, images: Count })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
});
export type StaffOverview = z.infer<typeof StaffOverview>;
```

```ts
/**
 * The public rulebook. korbat restricts content when it breaks one of these rules, or when it is illegal under EU law or
 * the law of an EU country and korbat is told about it in a notice. Opinions are never a reason. Every decision cites one
 * of these rules or the law.
 *
 * The rulebook is versioned: a decision records the version it was made under, and its statement is always rendered with
 * that version's text, so an old statement reads exactly as it was sent whatever the rules say now.
 */
export type Automation =
  | "none"                 // report-driven, human decides
  | "withhold_for_review"  // automation may hide from others pending a human
  | "auto_remove";         // automation may remove (R2 only)

export interface Rule {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  allowed: string[];
  notAllowed: string[];
  automation: Automation;
  /** Decided by an admin: every final decision under the rule, whether it acts or not. */
  seniorQueue: boolean;
}

/** Version 1: the six rules as they stood before moderation cases. Kept as it was, for the decisions made under it. */
const RULES_V1 = [

    text: "Images or text whose primary purpose is sexual arousal are not allowed. This includes nudity presented sexually, explicit sexual acts, and sexualised depictions of anyone. Images that score high on the automated check are hidden from others until a person reviews them; the author can always see their own post.",

] as const satisfies readonly Rule[];

/**
 * Version 2, with moderation cases: nothing is automated (a person decides every case; the automated checks of R1 and R2
 * return with a later version), R2 says how reported images are handled without anyone opening them, R4 and R5 say who
 * hides content while a case is decided and who decides it, and R6 names coordinated manipulation. R3 is unchanged.
 */
const RULES_V2 = [

After an admin has answered without a seal, staff may open them like any other image. Whoever is on duty may seal them while an admin decides: sealed images are shown to nobody, their author included. An admin either seals them for good, in which case they are kept only for the authorities and reported to them, or answers without a seal. Every final decision on a report or finding under this rule, whether it acts or not, and every review of one, is taken by an admin. Only an admin can lift a seal, and a seal for good only on the authorities' answer; an appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.",

  },
  {

Hyperbole, dark humour, and discussion of violence in news, history, or fiction are allowed. Any moderator may hide a reported threat from others at once while an admin decides, and may lift that again. Every final decision on a report under this rule, whether it acts or not, is taken by an admin, and only an admin corrects one. An appeal against a restriction under it is reviewed by a moderator who made none of the case's decisions and did not report it themselves, and waits while korbat has none.",
  },
  {
    ...RULES_V1[5],
    title: "No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation",
    text: "Repetitive unsolicited posting, deceptive schemes, malware links, and pretending to be another person or organisation are not allowed. Parody and fan accounts are fine when clearly labelled. Coordinating several accounts, your own or other people's, to like, repost or report together is not allowed.",
    allowed: [...RULES_V1[5].allowed, "Asking your followers to read or share a post"],
    notAllowed: [...RULES_V1[5].notAllowed, "A group of accounts liking each other's posts on cue to lift them in Explore", "Reporting someone together to get them removed"],
  },
] as const satisfies readonly Rule[];

/**
 * Version 3, with account sanctions (3e design, section 18, W.4): version 2 with one change, to R6, which now also names
 * report after report that is plainly unfounded, and says that a notice of illegal content is never restricted.
 */
const RULES_V3 = [
  RULES_V2[0],
  RULES_V2[1],
  RULES_V2[2],
  RULES_V2[3],
  RULES_V2[4],
  {
    ...RULES_V2[5],
    text: `${RULES_V2[5].text} Sending report after report that is plainly unfounded is not allowed either: after a warning, korbat may stop taking an account's reports under these rules for a limited time. A notice of illegal content is never restricted.`,
    allowed: [...RULES_V2[5].allowed, "Reporting in good faith something that turns out to break no rule"],
    notAllowed: [...RULES_V2[5].notAllowed, "Reporting the same account again and again for posts that plainly break no rule"],
  },
] as const satisfies readonly Rule[];

/** The version a decision made now records. */
export const RULES_VERSION = 3;

/** Every version of the rulebook, by its number. */
export const RULEBOOKS = { 1: RULES_V1, 2: RULES_V2, 3: RULES_V3 } as const satisfies Record<number, readonly Rule[]>;

/** The rules in force. */
export const RULES = RULEBOOKS[RULES_VERSION];

export type RuleId = (typeof RULES)[number]["id"];

/** A rule as one version of the rulebook words it: the current version unless told. Undefined for an id or a version that does not exist. */
export function getRule(id: string, version: number = RULES_VERSION): Rule | undefined {
  const book: readonly Rule[] | undefined = (RULEBOOKS as Record<number, readonly Rule[]>)[version];
  return book?.find((rule) => rule.id === id);
}

export function isRuleId(id: string): id is RuleId {
  return RULES.some((rule) => rule.id === id);
}

/** What a statement of reasons tells its author they can do about the decision. Which text applies follows from the decision's own kind and outcome. */
export interface RedressTexts {
  /** A final decision that restricts: korbat's appeal. `{deadline}` stands for the last day of the appeal, which the statement fills in. */
  appeal: string;
  /** A decision taken while korbat decides. */
  interim: string;
  /** Any other decision, which its author cannot appeal. */
  notAppealable: string;
  // Version 2 (3e design, section 18, W.3). Their numbers are literals of the version, held to STANDING_RULES by a table
  // test: a changed number is a new version, so an old statement keeps its own.
  /** After a strike's sentence: the prior warning of what strikes lead to. */
  strikeNext?: string;
  /** An announced suspension or termination: the reply before the start. */
  reply?: string;
  /** A suspension or termination taken at once: the reply while it runs. */
  replyAtOnce?: string;
  /** A kept answer to a reply. `{deadline}` stands for the last day of the appeal of the decision it keeps. */
  replyAnswered?: string;
  /** After a warning about reporting: what may follow it. */
  warnNext?: string;
  /** An announced measure: the appeal does not wait for the start. */
  appealNow?: string;
}

/** The version of the redress texts a decision made now records. */
export const REDRESS_VERSION = 2;

const OUTSIDE_KORBAT = "complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";

const REDRESS_V1 = {
  appeal: `You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until {deadline}: choose "Appeal" on this decision's screen under Settings, Cases. A moderator who took no part in the case reviews it. You can also go to court, or ${OUTSIDE_KORBAT}`,
  interim: `This applies while korbat decides, and ends with its decision. If korbat's decision restricts your post or profile, you can appeal it. You can also go to court, or ${OUTSIDE_KORBAT}`,
  notAppealable: `korbat's appeal does not apply to this decision. Where an earlier decision about this content still stands in part, its own screen in korbat says whether you can still appeal it. You can go to court, or ${OUTSIDE_KORBAT}`,
} as const;

/** Every version of the redress texts, by its number, kept as the rulebooks are. */
export const REDRESS_TEXTS = {
  1: REDRESS_V1,
  /** Account sanctions: version 1's three texts word for word, and six more. */
  2: {
    ...REDRESS_V1,
    strikeNext:
      "A strike restricts nothing by itself. When an account has 3 active strikes, a moderator may decide to suspend it for a limited time or, after three suspensions in 365 days, an admin may decide to terminate it. You would be told first and could reply before anything is restricted.",
    reply: `Before it starts you can reply: choose "Reply" on this decision's screen under Settings, Cases, and say anything you want the moderator to weigh. A reply sent before the start holds the start until a moderator has read it and answered you; if the decision is kept, it then starts with the answer, and never before the time you were given. A reply sent later is read and answered too, and can end this measure, but does not pause it. You can reply once. Replying does not use up your appeal.`,
    replyAtOnce: `You can reply at any time while it runs: choose "Reply" on this decision's screen under Settings, Cases. A moderator reads your reply and answers you, and can end this measure at once; the reply does not pause it. You can reply once. Replying does not use up your appeal.`,
    replyAnswered: `This answer is not appealed by itself. The appeal is against the decision it keeps: once, free of charge, until {deadline}, with "Appeal" on that decision's screen under Settings, Cases. The six months for it count from this answer when you replied before the start, and otherwise from the day you were told of that decision. You can also go to court, or ${OUTSIDE_KORBAT}`,
    warnNext: "If 3 of the reports you send after this warning are marked that way while it counts, a moderator may restrict your reports under korbat's rules for up to 30 days.",
    appealNow: "You can appeal from now; you do not have to wait for the start. An appeal does not hold the start: only a reply sent before the start does.",
  },
} as const satisfies Record<number, RedressTexts>;

/** The redress texts of one version. Undefined for a version that does not exist. */
export function getRedress(version: number): RedressTexts | undefined {
  return (REDRESS_TEXTS as Record<number, RedressTexts>)[version];
}

// The statement of reasons, rendered over the rulebooks and the redress texts above. The package exports only this file,
// so the app, the console and the API reach the statement through it.
export { STATEMENT_WORDS, retireEnd, statementParagraphs, type RetireEnd, type StatementInput } from "./statement";
```

### Replace `packages/rules/src/statement.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { MEASURES, RETENTION, appealDeadline, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
// The rulebooks and the redress texts live in the index, which re-exports this module: the two import each other, and
// each uses the other's functions only when called, never while it loads.
import { getRedress, getRule, type RedressTexts } from "./index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10), as one pure function of a decision's data: the author's screen, the
 * console's preview and the mail all render it with this, so what the moderator previews is what the author gets. It
 * reads nothing but its input: the rule's words come from the rulebook version the decision was made under and the
 * redress text from its redress version, and which redress text applies follows from the decision's own kind and
 * outcome, never from a later event, so a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 *
 * It carries the six elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act: what was restricted, where and for how long;
 * the facts, and whether the decision followed a notice or korbat's own finding; whether automated means were used; the
 * legal ground or the rule, with its explanation; and the redress.
 */
export type StatementInput = DecisionStatement;

/** A time as korbat's mails print it: the date and the minute in UTC, since the reader's zone is unknown. */
function utcMinute(at: string | Date): string {
  const iso = (typeof at === "string" ? new Date(at) : at).toISOString();
  return `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 16)} UTC`;
}

const FIELD_NAMES = { display_name: "display name", bio: "bio" } as const;
type Field = keyof typeof FIELD_NAMES;

/** The field a reset or its lifting is about, or null for any other kind. */
function fieldOf(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind): Field | null {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  return target === "display_name" || target === "bio" ? target : null;
}

/**
 * The statement's fixed words, one place for each: the tests pin them, and the console's composer refers to them. A
 * sentence that names a post names it as "your post of {time}".
 */
export const STATEMENT_WORDS = {
  /** What was done, for each measure but the seal. `post` is the post's time as printed; `deciding` says that it was taken while korbat decides. */
  done: {
    withhold: (post: string) => `korbat hid your post of ${post} from other people while it decides.`,
    remove: (post: string) => `korbat removed your post of ${post}: other people can no longer see it.`,
    withhold_media: (post: string) => `korbat hid one image of your post of ${post} from other people while it decides.`,
    remove_media: (post: string) => `korbat removed one image of your post of ${post}: other people can no longer see it.`,
    reset: (field: Field, deciding: boolean) => `korbat reset your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]}${deciding ? " while it decides" : ""}.`,
  },
  resetOnce: (field: Field) =>
    `korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]} again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.`,
  /** A measure that changed nothing when it was imposed. */
  already: (what: "post" | "image") => `Another decision already keeps this ${what} from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
  alreadyField: "The field already held korbat's placeholder, so this changes nothing now.",
  alreadySealed: "Another decision already keeps these images sealed, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.",
  deletedPost: "You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.",
  deletedAccount: "Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.",
  /** The seal. Nobody at korbat has opened the images, so no sentence says what they show. */
  sealPost: (post: string, images: number) => `korbat sealed the images of your post of ${post} (${images} in all): nobody can see them, you included.`,
  sealAccount: (images: number, posts: number) => `korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (${images} on ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}): nobody can see them, you included.`,
  sealDeleted: (images: number) => `${images} of them ${images === 1 ? "is on a post" : "are on posts"} you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data).`,
  sealForGood: "They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.",
  sealAppeal: "An appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.",
  /** Reversals. */
  lifted: "korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.",
  liftedField: (field: Field) => `korbat lifted the reset of your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]}.`,
  unsealed: "korbat lifted the seal on these images. If an image is still not shown, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies.",
  /** What a reset's end or lifting leaves: korbat never writes the old value back. */
  field: (field: Field) => `korbat does not put back your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]} as it was before the reset: set it again in Settings, Profile if you wish.`,
  oldValueKept: `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days.`,
  oldValueKeptR4: `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days, unless korbat had already erased it under rule R4.`,
  ended: (measures: string) => `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${measures}.`,
  /** The lead of a correction and of a review: which decision it is about, by its time, and what became of it. */
  corrected: (decided: string, part: boolean) => `korbat corrected its decision of ${decided} and reversed ${part ? "part of it" : "it"}.`,
  interimLifted: (decided: string) => `korbat lifted what it did while deciding on ${decided}.`,
  reviewed: (decided: string, outcome: "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed") =>
    `korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of ${decided} and ${outcome === "kept" ? "kept that decision" : outcome === "reversed" ? "reversed that decision" : "reversed part of that decision"}.`,
  noAction: "korbat decided to take no action.",
  /** Where a restriction applies and for how long. korbat cannot restrict by country, and a restriction on the law says so. */
  scope: {
    interim: "This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.",
    final: "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
    law: "korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so this applies everywhere, which is more than the law of a single country asks for.",
  },
  /** The source, as a category only: never a count, a reporter or a report's words. */
  source: {
    notice: "following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act",
    report: "following a report by another user",
    own_initiative: "found by a moderator",
  },
  automation: "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
  // 3e (design, section 18, W.2): the strike, the overruling of one, and what the software did for a decision that gives one.
  /** A strike: until when it counts, and how many of the account's strikes counted with it when it was decided. */
  strike: (endsAt: string, activeThen: number) =>
    `This decision gives your account a strike. It counts until ${endsAt}. With it your account had ${activeThen} active ${activeThen === 1 ? "strike" : "strikes"} when this was decided. korbat's rules fix when a decision gives a strike; the moderator does not choose it.`,
  /** A strike whose decision's other measures all changed nothing: the content was already not shown, or deleted. */
  strikeAnyway: "The strike counts although the post was already not shown or deleted: what counts is the breach.",
  overruled: "korbat overruled the strike that decision gave. It no longer counts.",
  automationStrike:
    "No automated means were used to find this or to decide that it breaks the rule. That the decision gives a strike follows from korbat's published rule, which its software applies.",
  // 3e (design, section 18, W.2): the retirement of a handle and its reversal.
  /** The first sentence of a retirement: which handle, and that nobody can use it again. */
  retireLead: (handle: string) => `korbat retired the handle @${handle}: nobody can use it again, you included.`,
  /**
   * A retirement that changed the profile: the handle, the placeholder, and when a new handle can be chosen without the
   * usual wait, by the decision's own measures (retireEnd): at once; when a suspension the same decision takes at once
   * ends; or not at all, after a termination taken at once, where the sentence ends after "instead".
   */
  retire: (handle: string, placeholder: string, end: RetireEnd) =>
    `korbat retired the handle @${handle}: nobody can use it again, you included. If your profile still held it, it now shows @${placeholder} instead${
      end === "none" ? "." : `, and you can choose a new handle in Settings, Profile, without the usual wait: ${end === "at_once" ? "at once" : "when that suspension ends"}.`
    }`,
  /** A retirement whose handle was already retired. */
  retireAlready: "That handle was already retired, so this changes nothing now.",
  /** The reversal of a retirement. */
  unretired: (handle: string) =>
    `korbat lifted the retirement of the handle @${handle}. If your profile still held the placeholder, it has the handle again. If you chose another handle since, you can change back to @${handle} at once in Settings, Profile. Nobody else could take it meanwhile.`,
  /**
   * The rule or the law, worded by what korbat knows when it decides. A decision that seals rests on a report that nobody
   * at korbat has checked against the images, since nobody opens them, so it says what the step rests on and never that
   * the rule is broken or the content illegal. A decision taken while deciding says what korbat is checking. Only a final
   * restriction without a seal states a finding. A review or a correction names the ground of the decision it is about.
   */
  ground: {
    sealRule: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `This step rests on korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    sealLaw: (reference: string) => `This step rests on the law: ${reference}`,
    checkingRule: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `korbat is checking this against korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    checkingLaw: (reference: string) => `korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: ${reference}`,
    breaks: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `It breaks korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    illegal: (reference: string) => `korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: ${reference}`,
    restedOnRule: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `That decision rested on korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    restedOnLaw: (reference: string) => `That decision rested on the law: ${reference}`,
    referenceErased: "its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.",
  },
} as const;

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;

/**
 * When the holder of a retired handle may choose a new one without the usual wait (3e design, W.2), read from the
 * decision's own measures so that the sentence reads as it was sent: at once; after a suspension the same decision
 * takes at once (a suspended account changes no handle); never after a termination taken at once. An announced
 * suspension or termination has not started when the decision is sent, so the handle can be chosen at once.
 */
export type RetireEnd = "at_once" | "after_suspension" | "none";
export function retireEnd(measures: readonly StatementInput["measures"][number][]): RetireEnd {
  if (measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "terminate" && measure.announced === false)) return "none";
  if (measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" && measure.announced === false)) return "after_suspension";
  return "at_once";
}

/** The sentence that names the source: a notice or a report was followed, a moderator's finding was found. */
const sourceSentence = (source: StatementInput["source"]): string => (source === "own_initiative" ? `What this decision is about was ${W.source.own_initiative}.` : `korbat decided this ${W.source[source]}.`);

/** What a reset's end or lifting says of the field: korbat does not put the old value back, and where it can still be read. */
function fieldSentence(field: Field, reset: { oldValueKept: boolean; resetRuleId: string | null }): string {
  const parts: string[] = [W.field(field)];
  if (reset.oldValueKept) parts.push(reset.resetRuleId === "R4" ? W.oldValueKeptR4 : W.oldValueKept);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** The kinds of 3e whose sentences this version of the package does not hold yet: none is rendered as another one. */
const UNWORDED: readonly (MeasureKind | ReversalKind)[] = ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting", "lift_suspension", "lift_reporting"];

/**
 * A retirement, as a paragraph. One that changed the profile names the handle, its placeholder and when a new handle can be
 * chosen; one that changed nothing names the handle and why, and no placeholder, since none was written.
 */
function retireParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string {
  const { handle, placeholder } = measure;
  if (handle === undefined || handle === null) throw new Error("a statement's retire_handle names the handle it retired: the decision's data holds none");
  if (measure.noEffect === "already") return `${W.retireLead(handle)} ${W.retireAlready}`;
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") return `${W.retireLead(handle)} ${W.deletedAccount}`;
  if (placeholder === undefined || placeholder === null) throw new Error("a statement's retire_handle names the placeholder it gave: the decision's data holds none");
  return W.retire(handle, placeholder, retireEnd(input.measures));
}

/**
 * A strike, as a paragraph: that the decision gives one, until when it counts and how many counted with it; that it
 * counts although the post was already not shown or deleted, when every other measure of the decision changed nothing;
 * then the prior warning of what strikes lead to, from the decision's own redress version.
 */
function strikeParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number], redress: RedressTexts): string {
  if (measure.endsAt === undefined || measure.endsAt === null || measure.activeThen === undefined || measure.activeThen === null) {
    throw new Error("a statement's strike names its end of counting and the strikes active then: the decision's data holds neither");
  }
  const parts: string[] = [W.strike(utcMinute(measure.endsAt), measure.activeThen)];
  const others = input.measures.filter((other) => other.kind !== "strike");
  if (others.length > 0 && others.every((other) => other.noEffect !== null)) parts.push(W.strikeAnyway);
  // Redress version 1 has no prior warning, and no decision under it holds a strike.
  if (redress.strikeNext !== undefined) parts.push(redress.strikeNext);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** One measure, as a paragraph: what was done, then that it changed nothing when it did not. */
function measureParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number], redress: RedressTexts): string {
  const post = input.post === null ? null : utcMinute(input.post.createdAt);
  const deciding = input.kind === "interim";
  if (UNWORDED.includes(measure.kind)) throw new Error(`a statement's ${measure.kind} is not worded in this version of @korbat/rules`);
  if (measure.kind === "strike") return strikeParagraph(input, measure, redress);
  if (measure.kind === "retire_handle") return retireParagraph(input, measure);
  const field = fieldOf(measure.kind);
  if (measure.kind === "seal_media") {
    const sealed = measure.sealed ?? { posts: 0, images: 0, deletedImages: 0 };
    const parts: string[] = [post === null ? W.sealAccount(sealed.images, sealed.posts) : W.sealPost(post, sealed.images)];
    if (post === null && sealed.deletedImages > 0) parts.push(W.sealDeleted(sealed.deletedImages));
    if (input.kind === "final") parts.push(W.sealForGood);
    if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.alreadySealed);
    if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(post === null ? W.deletedAccount : W.deletedPost);
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  if (field !== null) {
    const parts: string[] = [W.done.reset(field, deciding)];
    // A reset that changed something wrote the placeholder; one that changed nothing wrote nothing, and says so.
    if (measure.noEffect === null) parts.push(W.resetOnce(field));
    if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.alreadyField);
    if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedAccount);
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  if (post === null) throw new Error(`a statement's ${measure.kind} names its post: the decision's data holds none`);
  const done = measure.kind === "withhold" ? W.done.withhold(post) : measure.kind === "remove" ? W.done.remove(post) : measure.kind === "withhold_media" ? W.done.withhold_media(post) : W.done.remove_media(post);
  const parts: string[] = [done];
  if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.already(MEASURES[measure.kind].target === "image" ? "image" : "post"));
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedPost);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** One reversal, as a paragraph. A lifted restriction of a post or an image names the post. */
function reversalParagraph(input: StatementInput, reversal: StatementInput["reversals"][number]): string {
  if (UNWORDED.includes(reversal.kind)) throw new Error(`a statement's ${reversal.kind} is not worded in this version of @korbat/rules`);
  if (reversal.kind === "overrule") return W.overruled;
  if (reversal.kind === "unretire_handle") {
    if (reversal.handle === undefined || reversal.handle === null) throw new Error("a statement's unretire_handle names the handle it gives back: the decision's data holds none");
    return W.unretired(reversal.handle);
  }
  const field = fieldOf(reversal.kind);
  if (field !== null) return `${W.liftedField(field)} ${fieldSentence(field, reversal)}`;
  if (reversal.kind === "unseal_media") return W.unsealed;
  if (input.post === null) throw new Error(`a statement's ${reversal.kind} names its post: the decision's data holds none`);
  const post = utcMinute(input.post.createdAt);
  return `${reversal.kind === "restore_media" ? `One image of your post of ${post}` : `Your post of ${post}`}: ${W.lifted}`;
}

/** The measures taken while deciding that ended with the decision, and what becomes of each reset field the decision does not reset itself. */
function endedParagraph(input: StatementInput): string {
  const parts: string[] = [W.ended(input.endedMeasures.map((ended) => MEASURES[ended.kind].label).join(", "))];
  for (const ended of input.endedMeasures) {
    const field = fieldOf(ended.kind);
    if (field !== null && !input.measures.some((measure) => fieldOf(measure.kind) === field)) parts.push(fieldSentence(field, ended));
  }
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/**
 * How a ground is worded (STATEMENT_WORDS.ground): for the decision a review or a correction is about; for a decision
 * that seals; for one taken while deciding; or for a final restriction without a seal, the only one that states a finding.
 */
type GroundForm = "about" | "seal" | "deciding" | "found";

/** The rule or the law a decision rests on, in the form that fits what the decision is. */
function groundParagraph(ground: { ground: StatementInput["ground"]; ruleId: string | null; legalReference: string | null }, rulesVersion: number, form: GroundForm): string | null {
  const G = W.ground;
  if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
    const reference = ground.legalReference ?? G.referenceErased;
    return form === "about" ? G.restedOnLaw(reference) : form === "seal" ? G.sealLaw(reference) : form === "deciding" ? G.checkingLaw(reference) : G.illegal(reference);
  }
  if (ground.ground === "incompatible" && ground.ruleId !== null) {
    const rule = getRule(ground.ruleId, rulesVersion);
    // A decision records the version it was made under, and every version is kept: one that is missing is never rendered as another.
    if (!rule) throw new Error(`a statement cites ${ground.ruleId} of rulebook version ${rulesVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
    const words = form === "about" ? G.restedOnRule : form === "seal" ? G.sealRule : form === "deciding" ? G.checkingRule : G.breaks;
    return words(rule.id, rule.title, rule.text);
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The statement of reasons as paragraphs, in this order: what was done (one paragraph for each measure and each reversal,
 * then what ended); where it applies and for how long; how it came to korbat; that nothing was automated; the rule or the
 * law; the facts and the reason; and what the author can do about it.
 */
export function statementParagraphs(input: StatementInput): string[] {
  const redress = getRedress(input.redressVersion);
  if (!redress) throw new Error(`a statement names the redress texts of version ${input.redressVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
  const paragraphs: string[] = [];
  const about = input.kind === "review" || input.kind === "correction";
  const restricts = input.measures.length > 0;

  // What was done.
  if (about) {
    if (input.reviewed === null) throw new Error("the statement of a review or a correction names the decision it is about: the decision's data holds none");
    const decided = utcMinute(input.reviewed.decidedAt);
    if (input.kind === "review") paragraphs.push(W.reviewed(decided, input.outcome === "kept" ? "kept" : input.outcome === "partly_reversed" ? "partly_reversed" : "reversed"));
    else paragraphs.push(input.reviewed.kind === "interim" ? W.interimLifted(decided) : W.corrected(decided, input.outcome === "partly_reversed"));
  }
  for (const measure of input.measures) paragraphs.push(measureParagraph(input, measure, redress));
  for (const reversal of input.reversals) paragraphs.push(reversalParagraph(input, reversal));
  if (input.endedMeasures.length > 0) paragraphs.push(endedParagraph(input));
  if (paragraphs.length === 0) paragraphs.push(W.noAction);

  // Where and how long: only a decision that restricts has a scope.
  if (restricts) {
    paragraphs.push(input.kind === "interim" ? W.scope.interim : W.scope.final);
    if (input.ground === "illegal") paragraphs.push(W.scope.law);
  }

  // How it came to korbat, for a decision of its own; a review or a correction is korbat's own second look.
  if (!about) paragraphs.push(sourceSentence(input.source));
  // A decision that gives a strike says what the software did: it applied korbat's published rule of when one is given.
  paragraphs.push(input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "strike") ? W.automationStrike : W.automation);

  // The rule or the law: the decision's own, or for a review or a correction the reviewed decision's, from that decision's
  // row and in the wording of the rulebook that decision was made under.
  const form: GroundForm = about ? "about" : input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media") ? "seal" : input.kind === "interim" ? "deciding" : "found";
  const ground = about ? groundParagraph(input.reviewed!, input.reviewed!.rulesVersion, form) : groundParagraph(input, input.rulesVersion, form);
  if (ground !== null) paragraphs.push(ground);

  // The facts and the reason, while korbat keeps them.
  if (input.facts !== null) paragraphs.push(`The facts: ${input.facts}`);
  if (input.reason !== null) paragraphs.push(about ? `Why korbat ${input.outcome === "kept" ? "kept" : "changed"} it: ${input.reason}` : `korbat's reasons: ${input.reason}`);

  // Redress, from the decision's own kind and outcome.
  if (input.kind === "interim") paragraphs.push(redress.interim);
  else if (input.kind === "final" && input.outcome === "restricted") {
    const appeal = redress.appeal.replace("{deadline}", () => utcMinute(appealDeadline(new Date(input.decidedAt))));
    paragraphs.push(input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media") ? `${appeal} ${W.sealAppeal}` : appeal);
  } else paragraphs.push(redress.notAppealable);
  return paragraphs;
}
```
